strings.Chủ tiệm hỏi riêng, còn chỉ chỗ có ổ cắm: The owner asked me privately, and even pointed out a spot with an outlet. After moving, I actually focus better.
strings.Anh Khoa dời sang quầy bar, nhóm bốn ngư: Khoa moves to the bar, and the group of four gets the table within three minutes. That afternoon he orders another drink and a croissant.
strings.Được hỏi riêng, lại có ổ cắm, mình đổi l: Asked privately, and there's an outlet too — I switched right away. Didn't feel kicked out at all.
strings.Chờ có chút xíu là có bàn, tiệm xoay xở: Just a short wait and we got a table — the shop handled it smoothly.
strings.Giờ cao điểm mà bàn bốn chỉ có một người: A four-seat table taken up by one person during peak hour really cuts into lunch-shift revenue.
strings.Soạn nội quy mới: giờ cao điểm mỗi khách: Draft a new house rule: during peak hours, 2 hours max per order, posted for everyone starting next week
strings.Hôm nay nhóm bốn người bỏ đi, nhưng từ t: The group of four leaves today, but from next week everyone knows the rule before ordering.
strings.Luật rõ ràng thì mình tự canh giờ, không: With a clear rule, I can keep track of my own time — no one's put on the spot.
Well, we're heading to another café today.
strings.Gợi ý anh Khoa gói “combo làm việc” (đồ: Suggest Khoa a “work combo” (drink + pastry, 10% off) if he wants to keep sitting
strings.Anh Khoa mua combo, vẫn ngồi bàn bốn. Ti: Khoa buys the combo and stays at the four-seat table. The shop gets extra revenue, but the group still has to leave.
strings.Hợp lý, nhưng nghe hơi giống bị nhắc khé: Fair enough, but it kind of sounds like a polite way of charging for the seat.
No seats, so we just have to go.
strings.Tới rút sạc laptop: “Ngồi vậy tiệm lỗ, a: Walk over and yank the laptop charger: “Sitting like this loses the shop money, you should head out”
strings.Bị rút sạc giữa lúc đang làm, không một: Getting my charger yanked mid-work, without a word of warning. No house rule exists, yet I'm kicked out like some nuisance.
strings.Anh Khoa mất dữ liệu đang soạn, bỏ về. N: Khoa loses the document he was drafting and leaves. The group takes the table, but the neighboring table watched the whole thing and starts whispering.
strings.Nếu có luật thì mình đã theo. Đằng này b: If there'd been a rule, I would've followed it. Instead I got unplugged in front of everyone.
strings.Mình cũng hay ngồi lâu… chắc lần sau đi: I sit for a long time too... guess I'll go somewhere else next time.
strings.Nội quy phải báo trước và áp dụng như nh: House rules need to be announced ahead of time and applied equally; in the middle of a busy shift, a private word usually works better than an order to leave.
strings.Bánh hôm qua: tặng hay bỏ?: Yesterday's pastries: give away or toss?
strings.Sáng sớm, Mơ ghé: “Bếp Cơm 0 Đồng Ngõ Mâ: Early morning, Mơ stops by: “The Mây Alley Free Kitchen is asking for yesterday's pastries for the lottery-ticket sellers' breakfast — do you have any?” The case still has croissants, yesterday's bread, and a few slices of salted egg sponge cake.
strings.Croissant và bánh mì ra lò sáng hôm qua,: Croissants and bread came out of the oven yesterday morning, kept in a sealed box at room temperature. The salted egg sponge cake has custard sauce and was left outside the fridge overnight.
strings.Bánh khô ≤ 1 ngày: được giảm giá hoặc tặ: Dry pastries ≤ 1 day old: can be discounted or given away, with the bake date clearly marked. Pastries with cream/sauce left outside the fridge overnight: toss — don't sell, don't give away.
strings.Bếp phát bánh ngay trong buổi sáng, có s: The kitchen hands out the pastries that same morning, with a log recording the donated food source and the date received.
strings.Tặng croissant và bánh mì hôm qua kèm nh: Give away yesterday's croissants and bread with the bake-date label; toss the salted egg sponge cake and log it as waste
strings.Hai mươi cô chú có bánh ăn sáng. Mơ chụp: Twenty lottery sellers get breakfast pastries. Mơ photographs the bake-date label and pastes it into the kitchen's log.
strings.Có nhãn ngày rõ ràng, bếp tụi em yên tâm: With a clear date label, our kitchen feels safe handing these out to everyone.
strings.Croissant còn thơm bơ, sáng nay khỏi nhị: The croissant still smells of butter — no going hungry this morning.
strings.Bỏ bông lan cũng tiếc, nhưng sốt trứng q: It's a shame to toss the sponge cake, but overnight custard sauce is nothing to gamble with.
strings.Tặng hết cho đỡ phí, kể cả bông lan trứn: Give it all away to avoid waste, including the salted egg sponge cake
strings.Tình nguyện viên ngửi thấy sốt đã chua n: A volunteer smells that the sauce has gone sour and has to toss it mid-handout. The kitchen's flustered, and Mơ nervously double-checks every item with the shop afterward.
We trusted the shop, so we didn't check every item. That almost went badly...
strings.Đồ cho người khó khăn càng phải an toàn: Food for people in need should be even safer, not less.
strings.Bỏ hết cho chắc, không muốn rắc rối: Toss it all to be safe, don't want any trouble
strings.An toàn tuyệt đối, nhưng mười mấy chiếc: Absolutely safe, but over a dozen perfectly good pastries end up in the trash. Mơ goes home empty-handed.
strings.Em hiểu tiệm cẩn thận, chỉ tiếc bánh còn: I get that the shop's being careful, it's just a shame the pastries were still good.
Today's waste log is way too long.
strings.Bày lại lên kệ như bánh mới, bán giá thư: Put it back on the shelf as if fresh, sell at full price
strings.Bà Sáu mua phải ổ bánh mì hôm qua, về nh: Grandma Sáu buys yesterday's bread by mistake, can't chew it at home, and comes straight to the counter the next day to ask about it.
strings.Bánh cũ thì nói bánh cũ, bà mua rẻ cũng: If it's old bread, just say it's old bread — I'd have bought it cheap and been happy. Why lie to an old woman?
strings.Tiệm không cho mà đem bán như bánh mới…: The shop didn't give it away, but sold it off as fresh instead... that's really disappointing.
strings.Chia sẻ thực phẩm là việc tốt khi còn an: Sharing food is a good thing when it's still safe: label the bake date, and exclude anything with cream/sauce left overnight.
strings.Nhà phân phối Hạt Nắng báo: từ tuần này: Hạt Nắng distributor announces: starting this week, unsalted butter is up 40%. Every croissant now costs about 3 more coins in ingredients. Uncle Lâm, who buys a croissant every morning, is standing there reading the price board.
strings.Bơ lạt: 4 → 5,6 xu/khối. Mỗi khay croiss: Unsalted butter: 4 → 5.6 coins/block. Each tray of croissants uses 2 blocks.
strings.Croissant bán 22 xu; nguyên liệu mới ~9: Croissant sells for 22 coins; new ingredient cost ~9 coins, plus oven power, kneading labor, and depreciation ~8 coins.
strings.Có bơ thực vật rẻ hơn một nửa; vị, độ xố: There's margarine at less than half the price; the taste, texture, and ingredients differ from dairy butter.
strings.Tăng croissant thêm 3 xu, dán thông báo: Raise the croissant price by 3 coins, post a notice explaining why at the counter, keep the real butter
strings.Tăng 3 xu mà có ghi rõ lý do, bánh vẫn t: A 3-coin increase with a clear reason posted, and the croissant still smells of real butter. I'm fine with that.
strings.Vài khách hỏi, đọc thông báo rồi gật đầu: A few customers ask, read the notice, and nod along. Croissant sales stay nearly the same.
strings.Giá gì cũng lên, miễn bánh vẫn vậy và ng: Prices go up everywhere — as long as the pastry stays the same and people are honest about it.
strings.Tiệm vẫn đặt đều, bên em sẽ báo trước nế: The shop keeps ordering steadily; we'll let you know ahead of time if the price drops again.
strings.Chuyển sang bơ thực vật, đổi tên trên bả: Switch to margarine, rename it on the board to “margarine croissant”, keep the price the same
strings.Giá không đổi nhưng bánh không còn thơm: Price stays the same, but the pastry doesn't smell as good as before. At least the shop's upfront about it.
strings.Khách trung thành thấy khác vị; một số c: Loyal customers notice the difference in taste; some switch to bread instead. The shop keeps the price but loses a bit of flavor reputation.
strings.Ghi rõ là tốt, nhưng chú mua croissant v: Labeling it clearly is good, but I buy croissants for that butter smell.
strings.Bơ thực vật cán lớp dễ hơn nhưng bánh kh: Margarine is easier to laminate, but the pastry doesn't melt in your mouth the same way.
strings.Lén đổi sang bơ thực vật, bảng vẫn ghi “: Secretly switch to margarine, but leave the board reading “dairy butter croissant”
strings.Bảng ghi bơ sữa mà ăn là biết bơ thực vậ: The board says dairy butter, but one bite and you can tell it's margarine. Trust, gone.
strings.Một khách làm bánh tại gia nhận ra ngay: A home baker customer notices immediately and posts a comparison online. A wrong ingredient label is also a serious matter for anyone avoiding dairy or eating vegan.
strings.Tăng giá chú chịu được, bị lừa thì không: I can handle a price hike. Being lied to, I can't.
strings.Ghi sai thành phần thì người ăn kiêng bi: If the ingredient label is wrong, what are people with dietary restrictions supposed to trust?
strings.Giữ giá, lặng lẽ làm croissant nhỏ lại 2: Keep the price the same, quietly shrink the croissant by 20%
strings.Hình như croissant teo đi thì phải? Giá: Did the croissant shrink or something? Same price, but it's noticeably smaller.
strings.Khách quen nhận ra ngay khi cầm bánh. Kh: Regulars notice the moment they pick it up. No one says anything, but morning sales quietly start dropping.
strings.Chú mua ở đây ba năm, cầm lên là biết nh: I've been buying here for three years — I can tell the second it feels lighter in my hand.
A customer asked, and I didn't know how to answer.
strings.Khi chi phí tăng, khách chấp nhận giá mớ: When costs go up, customers accept a new price far more easily than they accept being kept in the dark.
strings.Tên trên bánh sinh nhật bị viết sai: The name on the birthday cake is spelled wrong
strings.Cô Diệp mở hộp bánh ngay tại quầy: “Trời: Ms. Diệp opens the box right at the counter: “Oh no, my granddaughter's name is NGỌC, why does it say NGOC? The party starts at 6!” The clock reads 5:10.
strings.Bạn là người bà đặt bánh cho cháu gái, đ: You're the grandmother who ordered the cake for her granddaughter — you gave careful instructions over the phone, and even confirmed by text.
strings.Phiếu viết tay khi nghe điện thoại ghi “: The handwritten slip taken over the phone reads “Bao Ngoc” without diacritics — the tablet was out of battery that day, so it was jotted down in a hurry.
strings.Ngay sau cuộc gọi, cô Diệp nhắn đúng tên: Right after the call, Ms. Diệp texted the correct name “Bảo Ngọc” with full diacritics. No one had cross-checked the text yet.
strings.Cạo lớp chữ, láng lại kem và viết mới mấ: Scraping off the lettering, resmoothing the frosting, and writing it again takes about 10 minutes.
strings.Nhận lỗi của tiệm, sửa chữ ngay trong 10: Own the shop's mistake, fix the lettering in 10 minutes, throw in a free box of number candles, and change the process: read the name with full diacritics back to the customer
strings.Tiệm nhận lỗi liền, 10 phút sửa xong, cò: The shop owned up right away, fixed it in 10 minutes, and even threw in number candles. Little Ngọc had a great time blowing them out!
strings.Cô Diệp ngồi uống trà chờ. Bánh đúng tên: Ms. Diệp sits and has tea while she waits. The cake gets the name right in time for the party, and from the next day on, the order form has a box for “read the name back to the customer”.
strings.Ai cũng có lúc sai, quan trọng là sửa kị: Everyone slips up sometimes — what matters is fixing it fast and not pointing fingers.
strings.Có tin nhắn mà không đối chiếu là lỗi qu: Having the text on file but not cross-checking it is a process failure, not the customer's fault.
strings.Tên con có dấu nặng xinh xinh trên bánh!: My name has that cute dot-below mark right on the cake!
strings.Đưa phiếu ra: “Cô đọc qua điện thoại khô: Hold up the slip: “You read it to me over the phone without the marks”
strings.Tôi đã nhắn tin đúng tên mà tiệm còn đổ: I texted the correct name and the shop still blames me for misreading it. Never ordering here again.
strings.Cô Diệp đưa tin nhắn ra. Tiệm vẫn phải s: Ms. Diệp pulls up the text message. The shop still has to fix it, but loses a customer who used to order cakes for the whole extended family.
strings.Tôi có tin nhắn đây này. Sai thì nhận, c: I have the text right here. If you're wrong, own it — no point arguing.
strings.Giá như mình mở tin nhắn ra trước khi nó: If only I'd checked the text before speaking up.
strings.Giảm 30% nhưng không sửa vì sợ không kịp: 30% off, but no fix, out of fear there's not enough time
strings.Được giảm tiền nhưng cả bữa tiệc ai cũng: I got a discount, but everyone at the party saw my granddaughter's name spelled wrong.
strings.Cô Diệp cầm bánh về trong im lặng. Ảnh c: Ms. Diệp takes the cake home in silence. The birthday party photos show the lettering missing its diacritics.
strings.Tiền giảm đâu thay được tấm ảnh sinh nhậ: A discount doesn't make up for my granddaughter's birthday photos.
strings.10 phút là sửa kịp mà…: 10 minutes would've been enough to fix it...
strings.Chữ trên bánh là phần quý nhất với người: The lettering on a cake matters most to the person receiving it: confirm the name with full diacritics in writing before you write it on.
strings.3 giờ chiều, cả dãy phố cúp điện. Khay c: 3 p.m., the whole block loses power. A tray of croissants in the oven is only half-baked, the fridge is holding fresh whipped cream, and Thảo's due to pick up her cake at 5.
strings.Không mở cửa lò khi mất điện: nhiệt giữ: Don't open the oven door during a power cut: heat holds for about 10 minutes. Half-baked pastries left to cool for hours and then rebaked usually come out flat and subpar.
strings.Đóng kín cửa, tủ giữ dưới 8 °C khoảng 2: With the door shut, the fridge stays below 8 °C for about 2 hours. Fresh whipped cream must be kept below 8 °C.
strings.Cốt bánh của chị Thảo đã nướng xong từ t: Thảo's cake sponge finished baking at noon — all that's left is frosting and lettering.
strings.Giữ kín cửa lò và tủ mát, gọi báo chị Th: Keep the oven and fridge doors shut, call Thảo to push back the pickup time or frost by hand in a cool corner; log the croissant tray as waste
strings.Tiệm gọi báo sớm, mình đổi giờ lấy bánh,: The shop called ahead, I adjusted my pickup time, no surprises at all. Very professional.
strings.Kem tươi an toàn, bánh của chị Thảo xong: The whipped cream stays safe, and Thảo's cake is ready by 5:40. The half-baked croissant tray gets logged as waste instead of being sold recklessly.
strings.Được báo từ 3 giờ nên chị sắp xếp kịp, k: Got the heads-up at 3, so I had time to rearrange — no standing around waiting.
strings.Tiếc khay croissant, nhưng bánh nửa sống: A shame about the croissant tray, but no one should risk selling half-raw pastries.
strings.Mở lò và tủ mát ra kiểm liên tục cho yên: Keep opening the oven and fridge to check, just to feel reassured
strings.Mỗi lần mở cửa là mất nhiệt; kem tươi lê: Every time the door opens, heat escapes; the whipped cream climbs past 8 °C and has to be tossed, and the croissants go completely flat.
strings.Càng mở càng hỏng. Lò với tủ cần được để: The more you open it, the worse it gets. The oven and fridge need to be left alone.
Showed up at 5 only to find the cake's not ready.
strings.Để nguội khay croissant nướng dở rồi bán: Let the half-baked croissant tray cool, then sell it at a discount
strings.Croissant giảm giá mà ruột còn sống nhão: The discounted croissant's still gooey and raw inside. What kind of saving is that?
strings.Khách mua về phát hiện ruột bột còn sống: A customer takes it home, discovers the raw dough inside, comes back demanding a refund, and posts photos in the neighborhood group.
strings.Ruột bánh còn bột sống, may chị chưa đưa: The inside was still raw dough — good thing I hadn't fed it to my kid yet.
strings.Nhóm khu phố đang bàn tán ghê lắm…: The neighborhood group is buzzing about this something fierce...
strings.Không báo ai, hy vọng có điện kịp: Don't tell anyone, hope the power comes back in time
strings.Tới đúng hẹn mới biết bánh chưa xong. Bá: Showed up right on time only to find the cake wasn't ready. A heads-up would've been all it took.
strings.Điện có lại 5 giờ 30 như thông báo; chị: Power comes back at 5:30, just as the notice said; Thảo ends up waiting almost an hour.
strings.Chị không giận cúp điện, chị giận vì khô: I'm not mad about the power cut. I'm mad that no one told me.
strings.Em cũng không biết nói sao khi chị ấy tớ: I didn't know what to say when she showed up.
strings.Sự cố thì ưu tiên an toàn thực phẩm, giữ: When something goes wrong, prioritize food safety, keep hot and cold storage proper, and tell the customer as early as possible.
strings.Thực tập sinh làm đổ cà phê lên khách qu: An intern spills coffee on a regular customer
strings.Tí — thực tập sinh tuần đầu — bưng khay: Tí — an intern in his first week — trips over a charging cable while carrying a hot latte, spilling half the cup onto Thảo's sleeve and bag. The whole shop goes silent.
strings.Bạn là thực tập sinh 18 tuổi, tuần đầu đ: You're an 18-year-old intern, first week on the job, and you just spilled a hot drink on a regular customer.
Her wrist is a little red; she says it stings.
strings.Túi vải bị loang cà phê; laptop bên tron: The fabric bag has a coffee stain; the laptop inside is still dry.
strings.Dây sạc của khách bàn bên vắt ngang lối: The charging cable from the next table has been stretched across the walkway since noon, and no one's cleared it.
strings.Lo cho chị Thảo trước: xả vết rát dưới n: See to Thảo first: run the burn under cool water, give her a clean towel, make a fresh cup, offer to cover her bag's cleaning cost; then coil up the cable and coach Tí privately
strings.Bị đổ cà phê mà ra về vẫn thấy được chăm: I got coffee spilled on me, but still left feeling taken care of. The shop was thoughtful about everything, from the burn to the bag.
strings.Tay chị Thảo dịu lại sau vài phút nước m: Thảo's hand settles after a few minutes under cool water. The cable gets cleared from the walkway; Tí gets coached on how to carry a tray and watch where he's walking.
strings.Chị thấy người ta lo cho mình trước khi: I saw them look after me before worrying about saving face. That's enough for me.
strings.Em tưởng bị đuổi, nhưng chủ tiệm chỉ cho: I thought I'd get fired, but the owner just showed me how to carry the tray and told me to always watch where I'm walking.
strings.Hóa ra dây sạc của mình… lần sau mình ng: Turns out it was my own cable... next time I'll sit somewhere with an outlet against the wall.
strings.Mắng Tí ngay trước mặt khách cho khách h: Scold Tí right in front of the customer to let her vent
strings.Tay tôi đang rát mà chủ tiệm lo mắng nhâ: My hand's stinging and the owner's busy scolding staff. Everyone in the shop feels awkward on my behalf.
strings.Tí khóc ở kho, chiều đó xin nghỉ. Chị Th: Tí cries in the storeroom and quits that afternoon. Thảo still hasn't gotten anyone to bring her cool water.
strings.Tôi đâu cần xem mắng người, tôi cần nước: I don't need to watch someone get scolded, I need cool water for my hand.
strings.Em biết em sai, nhưng bị mắng trước cả t: I know I messed up, but getting scolded in front of the whole shop — I don't dare come back.
strings.Xin lỗi và tặng voucher ly sau, không là: Apologize and offer a voucher for next time, nothing more
strings.Có xin lỗi, có voucher, nhưng cái túi và: There's an apology, there's a voucher, but the bag and the wrist I'm left to deal with myself.
strings.Chị Thảo nhận voucher, về tự xử lý vết r: Thảo accepts the voucher and goes home to tend to the burn herself. The cable's still stretched across the walkway.
strings.Lời xin lỗi thì có, sự chăm sóc thì chưa: There was an apology. There wasn't real care.
No one showed me what to do differently.
strings.Nói với chị Thảo đây là lỗi của khách bà: Tell Thảo it's the next table's fault for leaving the cable out
strings.Ly của tiệm đổ lên người tôi mà tiệm đi: The shop's own drink spilled on me, and the shop's blaming another customer for it.
strings.Hai bàn khách lời qua tiếng lại. Không a: The two tables start bickering. Neither gets looked after, and the cable's still lying right there.
strings.Tôi để dây đó từ trưa, tiệm đâu có nhắc: I left that cable there since noon, and the shop never said a word about it.
strings.Lỗi ai thì tính sau, tay tôi đang rát đâ: Figure out whose fault it is later — my hand is stinging right now.
strings.Khi có sự cố: người bị ảnh hưởng trước,: When something goes wrong: the person affected comes first, whose fault it is comes later; coach new staff privately and fix the root cause.
strings.Shot chiết đúng giây. Bánh ra lò đúng mà: Shots pulled to the second. Pastries baked to the right color.
strings.Xay hạt, chiết shot, đánh sữa; canh lò b: Grind beans, pull shots, steam milk; watch the oven and the display case. Every cup is the right drink, every pastry is the right day.
strings.Mùi bơ nướng lúc 6 giờ sáng: The smell of baking butter at 6 a.m.
strings.Đánh sữa mịn như lụa, vẽ tim chưa bao gi: Steam milk silky smooth, and never draw a lopsided heart.
strings.Dậy từ 4 giờ nhồi bột, thuộc lòng giờ ủ: Up at 4 a.m. kneading dough, knows every batch's proofing time by heart.
strings.Nhớ tên và món quen của gần hết khách tr: Remembers the name and usual order of nearly everyone in the alley.
Quick hands during rush hour, sometimes a bit careless.
strings.Xay mịn và chiết shot: Grind fine and pull the shot
strings.Bà Sáu kể hồi trẻ bà làm ở một lò bánh P: Grandma Sáu tells you that back in her youth she worked at a French bakery at the top of the street, folding dough “three by three” by hand. She wants to see how the shop folds its dough.
strings.Bạn mời bà vào bếp lúc 5 giờ sáng. Bà ch: You invite her into the kitchen at 5 a.m. She shows you how to keep the butter ice-cold so the dough layers don't stick together.

strings.Kiểm toán hỏi chứng từ không tìm thấy: The auditor asks for a document you can't find

strings.Mất chứng từ là chuyện xảy ra; làm giả m: Losing a document happens; faking one is a real problem.

I'd much rather have heard “I lost it”.

Silence turns a small problem into a big one.

strings.Thiếu chứng từ thì tìm bằng chứng thay t: If a document is missing, find alternative evidence and tell the truth — never recreate a document.
Someone says “the treasurer probably took it home”.

strings.Quỹ “khớp” nhưng phiếu tạm ứng không đượ: The cash “matches”, but the advance voucher never gets recorded: at month-end, Bảo's advance vanishes from the ledger, and the figures are wrong in two places.
strings.Bù tiền túi là che mất nguyên nhân — lần: Covering it out of pocket just hides the cause — what happens when the next shortfall is bigger?

Blamed before anything's even been checked. That really hurts.

strings.Hai mươi năm giữ quỹ, lần đầu bị nói vậy: Twenty years keeping the cash box, and this is the first time I've been talked about like that.
strings.Tôi đã suýt quyết định sai vì một thông: I nearly made the wrong call over information that was never checked.
strings.Lệch quỹ: đếm lại có chứng kiến, rà chứn: A cash discrepancy: recount with a witness, go through the documents, draw up a record — never top it up yourself, never assign blame without evidence.
strings.Phòng kinh doanh ép ghi doanh thu sớm: Sales pressures you to book revenue early

strings.Ban giám đốc duyệt thêm chỉ tiêu hợp đồn: The board approves the new signed-contracts metric; the books keep revenue recorded at the right time.
strings.Tưởng bị từ chối là xong, ai ngờ được sử: Thought being turned down was the end of it, and instead the whole KPI formula got fixed.
strings.Kế toán không chỉ giữ sổ, còn góp ý để q: Accounting isn't just about keeping the books — it's also about helping make the process fairer.

strings.Tuyệt vời luôn!!! (tháng sau kiểm toán g: Absolutely amazing!!! (next month when the audit calls me in though… it's a bit of a disaster 😬)

strings.Ghi doanh thu trước khi giao hàng là làm: Booking revenue before the goods ship is just dressing up the numbers.
One month of happiness, a whole quarter of headaches.
strings.Đúng là không được, nhưng nghe câu đó em: Yeah, it's really not allowed, but hearing that kind of deflated me a little.

strings.Em cần biết vì sao, không chỉ nghe chữ “: I need to know why, not just hear the word “no”.
strings.Đúng nguyên tắc rồi, nhưng thêm một câu: Being right on principle is one thing, but one more sentence of explanation plus one alternative would've turned sales into an ally.
strings.Doanh thu theo thời điểm giao hàng, khôn: Revenue follows the delivery date, not KPI pressure; if the pressure's real, fix how you measure it — not the books.
strings.Email “từ CEO” đòi chuyển khoản gấp: An email “from the CEO” demands an urgent transfer

The company's real domain is maytrexanh.vn; this email uses “maytrexanh-vn.co”.
strings.Không có nhà cung cấp nào với số tài kho: There's no supplier on file with this account number; there's no contract or payment request either.
strings.Mọi khoản chi trên 1.000 xu cần đề nghị: Every payment over 1,000 coins needs a signed payment request and verification through a registered phone number.
strings.Không chuyển; gọi anh Tùng qua số đã đăn: Don't transfer it; call Tùng through his registered number, report it to IT, move the email to the scam folder
strings.Anh đang ngồi quán cà phê chứ họp hành g: I'm sitting at a café, no meeting at all! That's a fake email. Thanks for saving the company 3,000 coins.
strings.IT chặn tên miền giả và gửi cảnh báo toà: IT blocks the fake domain and sends a company-wide warning. Two other departments got a similar email but were warned in time.
strings.Tôi không bao giờ bảo ai “đừng gọi” khi: I would never tell anyone “don't call” when it comes to transferring money. Remember that.
strings.Một cuộc gọi xác minh rẻ hơn mọi phần mề: One verification call is cheaper than any anti-fraud software.
strings.Quy trình chi tồn tại chính là cho những: The payment process exists exactly for moments like this, when you're being rushed.
strings.Chuyển ngay, sếp đang gấp mà: Transfer it right away, the boss is in a hurry
strings.Anh chưa từng gửi email đó. Công ty mất: I never sent that email. The company just lost 3,000 coins, and you skipped every verification step.
strings.Tiền đi vào tài khoản lừa đảo; ngân hàng: The money goes into the scammer's account; the bank can only freeze part of it back. You get disciplined and lose your bonus.
strings.Lệnh hợp lệ từ tài khoản của khách, ngân: It's a valid order from the customer's own account — the bank can only help trace it after the fact.
strings.Tôi giận kẻ lừa đảo, nhưng cũng giận việ: I'm angry at the scammer, but I'm also angry that the process got skipped.
strings.Trả lời email hỏi “anh chắc chứ ạ?”: Reply to the email asking “are you sure about this?”
strings.Kẻ gian trả lời ngay “chắc chắn, nhanh l: The scammer replies right away, “absolutely certain, hurry up”. Luckily you hesitate until morning and ask Tùng directly.
strings.Hỏi lại qua chính email giả là hỏi kẻ lừ: Replying through the same fake email just means asking the scammer. Use a registered channel instead.
strings.Tôi không bao giờ đòi chuyển tiền qua em: I would never demand a money transfer over email. Next time, just call my number directly.
strings.Yêu cầu chuyển tiền gấp + bí mật + kênh: An urgent transfer request + secrecy + an unfamiliar channel = a scam red flag. Always verify through a registered channel and follow the payment process.
strings.Thực tập sinh làm đổ cà phê lên chứng từ: The intern spills coffee on the original documents

strings.Em tưởng tiêu rồi, ai ngờ có quy trình h: I thought I was done for, turns out there's a whole procedure for it. From now on my coffee stays on that other desk 😅
strings.Đủ chứng từ thay thế trong hai ngày. Phò: Replacement documents are all in within two days. The accounting office puts up a sign: “Filing Area — No Drinks.”
strings.Được chỉ cách sửa thay vì bị mắng, em nh: Getting shown how to fix it instead of getting yelled at — I'll remember this lesson for a long time.
strings.Sự cố nhỏ xử lý đúng quy trình thì không: A small mishap handled the right way never turns into a big deal.
strings.Tự viết lại mấy tờ mới cho giống, khỏi p: Rewrite fresh copies yourself to match, no need to bother the suppliers
strings.Chị Hạnh phát hiện chữ trên tờ viết lại: Hạnh notices the handwriting on the rewritten sheets doesn't match the e-invoices at all. Both of you get a warning.

strings.Chụp ảnh ngay, báo sự cố lên app, giao k: Take photos right away, report the incident in the app, deliver it with an explanation, and invite the customer to inspect it together
strings.Hộp móp nhưng shipper nói thật, mở kiểm: The box is dented, but the rider was honest, opened it together to check, and even reported it to insurance. Much appreciated!
strings.Chỉ một chiếc chén mẻ, bảo hiểm và shop: Only one chipped bowl — insurance and the shop replace it. Ms. Mận keeps her customer.
strings.Chị buồn chiếc chén nhưng quý sự thật th: She's sad about the bowl, but she values the honesty.
We got to check it together — nobody has to suspect anybody.
strings.Dán thêm băng keo che góc móp rồi giao n: Slap on extra tape to hide the dent and deliver it as if nothing happened
The customer gets a box wrapped in layers of tape, opens it to find broken bowls. The rider flat-out denies it!
strings.Khách phát hiện chén vỡ sau khi shipper: The customer discovers the broken bowls after the rider's gone, and complains to both the shop and the post station.
Lost a regular customer over one layer of tape.
strings.Không có ảnh sự cố thì bảo hiểm không hỗ: Without incident photos, insurance can't help.
strings.Báo “thất lạc hàng” cho gọn: Just report it as “lost in transit” to keep things simple
strings.Kiểm tra định vị cho thấy hàng vẫn trong: GPS tracking shows the item's still in the delivery box. You get written up for dishonesty.
A false report is worse than a dented box.
strings.Hàng tôi rõ ràng đang ở đâu đó mà?: My item's clearly somewhere out there, isn't it?
strings.Sự cố thì báo ngay kèm ảnh và để khách đ: Report incidents right away with photos and let the customer inspect together — covering up turns a small problem into a big one.
strings.Còn 6 phút là trễ đơn của anh Tùng. Con: Six minutes left before Tùng's order is late. The wrong-way street in front of Bồ Câu School would cut out a whole loop.
strings.Đường một chiều, giờ tan trường đông học: One-way street, packed with students at school dismissal time.
strings.Trễ vài phút chỉ bị trừ ít phí ship, khô: A few minutes late only costs a small shipping-fee deduction, not an account lock.
strings.Có thể nhắn khách “Em kẹt đường, trễ 5 p: You can text the customer, “Stuck in traffic, running 5 minutes late.”
strings.Đi đúng đường vòng, nhắn khách xin trễ 5: Take the proper detour, and text the customer to ask for 5 more minutes
A little late, but with a heads-up — polite.
strings.Tới trễ 5 phút, anh Tùng càu nhàu một câ: Arrives 5 minutes late; Tùng grumbles once and lets it go.
Five minutes late is fine, as long as you let me know.
strings.Giờ tan trường mà xe cứ đâm ngược chiều: Bikes barreling the wrong way at dismissal time is downright scary.
strings.Chạy ngược chiều cho kịp: Ride the wrong way to make it in time
strings.Suýt quẹt một em học sinh, bị cảnh sát g: Nearly clipped a student, got a ticket from traffic police.
I was so startled I dropped my whole backpack.
strings.Được 5 sao mà mất tiền phạt, còn run cả: Got five stars but paid a fine, and your hands are still shaking.
strings.Leo lề đi cho nhanh: Ride up onto the sidewalk to go faster
strings.Người đi bộ la ó, bảo vệ trường chụp ảnh: Pedestrians shout, and the school guard photographs it and sends it to the post station.
strings.Áo đồng phục in logo, ai cũng biết em là: Your uniform has the logo printed on it — everyone knows who you are.
strings.Vài phút trễ có thể xin lỗi; tai nạn thì: A few minutes late, you can apologize for; an accident, you can't take back.
strings.Mưa như trút, vài con hẻm ngập tới bánh: Rain’s pouring down, and some alleys are flooded up to the wheel hubs. Ms. Hạnh calls: “Double bonus this shift — can you run a bit more?”
Ốc Bươu Alley is flooded 30 cm deep, with distant lightning.
The rain suit's still good, but one headlight is dim.
strings.Được từ chối đơn đi qua vùng ngập sâu; d: You may refuse orders that go through deep-flooded areas; pull over to shelter when lightning is near.
strings.Nhận thêm ca nhưng chỉ tuyến không ngập,: Take the extra shift, but only routes that aren't flooded, headlight on, and shelter when there's lightning
strings.Bạn chạy chậm mà chắc, giao được 3 đơn,: You ride slow but steady, deliver 3 orders, and get home safe.
strings.Chị cần người chạy bền, không cần người: I need someone who lasts, not someone reckless.
strings.Trời mưa vậy mà vẫn có người mang tới, q: Even in weather like this, someone still brings it — that means a lot.
strings.Nhận hết mọi đơn kể cả hẻm ngập: Take every order, even the flooded alleys
strings.Xe chết máy giữa hẻm ngập, tốn tiền sửa: The bike stalls in the middle of a flooded alley — costs money to fix the spark plug, and the goods get soaked.
Pushed the bike through the water for 20 minutes.
Water's gotten into the spark plug — it's not going to start.
strings.Từ chối ca thêm vì đèn xe mờ: Turn down the extra shift because of the dim headlight
strings.Bạn về nghỉ an toàn, chị Hạnh tìm người: You go home safe, and Ms. Hạnh finds someone else.
strings.Biết giới hạn là tốt, mai nhớ thay bóng: Good to know your limits — remember to replace that bulb tomorrow.
strings.Ca mưa thiếu người, tụi mình chạy mệt hơ: Short-staffed for the rain shift, so the rest of us run a bit harder.
strings.Tiền thưởng không đáng để đánh cược an t: A bonus isn't worth gambling your safety on: only take on work within your own safe limits.
strings.Cuộc gọi xin mã OTP: A call asking for your OTP code
strings.Số lạ gọi tới: “Anh là kỹ thuật app Giao: An unknown number calls: “This is Giao Nhanh app tech support. Your wallet’s been locked — read me the OTP code we just sent so I can unlock it, or you’ll lose your bonus.”
strings.“Mã OTP đăng nhập ví của bạn là …. KHÔNG: “Your wallet login OTP is …. DO NOT share this code with anyone.”
strings.Bưu cục không bao giờ xin OTP. Mọi hỗ tr: The post station never asks for OTPs. All support goes through the Help section in the app, or in person.
strings.Hối thúc liên tục: “Nhanh lên, 2 phút nữ: Keeps pushing: “Hurry up, 2 more minutes and you lose the money!”
strings.Không đọc mã, cúp máy, báo chị Hạnh qua: Don't read the code out, hang up, and report it to Ms. Hạnh through the official channel
strings.Chị Hạnh cảnh báo cả nhóm tài xế. Hai ng: Ms. Hạnh warns the whole rider group. Two others just got the exact same call.
You reported it early, so the whole group avoided it.
I almost read out the code too.
strings.Đọc mã cho nhanh, sợ mất tiền thưởng: Read out the code quickly, afraid of losing the bonus
The rider's wallet gets drained clean in minutes.
strings.Hai tuần chạy xe bay mất trong một cuộc: Two weeks of riding, gone in a single phone call.
strings.Không ai từ bưu cục xin OTP cả, em nhớ n: Nobody from the post station ever asks for an OTP — remember that.
strings.Không đọc mã nhưng bấm vào đường link họ: Don't read out the code, but tap the link they sent to “check”
strings.Đường link giả cài phần mềm lạ, bạn phải: The fake link installs strange software — you have to take your phone in for a reinstall.
A strange link is just as dangerous as reading out an OTP.
I thought I was being careful.
strings.Không đọc OTP, không bấm link lạ; xác mi: Don't read out an OTP, don't tap strange links; verify through the official channel. A real person wouldn't rush you like that.
Right person, right time, right money.
strings.Nhận đơn, chốt lộ trình, cân hàng, gói k: Accept the order, finalize the route, weigh the goods, pack them well, call the customer if the room number's missing, give the right change, and hand in the COD at the post station.
strings.Mỗi con hẻm là một câu chuyện đang chờ đ: Every alley holds a story waiting for a knock on the door
strings.Phân loại hàng theo tuyến, nhớ đường như: Sorts goods by route, knows every street by heart.
Packs with a steady hand, sparing with the bubble wrap.
strings.Gọi khách giọng ngọt, hỏi số phòng không: Calls customers with a sweet voice, never forgets to ask for the room number.
Strong, ties down bulky loads very carefully.
strings.Nhận đơn trên app: Accept the order in the app
strings.Gọi khách, giao, thu tiền: Call the customer, deliver, collect payment
strings.Về bưu cục nộp COD: Return to the post station to hand in COD
strings.Tô cháo cho ông Út: A bowl of porridge for Mr. Út
strings.Bà Út đặt cháo cho ông nhà đang cảm, dặn: Mrs. Út orders porridge for her husband, who has a cold, and reminds you again and again, “light on the scallions.”
strings.Bạn đứng chờ quán nấu, so từng hộp với b: You wait for the shop to cook, matching each container against the bill before heading out.
strings.Hôm sau bà Út dúi cho bạn hai cái bánh í: The next day Mrs. Út presses two bánh ít cakes into your hands: “He’s better now — thank you, dear.”
strings.Na chỉ bạn cách xếp đơn theo cụm: lấy gầ: Na shows you how to cluster orders: pick up nearby, deliver farther out, and food always goes first.
strings.Bạn tập vẽ tuyến trên giấy trước mỗi ca,: You practice sketching your route on paper before every shift, crossing off each stop as you go.
strings.Cuối tuần, số km của bạn giảm hẳn mà đơn: By the end of the week, your mileage drops noticeably while your delivery count goes up.
strings.Chiếc váy kịp giờ tiệc: A dress that made it to the party in time
strings.Bé Vy đặt váy dự tiệc, nhưng cứ chạy ra: Little Vy ordered a party dress, but she keeps darting off to the hair salon.
strings.Bạn gọi trước, giao đơn khác rồi quay lạ: You call ahead, deliver another order, then come back right at the appointed time.
strings.Vy gửi ảnh mặc váy dự tiệc: “Nhờ bạn shi: Vy sends a photo in her party dress: “Thanks to you I made it in time!”
strings.Hàng gói kỹ, sạch sẽ, cầm là thấy yên tâ: The package is well-wrapped and clean — you can just feel that it's safe.
Delivered neatly, no need to remind them of anything.
strings.Tới đúng giờ như đồng hồ báo thức!: Arrived right on time, like clockwork!
strings.Nhận đơn → chốt lộ trình → cân, kiểm, gó: Accept the order → finalize the route → weigh, check, pack → load the goods → call the customer → deliver, collect payment → hand in COD.
strings.Tới ngã tư Chợ Chiều, cảnh sát giao thôn: At the Chợ Chiều intersection, traffic police wave you over to check your vehicle documents.
strings.Tấp vào lề, xuất trình bằng lái và giấy: Pull over, show your license and registration
strings.Giấy tờ đủ, anh cảnh sát dặn cài quai mũ: Papers are all in order, the officer reminds you to strap your helmet and waves you on.
strings.Quay đầu né chốt, chạy đường khác: Turn around to dodge the checkpoint, take another route
strings.Né được, nhưng phải chạy vòng thêm một đ: You dodge it, but have to ride an extra stretch around.
strings.Bị chặn lại ở đầu hẻm, lập biên bản vì b: Stopped at the alley mouth, ticketed for fleeing: fined 20 coins, lose 12 minutes.
strings.Trời đang nắng bỗng tối sầm, gió giật, m: The sky was clear, now it's gone dark, wind's gusting, rain's about to pour. The goods on the bike don't have waterproof bags yet.
strings.Tấp vào hiên trú 10 phút cho qua cơn: Pull under an eave to wait out the storm for 10 minutes
strings.Cơn giông qua nhanh, hàng khô ráo, chỉ t: The storm passes quickly, goods stay dry, just a bit late.
strings.Trùm túi chống nước cho từng kiện rồi ch: Cover each package with a waterproof bag, then ride
Just finished covering the packages when the rain arrives.
strings.Chạy luôn cho kịp: Ride on to make it in time
strings.Kiện không có túi sẽ ướt: Packages without a bag will get wet
The rain lashes down, soaking both you and the goods.
strings.Shop lạ nhờ ứng tiền hàng: An unfamiliar shop asks you to front the payment
strings.Một shop lạ nhắn qua app: “Em ứng trước: “Front 80 coins for the shop's goods, will you? The customer pays 120 coins COD later, you keep the 40 coin profit!”
strings.Gọi thử số người nhận trước đã: Try calling the recipient's number first
strings.Số người nhận không có thật — đơn ảo lừa: The recipient's number doesn't exist — a fake order to scam you out of the advance. You report it to Hạnh to block the shop.
strings.Từ chối ứng tiền, báo bưu cục: Refuse to front the money, report it to the post office
strings.Chị Hạnh: “Bưu cục không bao giờ bắt tài: “The post office never makes drivers front the money. You did the right thing.”
strings.Ứng 80 xu cho nhanh, lời 40 xu mà: Just front the 80 coins to keep things moving, that's a 40-coin profit
strings.Shop chặn liên lạc, người nhận không có: The shop blocks you, and the recipient never existed. You lose all 80 coins.
strings.Bà Út nhờ mua giùm thuốc: Grandma Út asks you to pick up medicine
strings.Bà Út đứng đầu hẻm vẫy: “Cháu tiện đường: “On your way, could you pick up a pack of cough medicine for my husband, dear? I'll pay you for the trouble.”
strings.Ghé tiệm thuốc mua giùm bà: Stop by the pharmacy to buy it for her
strings.Cháu shipper tốt bụng, tiện đường mua th: The kind delivery driver picks up medicine for her along the way.
strings.Hẹn bà cuối ca ghé mua: Tell her you'll stop by at the end of your shift
strings.Bà Út gật gù: “Ừ, không gấp đâu, cuối ca: “Alright, no rush, just remember at the end of your shift.”
strings.Từ chối khéo vì đang chở đơn gấp: Politely decline since you're carrying a rush order
strings.Bà Út cười xòa: “Thôi cháu đi đi, để bà: “Alright, go on then, I'll ask someone else.”
strings.App báo pin yếu: 8%. Hết pin là không gọ: The app warns of low battery: 8%. Dead battery means no calling customers, no seeing orders.
strings.Ghé quán nước sạc nhờ 10 phút: Stop by a drink stall to charge for 10 minutes
strings.+10 phút, 2 xu ly trà đá: +10 minutes, 2 coins for an iced tea
Charge up while resting your legs, battery climbs to 40%.
strings.Mua sạc dự phòng ở tiệm điện thoại: Buy a power bank at the phone shop
strings.15 xu, không lo hết pin nữa: 15 coins, never worry about dying batteries again
strings.Có cục sạc dự phòng, từ nay yên tâm chạy: With a power bank now, you can ride the whole shift worry-free.
You get back with exactly 1% left, what a scare.
strings.Máy sập nguồn giữa đường, phải mượn điện: The phone dies mid-route, you have to borrow one to call the post office, losing 12 minutes.
strings.Chị Hạnh cần chạy gấp túi thuốc: Hạnh needs an urgent medicine run
strings.Bộ đàm rè rè: “Phòng khám cần gấp túi th: “The clinic urgently needs medicine for a feverish kid at the apartment building, can you run it for me? 15-coin bonus.”
strings.Túi thuốc tới tay mẹ bé kịp lúc. Chị Hạn: The medicine reaches the mom just in time. Hạnh writes your name on the praise board.
strings.Nhường đồng nghiệp vì đang có đơn sắp tr: Pass it to a coworker since you have an order about to run late
strings.Chị Hạnh: “Ok em, chị gọi Na.” Đơn của b: “Okay, I'll call Na.” Your order still makes it on time.
strings.Va quẹt nhẹ ở ngã tư: A minor collision at the intersection
strings.Một chiếc xe đạp điện lấn làn quẹt vào x: An e-bike swerves into your lane and clips your bike: your mirror snaps, their headlight shatters.
strings.Dừng lại hỏi han, chụp ảnh, mỗi bên tự l: Stop, check in, take photos, each side handles their own repairs
strings.Hai bên bình tĩnh nói chuyện, ai sửa xe: Both sides talk it out calmly, each fixes their own bike, they shake hands and go.
strings.Người kia cầm tiền đi luôn, dù lỗi chưa: The other person takes the money and leaves, even though the fault wasn't clearly yours.
strings.Chạy luôn cho kịp đơn: Ride off to make the order on time
strings.Không ai đuổi theo, nhưng áo đồng phục i: No one chases after you, but your uniform has the logo printed big and clear — you can't shake the unease.
strings.Shipper quẹt xe người ta rồi bỏ chạy!: Delivery driver clips someone's bike and flees the scene!
strings.Người ta chụp biển số gửi bưu cục. Bạn b: Someone photographs your plate and sends it to the post office. You're fined 25 coins and get a public complaint.
strings.Khách dọa 1 sao đòi miễn phí ship: Customer threatens 1 star to demand free shipping
strings.Anh Tùng nhắn: “Phí ship gì mà cao vậy?: “Why's the shipping fee so high? Waive it or I'll give you 1 star, just so you know.”
strings.Lễ phép giải thích phí do app tính, khôn: Politely explain the fee is set by the app, you can't discount it on your own
The driver explains clearly and politely. It's fine.
strings.Anh Tùng đọc lại bảng phí, thôi không dọ: Tùng reads the fee table again and drops the threat.
strings.Tự bù 8 xu phí ship cho khách vui: Cover the 8-coin shipping fee yourself to keep the customer happy
strings.Được 5 sao, nhưng tiền túi mình bay 8 xu: You get 5 stars, but 8 coins vanish from your own pocket — and the customer learns threats work.
strings.Cãi lại cho ra lẽ: Argue back to set things straight
Delivery driver argues head-to-head with a customer.
strings.Hai bên nhắn qua lại gay gắt, khách đánh: Both sides trade heated messages, and the customer really does give 1 star.
strings.Tin nhắn nhóm tài xế: “Cây xăng Gió Lộng: “Gió Lộng gas station is out of power until 6pm, pumps aren't working, heads up everyone!”
strings.Mua sẵn 20% xăng chai ven đường: Buy 20% worth of bottled gas roadside in advance
strings.Đổ sẵn 20% xăng chai, chạy yên tâm tới t: Fill up with 20% bottled gas in advance, ride worry-free till evening.
strings.Nhớ canh xăng: cây xăng chỉ bơm lại sau: Remember to watch the gas: the station only pumps again after 6pm.
strings.Chó dữ trước cổng: A fierce dog at the gate
strings.Con chó vện to đùng đứng chắn cổng, nhe: A huge brindle dog blocks the gate, baring its teeth and barking wildly, not letting anyone through.
strings.Đứng ngoài gọi khách ra giữ chó: Stand outside and call for the customer to hold the dog
strings.Khách chạy ra xích chó lại: “Xin lỗi nha: “Sorry about that, it looks fierce but it's actually gentle.”
strings.Mua cái bánh bao dỗ chó: Buy a steamed bun to win the dog over
The dog finishes eating and wags its tail out of the way.
strings.Chó ăn xong vẫn sủa, rốt cuộc vẫn phải g: The dog keeps barking even after eating, you still have to call the customer out.
strings.Liều dắt xe đi thẳng vào: Risk it and walk the bike straight in
The dog just barks after you, what a scare.
strings.Chó lao tới, bạn loạng choạng té xe, hàn: The dog lunges, you stumble and crash the bike, the goods scatter on the ground.
strings.Đơn thu hộ tới nơi: khách không bắt máy,: The COD order arrives: the customer won't answer, family says no one ordered it, won't accept.
strings.Chụp ảnh, ghi lý do lên app, hoàn hàng v: Take a photo, log the reason in the app, return the goods to the post office
strings.Làm đúng thủ tục hoàn. Shop bị bom nhưng: You follow the return procedure correctly. The shop got ghosted, but with photo proof, no one blames you.
strings.Khách đồng ý nhận vì được bớt — tiền bớt: The customer agrees to accept it after a discount — and the discount comes out of your own pocket.
strings.Đứng lì ép khách phải nhận: Stand your ground and force the customer to accept
strings.Khách miễn cưỡng ra nhận, mặt nặng mày n: The customer reluctantly comes out to accept it, scowling.
Delivery driver plants themselves at the door, forcing the delivery.
strings.Khách gọi tổng đài phàn nàn. Hàng vẫn ph: The customer calls the hotline to complain. The goods still get returned, and you lose the delivery fee too.
strings.Khách đổi địa chỉ phút chót: Customer changes address at the last minute
strings.Khách nhắn: “Mình mới chuyển chỗ, giao q: “I just moved, please deliver to my new address!”
strings.Cập nhật địa chỉ mới trên app, khách cảm: Update the new address on the app, the customer thanks you profusely.
strings.Hẹn khách ra lại địa chỉ cũ nhận hàng: Ask the customer to come back to the old address to receive it
The customer rides out to get it, a 10-minute wait.
strings.Khách không ra được, đành chạy qua địa c: The customer can't make it, so you end up riding to the new address with no extra fee.
strings.Từ chối, hoàn đơn về bưu cục: Refuse, return the order to the post office
The order gets returned, and the customer has to reorder from scratch.
strings.Bánh sau xẹp lép, xe lắc lư. Lốp mòn quá: The rear tire's completely flat, the bike's wobbling. The tire's worn through.
strings.Dắt bộ tới tiệm vá gần nhất: Walk the bike to the nearest repair shop
strings.Chú thợ vá ruột, bơm căng. Lốp tạm ổn, n: The mechanic patches the tube, pumps it up. The tire's fine for now, remember to get it serviced soon.
strings.Gọi thợ vá lưu động tới tận nơi: Call a mobile repairman to come to you
strings.Thợ tới nhanh, thay ruột mới. Tốn tiền n: The mechanic arrives fast, fits a new tube. Costs more, but keeps you on schedule.
strings.Chạy tiếp bánh xẹp cho kịp đơn: Keep riding on the flat to make the delivery
strings.Hư vành, hàng dễ vỡ bị xóc: Rim's damaged, fragile goods get jostled
strings.Xe cà giật suốt đoạn đường, vành móp — l: The bike judders the whole way, the rim bends — next maintenance will cost extra.
strings.Sên mòn chùng quá, tuột khỏi nhông. Xe đ: The chain is so worn and slack it came off the sprocket. The bike's stuck, the goods are still on it.
strings.Tự lắp sên lại bên lề: Put the chain back on yourself by the roadside

strings.Khơi rãnh cả chiều mệt nhưng sáng ra đất: Digging drainage all afternoon was exhausting, but the soil wasn't flooded come morning.
strings.Hái sạch cả vườn, kể cả trái xanh: Strip the whole garden clean, even the green fruit
strings.Không sợ bão nhưng nửa số trái xanh khôn: No fear of the storm, but half the green fruit never ripens and has to be tossed.
strings.Cà chua xanh thì bếp tôi không dùng được: My kitchen has no use for green tomatoes.
strings.Tin là bão đổi hướng, không làm gì: Trust the storm will change course, and do nothing
strings.Gió quật đổ giàn, cà chua rụng dập, luốn: Wind knocks down the trellis, tomatoes fall and bruise, the bed floods (30-coin loss).
A farmer who ignores the forecast is taking a reckless gamble.
strings.Trước thời tiết xấu: thu phần đủ điều ki: Ahead of bad weather: harvest what's ready, reinforce the rest, and sort out drainage.
strings.Mùa thu hoạch mà không thuê được người: Harvest season, and no help to be hired
strings.Ba luống chín cùng lúc, hai người làm th: Three beds ripen at once, and your two regular seasonal workers quit to go work at the industrial park.
strings.Khu công nghiệp trả lương tháng ổn định;: The industrial park pays a steady monthly wage; picking vegetables pays by the day, hit or miss.
strings.Khoa nông học cần chỗ thực tập, sinh viê: The agriculture department needs an internship placement, and the students want to really learn garden work.
strings.HTX có nhóm “đổi công”: hôm nay giúp vườ: The co-op has a “labor exchange” group: help this garden today, and that garden helps back tomorrow.
strings.Tham gia đổi công với HTX và nhận hai si: Join the co-op's labor exchange, and take on two supervised student interns, paid properly
strings.Rau được thu kịp; sinh viên học được các: The vegetables get harvested in time; the students learn how to grade produce and keep a farm log.
strings.Được làm thật, được trả công và được chỉ: Real work, fair pay, and real guidance.
Labor exchange is how our grandparents' generation always did it.
strings.Nhận sinh viên “thực tập” không trả công: Take on “interns” who work all day, unpaid
strings.Sinh viên nghỉ sau hai ngày, trường gạch: The students quit after two days, and the school strikes the farm off the internship list.
strings.Tụi em đi học chứ không phải làm không c: We came here to learn, not to work for free.
strings.Thực tập phải có người hướng dẫn và chế: An internship needs a supervisor and clear terms.
strings.Tự làm, bỏ bớt một luống: Do it alone, give up on one bed
strings.Kịp hai luống, luống thứ ba già quá lứa: You make it through two beds; the third goes overripe and has to be cleared for compost.
strings.Một người không thể làm việc của ba ngườ: One person can't do the work of three.
strings.Thiếu người mùa vụ: hợp tác, đổi công và: Short-staffed at harvest time: cooperate, exchange labor, and treat the people working alongside you fairly.
strings.Chú Tám mời nông trại vào HTX rau an toà: Uncle Tám invites the farm to join the safe-vegetable co-op: there's a supermarket contract, but you have to follow the shared process and keep a proper log.
strings.HTX mua chung hạt giống, phân bón giá sỉ: The co-op buys seeds and fertilizer together at wholesale prices; it has a stable supermarket outlet.
strings.Mỗi thành viên phải ghi nhật ký, chịu ki: Every member must keep a log and accept random inspections; a single violation costs the whole group the contract.
strings.Góp vốn 30 xu, trích 5% doanh thu qua HT: Contribute 30 coins in capital, plus 5% of revenue through the co-op into the shared fund.
strings.Tham gia, cam kết ghi nhật ký chuẩn và g: Join, commit to keeping a proper log, and contribute capital
strings.Nông trại có đầu ra ổn định; lần đầu đượ: The farm gets a stable outlet; on the supermarket's first inspection, the log is complete, so it passes.
One tree alone can't make a mountain.
strings.Chúng tôi cần nguồn hàng có hồ sơ, ổn đị: We need a supply source with documentation, stable all year round.
strings.Vào HTX nhưng tính “làm cho có”, không g: Join the co-op but just go through the motions, skip the logging
strings.Lần kiểm tra đầu tiên nông trại thiếu nh: On the first inspection the farm's missing its log, and the whole group gets a warning. Trust with the other members takes a hit.
One person cuts corners, and the whole group pays for it.
strings.Chưa vào, giữ bán lẻ tự do: Don't join, stay independent as a retail seller
strings.Tự do quyết giá, nhưng mùa rộ vẫn bị thư: Free to set your own prices, but still get squeezed by traders during peak season.
An independent farm is easy to buy cheap.
strings.Hợp tác xã mạnh khi từng thành viên giữ: A co-op is strong when every member holds to the shared process; benefits come with responsibility.
strings.Lớp của bé Mít tới tham quan: Little Mít's class comes to visit
strings.Cô giáo dẫn 20 bạn nhỏ lớp bé Mít tới th: The teacher brings 20 kids from Mít's class to tour the farm. Everyone wants to hug a chicken and pick tomatoes.
strings.Bạn là Mít: lần đầu thấy gà đẻ trứng, mu: You're Mít: seeing a chicken lay an egg for the first time, and wanting to hold the biggest hen.
strings.Tủ thuốc trừ sâu hóa học có khóa, nhưng: The chemical pesticide cabinet is locked, but bed 4 was just sprayed yesterday.
strings.Gà mái dễ hoảng khi bị rượt; trẻ cần rửa: Hens spook easily when chased; kids need to wash their hands after touching one.
strings.Đoàn ở 90 phút, các bạn thích được tự ta: The group's here for 90 minutes, and the kids love getting to do things themselves.
strings.Chia nhóm, rào luống vừa phun, cho các b: Split into groups, fence off the just-sprayed bed, let the kids sow seeds and collect eggs under supervision, then wash hands
strings.Con được tự gieo hạt rau muống và nhặt t: I got to sow water spinach seeds myself and collect eggs!!! Coolest farm ever 🐔✨
strings.Các bạn mang về chậu rau tự gieo. Phụ hu: The kids take home the pots they planted themselves. Parents send their thanks for keeping it safe and educational.
strings.Con biết trứng phải lau khô chứ không rử: I know you have to wipe eggs dry, not wash them with water!
strings.Chia nhóm, có rào chắn, có rửa tay — tôi: Groups, barriers, handwashing — I'm at ease.
Cluck cluck! Nobody chased us, thanks.
strings.Cho các bạn tự do chạy khắp vườn cho vui: Let the kids run wild around the garden for fun
strings.Vui nhưng một bạn chạy vào luống mới phu: Fun, but one kid runs into the freshly-sprayed bed, and the teacher panics.
strings.Một bạn giẫm vào luống vừa phun, phải rử: One kid steps into the just-sprayed bed, has to wash up and go home early. The chickens get spooked, so tomorrow's egg count is low.
A farm needs a safe zone marked out for children.
My friend got scolded, and the whole class went home early.
strings.Chỉ đứng giới thiệu, không cho các bạn c: Just stand and give a talk, don't let the kids touch anything
strings.An toàn nhưng tụi con chỉ đứng nghe thôi: Safe, but we just stood around listening — kind of boring 🥲
strings.Buổi tham quan an toàn nhưng các bạn nhỏ: The tour was safe, but the kids didn't come away remembering much.
strings.An toàn rồi, giá mà các con được làm thử: Safe, sure, but I wish the kids got to try things themselves.
strings.Đón trẻ em: an toàn trước (khu vực thuốc: Hosting children: safety first (chemical areas, hygiene), then let them experience things hands-on.
strings.Một con gà ủ rũ, bỏ ăn: A listless hen that won't eat
strings.Sáng nay một con gà mái đứng ủ rũ, xù lô: This morning one hen stands listless, feathers puffed up, not eating. Grandma Năm's waiting to pick up 30 eggs.
strings.Gà xù lông, mắt lim dim, phân loãng; các: Feathers puffed up, eyes half-closed, loose droppings; the other hens are eating normally.
strings.Cán bộ thú y xã có thể ghé khám trong bu: The commune vet can come examine it this afternoon (fee: 12 coins).
strings.Trứng của con gà bệnh nằm chung ổ với cá: The sick hen's eggs are in the same nest as the others.
strings.Cách ly con gà bệnh, gọi thú y, sát trùn: Isolate the sick hen, call the vet, disinfect the coop, and tell Grandma Năm the delivery will be a day late
strings.Giao trễ một ngày nhưng nói rõ lý do, tr: A day late, but with a clear reason, and clean eggs. That's fine.
strings.Thú y xác định gà bị tiêu chảy do thức ă: The vet determines the hen has diarrhea from damp feed; the whole flock recovers within three days.
A day late beats eggs that aren't clean.
strings.Cách ly sớm là cách tốt nhất để cả đàn k: Early isolation is the best way to keep the whole flock from getting infected.
strings.Cứ giao trứng như bình thường, chắc khôn: Just deliver the eggs as usual, probably fine
strings.Mấy quả trứng dính bẩn, lòng đỏ lạ. Tôi: Some of the eggs are dirty, the yolks look off. I'm not comfortable with this.
strings.Bệnh lan sang ba con khác, trứng giảm hẳ: The sickness spreads to three other hens, egg production drops for a week (20-coin loss).
strings.Làm bánh cho người ta ăn, tôi cần nguồn: I bake for people to eat — I need a clean source of eggs.
strings.Tự mua kháng sinh trộn vào cám cả đàn: Buy antibiotics yourself and mix them into the whole flock's feed
strings.Nghe nói gà đang uống thuốc, trứng có an: I heard the chickens are on medication — are the eggs still safe?
strings.Gà đỡ bệnh, nhưng trứng phải bỏ trong th: The hens improve, but the eggs have to be discarded during the drug withdrawal period; Grandma Năm sources eggs elsewhere for a few days.
strings.Dùng thuốc phải có chỉ định và tuân thủ: Medication requires a prescription, and you must follow the withdrawal period before selling eggs.
strings.Vật nuôi bệnh: cách ly, hỏi thú y, sát t: A sick animal: isolate it, consult the vet, disinfect — and be honest with customers about any affected orders.
strings.Trạm bơm HTX cúp nước: The co-op's pump station loses water
strings.Chú Tám gọi: “Trạm bơm cháy mô-tơ rồi co: “The pump's motor burned out, there's no water for the whole-garden irrigation valve today. What do you want to do?”
Every bed gets +20% moisture right away.
strings.Xe bồn xả nước vào bể, cả vườn được một: The tanker fills the tank, and the whole garden gets a good soaking.
strings.Gánh nước giếng tưới từng luống: Carry well water to each bed by hand
strings.Mỏi vai, khách chờ lâu hơn; tưới từng lu: Sore shoulders, customers wait longer; but each bed still gets watered.
strings.Vai mỏi nhừ, nhưng luống nào khô cũng sẽ: Your shoulders ache, but every dry bed gets its well water.
strings.Chờ sửa bơm, để đất tự lo: Wait for the pump to get fixed, let the soil fend for itself
The sun dries out the moisture, and a few beds start wilting.
strings.Trời tối sầm, loa xã báo giông lốc trong: The sky goes dark, the ward loudspeaker warns of a storm within the hour. The tall tomato and cucumber trellises are the most likely to fall.
strings.Chằng cọc, căng lưới chắn gió: Stake the poles, stretch windbreak netting
Costs money for netting and labor, but the trellis holds.
strings.Giông qua, giàn vẫn đứng vững; chỉ rách: The storm passes, the trellis stays standing; only a few leaves get torn.
strings.Khơi rãnh sẵn, chấp nhận giàn nghiêng: Dig drainage trenches in advance, accept the trellis leaning
strings.Rãnh thoát nước kịp khơi xong trước cơn: The drainage trench gets dug just in time before the storm hits.
strings.Mặc kệ, chắc giông tạt qua thôi: Ignore it, the storm will probably just pass by
strings.Giông tạt qua xã bên. Hú hồn!: The storm veers off to the next ward over. What a relief!
The storm slams straight through the garden.
strings.Sâu khoang bùng phát khắp xóm: Armyworms break out across the hamlet
strings.Chú Tám: “Mấy vườn quanh đây sâu khoang: “Armyworms are hatching all over the gardens around here, last night moths swarmed the lights in droves. Ours is probably next.”
strings.Treo bẫy đèn, bẫy pheromone quanh vườn: Hang light traps and pheromone traps around the garden
Stop the moths from laying eggs in the first place.
strings.Bẫy bắt được cả đàn bướm, sâu non không: The traps catch a whole swarm of moths, the larvae never get a chance to hatch.
strings.Thăm từng luống, sâu tới đâu xử lý tới đ: Check each bed, deal with the worms as you find them
No coins spent, but you have to walk the fields.
The worms have already gotten into the garden.
strings.Phun thuốc hóa học ngừa cả vườn cho chắc: Spray chemical pesticide over the whole garden to be safe
strings.Sạch sâu, nhưng mất chuẩn hữu cơ và phải: Clears the worms, but breaks organic certification and requires a withholding period.
The whole garden's clear of worms.
strings.Hai cán bộ chứng nhận hữu cơ tới không b: “Show us your cultivation log and cold room.”
strings.Mở sổ nhật ký, dẫn đoàn đi xem kho mát: Open the log book, lead them to the cold room
strings.Kho còn lô chưa hết cách ly là bị lập bi: If the cold room has a batch still under withholding, it gets written up.
They cross-check the log against each bed.
strings.Xin hẹn hôm khác vì đang bận giao hàng: Ask to reschedule since you're busy with deliveries
strings.Nông trại xin hoãn kiểm tra. Hữu cơ thật: The farm asks to postpone the inspection. If it's truly organic, just open the door for the check.
strings.Đoàn ghi “cơ sở xin hoãn” và sẽ quay lại: They note “the farm requested a postponement” and will return unannounced.
strings.Dúi phong bì “bồi dưỡng” cho đoàn: Slip the team a “token of appreciation” envelope
strings.Nông trại đưa phong bì cho đoàn kiểm tra: The farm hands an envelope to the inspection team. Who'd trust an organic label earned like that.
strings.Đoàn trả lại phong bì, lập biên bản hành: The team returns the envelope, files a report for the bribery attempt, and schedules a re-inspection.
strings.Đoàn chứng nhận hữu cơ quay lại như đã h: “This time, please open the log book and the cold room.”
strings.Mở sổ, dẫn đoàn đi xem kho mát: Open the log book, lead them to the cold room
strings.Từ chối kiểm tra hai lần. Tạm treo giấy: Refused the inspection twice. The organic certification is suspended.
The team files a report for refusing inspection.
strings.HTX cần hàng gấp cho siêu thị: The co-op urgently needs stock for a supermarket
strings.Chú Tám gọi: “Siêu thị đặt gấp một lô ra: “A supermarket placed a rush order for grade-A produce, the co-op's short. Chip in a share from the farm before you close the day.”
strings.Đã hứa với HTX. Vào tab 📈 Chợ để giao ph: You've promised the co-op. Go to the 📈 Market tab to deliver the contribution before closing the day.
strings.Nhận một nửa cho chắc: Take on half to be safe
strings.Đã hứa góp một nửa. Vào tab 📈 Chợ để gia: You've promised half a share. Go to the 📈 Market tab to deliver it before closing the day.
Uncle Tám calls another farm instead.
strings.Chồn mò vào chuồng gà: A weasel sneaks into the henhouse
strings.Sáng ra thấy lông gà vương vãi, lưới chu: You wake up to feathers scattered everywhere and a big hole chewed through the coop netting. The weasel's sure to come back tonight.
strings.Vá lưới, gắn đèn cảm biến: Patch the netting, install a motion-sensor light
Solid and reliable for the long run.
strings.Đêm đó chồn lảng vảng rồi bỏ đi. Chuồng: That night the weasel lurks around, then gives up and leaves. The coop's secure now.
strings.Đặt lồng bẫy mồi trứng: Set a cage trap baited with an egg
strings.Bẫy được con chồn, nhờ kiểm lâm thả về r: Traps the weasel, and forest rangers release it far away.
The weasel eats the bait, then slips back through the old hole.
strings.Để tối rồi tính: Wait until tonight to deal with it
The weasel really does come back that night.
strings.Ba con dê nhà ông Sáu phá rào, đang gặm: Mr. Sáu's three goats break through the fence and are happily munching your leafy greens!
strings.Lùa dê về, nhờ ông Sáu sửa chuồng: Herd the goats back, ask Mr. Sáu to fix the pen
Takes a bit of time, but keeps the peace.
strings.Ông Sáu rối rít xin lỗi, gửi 6 xu tiền r: Mr. Sáu apologizes profusely, hands over 6 coins for the greens.
strings.Giữ dê lại, đòi đền cho đủ: Hold the goats and demand full compensation
Mr. Sáu pays up fairly, 15 coins.
strings.Hàng xóm với nhau mà giữ dê đòi tiền, că: Holding a neighbor's goats hostage for money — that's pretty tense.
strings.Hai nhà to tiếng, ông Sáu không đền đồng: Both households end up shouting, and Mr. Sáu doesn't pay a single coin.
strings.Dê hoảng, chạy loạn khắp vườn rồi mới ch: The goats panic and bolt all over the garden before finally getting out.
strings.Một người chạy xe máy chở bao hạt giống:: A man rides up on a motorbike with sacks of seeds: “Super-fast F1 hybrid water spinach, just 2 coins a pack, 3 coins at the store!” The packaging has no label, no date.
strings.Hạt lép, gieo thử không lên cây nào. Mất: The seeds are hollow, not a single one sprouts when you try planting. Lost money and effort both.
strings.Gọi hỏi chú Tám trước: Call and ask Uncle Tám first
strings.Chú Tám: “Giống không nhãn mác là giống: “Unlabeled seeds are unregulated stock, don't fall for the cheap price.” The seller hurries off.
The seller moves on to another farm.
strings.Mới 10 giờ, nhiệt kế ngoài hiên đã chỉ 3: It's only 10am and the porch thermometer already reads 38°C. The leaves are starting to droop.
It's noticeably cooler under the netting, and the plants perk back up.
strings.Tưới đẫm cả vườn ngay: Give the whole garden a thorough soaking right away
The soil's soaked through, though the midday sun still dries some of it up.
strings.Để vậy, chiều tưới bù: Leave it be, water extra in the afternoon
The plants stay wilted until the afternoon, growth stalls.
strings.Người nuôi ong xin đặt thùng: A beekeeper asks to place his hives
strings.Anh Lâm nuôi ong xin đặt năm thùng ong c: Lâm, a beekeeper, asks to set up five hives next to the garden for two days: “The bees pollinate the tomatoes and cucumbers so they fruit better. Just please don't spray chemical pesticide.”
strings.Đồng ý, hứa không phun thuốc hóa học: Agree, promise not to spray chemical pesticide
Bees buzz gently around the garden.
strings.Đồng ý nếu anh trả 6 xu tiền đất: Agree if he pays 6 coins for the land
Lâm hesitates a bit, then pays it anyway.
strings.Từ chối, vườn còn cần phun thuốc: Decline, the garden still needs spraying
Lâm carts the hives over to the next hill.
strings.Thương lái hỏi mua sạch kho mát: A trader wants to buy out the cold room
strings.Anh Tuấn: “Rau trong kho mát em có bao n: “Whatever produce you've got in the cold room, I'll take it all, cash on the spot!”
55% of retail market price, the cold room's cleared out right away.
Tuấn hauls the produce onto his truck.
Tuấn scratches his head, then nods in agreement.
strings.Anh Tuấn lắc đầu: “Chỗ khác bán rẻ hơn.”: “Somewhere else sells it cheaper.” then drives off.
strings.Giữ hàng cho khách quen: Keep the stock for regular customers
Tuấn drives off to the next farm.
strings.Đền thùng ong chết vì thuốc: Compensate for the hives killed by pesticide
strings.Đã hứa với người nuôi ong mà vẫn phun th: You promised the beekeeper but sprayed chemical pesticide anyway, and the whole colony dies. Farming means keeping your word.
strings.Nộp phạt theo biên bản: Pay the fine per the report
Lucky the garden has no tall trellises.
The soil's soaked through, watch out for waterlogging.
strings.Vườn chưa có cây lớn, sâu chưa có gì để: The garden has no mature plants yet, the worms have nothing to eat.
strings.Phạt vi phạm thời gian cách ly: Fined for violating the withholding period
strings.Đoàn kiểm tra lập biên bản: có lô thu ho: The inspection team files a report: a batch was harvested before the pesticide withholding period was over.
strings.Hỗ trợ nông trại đạt kiểm tra hữu cơ: Support given for passing the organic inspection
strings.Đoàn kiểm tra khen: nhật ký khớp từng lu: The inspection team praises the farm: the log matches every bed, the cold room's spotless.
strings.Nhật ký khớp từng luống, kho mát sạch: đ: The log matches every bed, the cold room's clean: the team praises you and grants 12 coins in support.
strings.Phần góp trước còn chưa xong nên HTX khô: The earlier contribution still isn't finished, so the co-op won't hand over anything more.
Lost half a clutch of eggs.
Lucky the garden has no leafy greens to chew on.
strings.gặm và giẫm nát cả mảng: chew through and trample a whole patch
strings.Vườn chưa có cà chua, dưa leo nên ong ch: The garden has no tomatoes or cucumbers yet, so the bees just drop by to visit.
strings.Kho mát chẳng còn rau, anh Tuấn đi tay k: The cold room's got no produce left, Tuấn leaves empty-handed.
strings.Đất ẩm vừa tay. Rau hái đúng lứa. Nhãn n: Soil moist just right. Vegetables picked at the right time. Labels that tell the truth.
strings.Xem thời tiết, tưới đúng lúc, thu hoạch: Check the weather, water at the right time, harvest at the right ripeness, feed the chickens — then box up the orders with honest labels.
strings.Sáu luống rau, mười con gà, một cuốn nhậ: Six vegetable beds, ten chickens, one farm log
strings.Tay to, tưới đều, nhìn đất là biết khô h: Big hands, waters evenly, can tell dry from wet soil at a glance.
strings.Gà nghe tiếng là chạy lại, nhặt trứng kh: The chickens come running at the sound of her voice, and she never breaks an egg collecting them.
Weeds fast as the wind, though a bit careless.
Washes, sorts, and lines the boxes neatly.
