strings.Nhận lại tiền, nhưng sinh nhật mẹ tôi kh: I get my money back, but my mom's birthday has no flowers.
strings.Tiền hoàn đủ; mẹ chị Hạnh thổi nến mà kh: The refund is full; but Ms. Hạnh's mom blows out her candles with no bouquet from her daughter.
Money isn't what I needed tonight.
strings.Giao sai thì sửa cho người nhận trước, r: When a delivery goes wrong, fix it for the recipient first, then fix the process: call to confirm the address one last time before heading out.
strings.Giá sỉ tăng gấp ba trước 20/10: Wholesale prices triple before Vietnamese Women's Day
strings.Tuần lễ 20/10, chợ hoa sỉ Bến Mây báo hồ: In the run-up to Vietnamese Women's Day, the Bến Mây wholesale flower market announces red roses jumping from 5 to 15 coins a stem. Linh drops by to ask: “Why was a rose bouquet 100 coins last week, and now it's 180?”
strings.Hồng đỏ 5 → 15 xu/cành, hồng phấn 4 → 11: Red roses 5 → 15 coins/stem, pink roses 4 → 11 coins; carnations and daisies hold nearly steady.
strings.12 đơn 20/10 đã đặt từ tuần trước với bá: 12 orders for the holiday were placed last week at the old quote, mostly from students.
strings.Bó cẩm chướng + baby đẹp, ý nghĩa biết ơ: A carnation + baby's breath bouquet looks lovely, means gratitude, and its price has barely moved.
strings.Giữ giá cũ cho đơn đặt trước; đơn mới bá: Honor the old price for pre-orders; quote new orders at the wholesale price with an explanation, and suggest the cheaper carnation bouquet
strings.Chị giải thích rõ vì sao hồng lên giá, c: She explained clearly why roses went up, and even pointed me to a pretty carnation bouquet that fit my budget. Pre-orders kept the old price too. Trustworthy!
strings.Đơn cũ giữ lời hứa; khách mới hiểu lý do: Old orders keep their promised price; new customers understand the reason, and many choose the carnation bouquet. Holiday profit falls short of the dream, but customers come back.
strings.Được giải thích và có lựa chọn vừa túi t: With an explanation and an affordable option, I'm happy to buy.
strings.Mùa lễ bên tôi cũng bị nhà vườn tăng giá: My growers raise prices during holiday season too — it's right for the shop to be upfront with customers.
strings.Cẩm chướng cắm lên xinh lắm, mà không ai: Carnations look lovely arranged, and nobody has to pay a “holiday” markup.
strings.Nhân dịp tăng giá gấp năm, ai hỏi cũng n: Use the occasion to hike prices fivefold, and tell everyone who asks that “the old price is sold out”
strings.Tiệm đẩy giá gấp năm lần ngày lễ, còn bả: The shop jacks up prices fivefold for the holiday, and claims pre-orders are out of stock. A total rip-off.
strings.Doanh thu tuần lễ cao vọt, nhưng nhóm si: Holiday-week revenue spikes, but the student group posts a warning online, and business dries up right after the holiday.
strings.Em đặt từ tuần trước mà giờ bị báo hết g: I ordered last week, and now I'm told the old price is sold out?
Gouge customers for one season, and you lose the whole year.
strings.Báo khách đặt trước phải bù thêm tiền, k: Tell pre-order customers they have to pay extra, or their order gets cancelled
strings.Đặt trước để chắc giá, cuối cùng bị đòi: Pre-ordered to lock in the price, and ends up being asked for more money right before the day.
strings.Một nửa đơn đặt trước bị hủy, học sinh p: Half the pre-orders get cancelled, and students have to scramble to buy elsewhere right before the holiday.
We only pre-ordered because we trusted the quoted price.
strings.Giá tăng là thật, nhưng hợp đồng đã chốt: The price hike is real, but once a deal's locked in, you honor it.
strings.Giữ giá cũ cho tất cả mọi đơn, tiệm chịu: Keep the old price for every single order, and take the loss
strings.Giá không đổi dù ngày lễ, tuyệt vời!: Same price even on the holiday, amazing!
strings.Khách rất vui, nhưng tiệm lỗ cả mùa lễ v: Customers are thrilled, but the shop loses money the whole holiday season and has to delay paying the wholesale market.
Didn't raise prices at all, way too generous.
strings.Tháng này tiền nhập vượt tiền bán; lương: This month, purchasing costs outstrip sales; staff wages have to be pushed back a few days.
strings.Giá theo mùa là thật; giữ lời hứa với đơ: Seasonal pricing is real; honoring old promises while being transparent about new ones — that's what's fair.
strings.Người nhận nuôi mèo, khách muốn hoa ly: The recipient has a cat, but the customer wants lilies
strings.Chú Phúc chọn bó ly trắng thật thơm tặng: Uncle Phúc picks a fragrant white lily bouquet for his daughter, who just moved into a new place. He mentions: “She's got two cats that love jumping on the table.”
strings.Mọi phần của cây ly — phấn hoa, lá, cánh: Every part of a lily — pollen, leaves, petals, even the water in the vase — is highly toxic to cats and can cause serious kidney damage.
strings.Hai bé mèo hay nhảy lên bàn, gặm lá cây: The two cats love jumping on tables and nibbling on houseplants.
strings.Hồng và hướng dương an toàn hơn cho nhà: Roses and sunflowers are safer for homes with cats; eucalyptus and baby's breath should also be avoided since cats chewing on them can get an upset stomach.
strings.Giải thích hoa ly độc với mèo, đề xuất b: Explain that lilies are toxic to cats, suggest a white rose–sunflower bouquet instead, and drop the eucalyptus and baby's breath
strings.Suýt nữa tặng con một bó hoa nguy hiểm c: Almost gave my daughter a bouquet dangerous to her cats. The shop's advice was so thoughtful, and the rose–sunflower bouquet turned out even lovelier.
strings.Chú Phúc đổi sang bó hồng trắng – hướng: Uncle Phúc switches to the white rose–sunflower bouquet. His daughter sends a photo of the two cats lying right next to the vase.
strings.Chú đâu biết hoa ly độc vậy. Cảm ơn tiệm: I had no idea lilies were that toxic. Thanks to the shop for the heads-up.
strings.Mèo nhà em mà gặm phải ly là phải đi cấp: If my cats had gotten into lilies, it would've been an emergency vet trip. Dad picked exactly the right bouquet.
strings.Vẫn bán ly nhưng tỉa hết nhụy phấn cho “: Still sell the lilies, just trim off the pollen stamens for “safety”
strings.Hoa đẹp, tiệm có tỉa nhụy. Sau mới biết: The flowers are lovely, and the shop trimmed the stamens. Only later did I learn the leaves and vase water are toxic too.
strings.Con gái chú Phúc đọc được thông tin, phả: Uncle Phúc's daughter reads up on it and has to move the lily bouquet out to the balcony that very night.
strings.Tỉa nhụy chưa đủ, cả cây đều độc với mèo: Trimming the stamens isn't enough — the whole plant is toxic to cats.
I thought the shop had it all covered.
strings.Khách muốn gì bán nấy, không nói thêm: Sell whatever the customer wants, no extra comments
strings.Bó ly được đặt trên bàn. May mà con gái: The lily bouquet sits on the table. Luckily his daughter catches it in time, just as the cat starts nibbling the leaves.
Nobody said a single word to me about the cats.
I knew and didn't say anything — that's on me.
strings.Tư vấn hoa là tư vấn cả an toàn: hoa ly: Flower advice includes safety advice: lilies are highly toxic to cats, pollen and vase water included.
strings.Kệ hoa viếng gấp, băng rôn in sai: Rush funeral stand, banner printed wrong
strings.6 giờ 30 sáng, kệ hoa viếng đã lên xe th: At 6:30 AM, the funeral stand is already loaded onto the bike when Khánh notices the banner reads “The late Mr. Nguyễn Văn Tư,” while the obituary says “The late Mrs. Nguyễn Thị Tư.” The visitation starts at 8.
strings.Cáo phó ghi: “Cụ bà Nguyễn Thị Tư, hưởng: The obituary reads: “The late Mrs. Nguyễn Thị Tư, age 88.”
strings.Cô Lụa đặt đúng “Cụ bà”. Lỗi do tiệm gõ: Ms. Lụa ordered it correctly as “Mrs.” The mistake happened when the shop mistyped it printing the banner.
strings.In lại mất khoảng 15 phút; tiệm còn cuộn: Reprinting takes about 15 minutes; the shop still has a roll of blank banner.
strings.Cho xe quay lại, in lại băng rôn đúng, g: Send the bike back, reprint the correct banner, deliver before 7:30; call Ms. Lụa to explain and apologize
strings.Tiệm tự phát hiện, tự sửa và gọi báo tôi: The shop caught it themselves, fixed it, and called to tell me before I even found out. The stand looks solemn, with the right name.
strings.Kệ hoa tới lúc 7 giờ 20 với băng rôn đún: The stand arrives at 7:20 with the correct banner. The family never even knows there was a mistake.
strings.Chuyện hiếu thì một chữ cũng không được: For a funeral, not even one word can be wrong. The shop put my mind at ease.
strings.Kệ hoa của tổ dân phố đặt ngay lối vào,: The neighborhood group's flower stand sits right at the entrance, with my mother's name correct.
strings.May là đọc lại băng rôn trước khi đi. Từ: Lucky I proofread the banner before heading out. From now on, that's a mandatory step.
strings.Dán đè chữ “ông” bằng băng keo trắng rồi: Cover the word “Mr.” with white tape and handwrite “Mrs.” over it
strings.Kệ hoa đến đúng giờ, nhưng băng rôn chắp: The stand arrives on time, but the banner looks patched up. Everyone at the funeral home can see it.
strings.Kệ hoa tới đúng giờ nhưng miếng băng keo: The stand arrives on time, but the tape patch is obvious. Ms. Lụa has to explain it to the family.
Seeing my mother's name patched over just adds to the weight in my chest.
strings.Tôi đại diện cả tổ dân phố mà tới viếng: I'm representing the whole neighborhood group, and I show up with a patched-together banner.
strings.Giao luôn, chắc không ai để ý: Just deliver it as is, probably nobody will notice
strings.Băng rôn ghi sai giới tính người mất. Gi: The banner gets the deceased's gender wrong. The family is deeply hurt. Unacceptable.
strings.Con cháu cụ nhìn thấy ngay. Cô Lụa phải: Her children and grandchildren spot it immediately. Ms. Lụa has to take the banner down in the middle of the visitation and apologize to the family.
She's already gone, and now her name's been gotten wrong too.
I've lost face in front of the whole alley.
strings.Gọi cô Lụa nói phiếu đặt viết không rõ: Call Ms. Lụa and say her order slip wasn't written clearly
strings.Phiếu tôi ghi rõ ràng mà tiệm còn đổ lỗi: My slip was written clearly, and now the shop's blaming me, right in the middle of our grief.
strings.Cô Lụa chụp phiếu đặt gửi lại. Kệ hoa vẫ: Ms. Lụa photographs the order slip and sends it back. The banner still has to be reprinted, delaying the visitation.
And here we are arguing over an order slip at a time like this.
strings.Mất 20 phút gọi điện qua lại, lẽ ra đã i: 20 minutes wasted on back-and-forth calls, when it could've already been reprinted.
strings.Với tang lễ, một chữ sai là nỗi đau của: At a funeral, one wrong word becomes pain for the whole family: stop, fix it properly, and own the mistake.
strings.Cô dâu đổi màu hoa trước một ngày: The bride changes the flower color one day before
strings.Linh gọi: “Chị em đổi ý rồi! Mai cưới mà: Linh calls: “My sister changed her mind! The wedding's tomorrow, and now she wants everything switched from white-and-pink to wine red — the bouquet and all 8 boutonnieres.”
strings.Hợp đồng chốt tông trắng – hồng, đã cọc: The contract locked in white-and-pink, 50% deposit paid; terms: design changes before 48 hours are free, after that the actual extra cost applies.
strings.Có 20 hồng đỏ thường; hồng đỏ rượu vang: There are 20 regular red roses on hand; wine-red roses would need a rush order from Mây Xanh Express, 35% more expensive.
strings.Làm lại toàn bộ mất khoảng 5 tiếng tối n: Redoing everything would take about 5 hours tonight; Yến can stay to help.
strings.Gọi lại đưa hai phương án: giữ trắng – h: Call back with two options: keep white-and-pink with red accents from the roses on hand (no extra charge), or switch everything to wine red with a clearly stated rush fee
strings.Tiệm đưa lựa chọn rõ ràng, phụ phí minh: The shop gave clear options and a transparent fee. My sister chose the full switch, and the wedding flowers turned out gorgeous!
The bride chooses the full switch and pays the fee. Nhung and Yến work until 11 PM; the next morning the flowers go out on time.
strings.Chị em được chọn, biết trước chi phí, kh: My sister got to choose, knew the cost upfront, and nobody was put in an awkward spot.
strings.Tăng ca có phụ phí thì tụi em làm vui vẻ: Overtime with a fee attached, and we're happy to do it.
strings.Đơn gấp nhưng rõ ràng, giao lúc 7 giờ tố: A rush order, but a clear one — delivered at 7 PM.
strings.Đồng ý hết, không thu thêm, cả tiệm thức: Agree to everything, charge nothing extra, and the whole shop pulls an all-nighter
strings.Tiệm chiều hết cỡ, không lấy thêm đồng n: The shop went all out for me and didn't charge a single extra coin. So touched!
strings.Hoa cưới đẹp, cô dâu vui; tiệm lỗ đơn nà: The wedding flowers are beautiful and the bride's happy; but the shop loses money on this order, and the staff are exhausted all the next day.
The shop is way too kind.
strings.Thức trắng không phụ phí, mai em xin ngh: Pulled an all-nighter for no extra pay — I'm taking tomorrow off.
strings.Từ chối vì hợp đồng đã chốt: Refuse, since the contract's already locked in
strings.Đúng hợp đồng nhưng không một lời gợi ý: Technically per the contract, but not a single suggestion offered. A bit rigid.
strings.Cô dâu dùng tông cũ nhưng không vui; Lin: The bride sticks with the old color scheme but isn't happy about it; Linh tells the whole friend group about it.
strings.Biết là đổi trễ, nhưng ít nhất cũng cho: I know it's a late change, but you could've at least given me an option.
Adding a few red accents would've been doable, though.
strings.Nhận lời cho qua, nhưng vẫn làm tông cũ: Agree just to smooth things over, but still deliver the old color scheme since there's no time
strings.Nhận lời đổi màu rồi giao y như cũ. Ngày: Agree to change the color, then deliver the exact same thing. Tricked, on her wedding day.
strings.Cô dâu mở hộp hoa trong phòng trang điểm: The bride opens the flower box in the dressing room and bursts into tears. Linh's friend group never comes back.
strings.Không làm được thì nói, sao lại hứa?: If you couldn't do it, why promise it at all?
I was made to do something I knew was wrong.
strings.Thay đổi phút chót: nói rõ điều làm được: For last-minute changes: state clearly what's possible and the real cost, and let the customer choose — never make an empty promise.
strings.Khách đòi trả bó hoa héo sau 5 ngày: A customer wants to return a bouquet that wilted after 5 days
strings.Bà Tám mang bó hồng đã rũ tới quầy: “Mua: Grandma Tám brings a wilted rose bouquet to the counter: “Only five days and it's all drooping! You sold me old flowers, didn't you?”
strings.Bó hồng bán 5 ngày trước, dùng lô hồng n: The bouquet was sold 5 days ago, made from a batch of roses that had arrived 2 days earlier — at the time of sale, only about 2 days of freshness were left.
strings.Bình để cạnh cửa sổ nắng, nước đục, gốc: The vase sits by a sunny window, the water's cloudy, and the stems have never been retrimmed.
strings.Tiệm có kèm thẻ: thay nước mỗi ngày, cắt: The shop includes a card: change the water daily, retrim the stems, avoid harsh sunlight.
strings.Nhận phần lỗi về lô hoa hơi cũ, tặng vou: Own up to the batch being a bit old, offer a 50%-off voucher for her next bouquet, walk her through proper care again; change the process: only use batches with ≥ 3 days of freshness for gift bouquets
strings.Tiệm nhận phần lỗi của tiệm, còn chỉ bà: The shop owned their part of the mistake, and even showed me how to care for flowers properly. Fair enough — I'll be back.
strings.Bà Tám cầm voucher, dặn “lần sau lấy hoa: Grandma Tám takes the voucher, saying, “get me fresh flowers next time.” The shop posts a rule about picking fresh batches for gift orders.
strings.Bà cũng có lỗi để nắng, nhưng tiệm chịu: She's partly at fault for the sunlight too, but the shop owned its share — that's fair enough.
strings.Từ giờ em dán ngày nhập lên từng xô cho: From now on I'll label each bucket with the intake date to make it easier to pick the right batch.
strings.Hoàn tiền toàn bộ cho êm chuyện: Refund it all in full, just to smooth things over
strings.Bà Tám về vui, nhưng cách chăm hoa và cá: Grandma Tám leaves happy, but the shop's flower care and batch-selection habits stay exactly the same.
Getting the money back is fine — I'll worry about next time later.
The exact same thing could easily happen again.
strings.Từ chối: “Hoa tươi chỉ giữ 3–5 ngày, bà: Refuse: “Fresh flowers only last 3–5 days — leaving them in the sun is your own fault”
strings.Bán hoa gần hết hạn rồi đổ hết lỗi cho k: Sell flowers that were nearly past their prime, then dump all the blame on the customer.
strings.Bà Tám kể với cả xóm; vài người để ý tiệ: Grandma Tám tells the whole neighborhood; a few people start noticing the shop often sells older batches.
strings.Bà lớn tuổi chứ không lẫn. Hoa cũ bà nhì: I may be old, but I'm not senile. I can tell old flowers just by looking.
Truth is, that batch's petals were already a bit soft the day it was sold.
strings.Hoa là hàng sống: bán lô tươi nhất cho đ: Flowers are perishable goods: sell the freshest batch for gift orders, include care instructions — and share responsibility fairly when a complaint comes up.
Every bouquet tells exactly one story.
strings.Hỏi dịp tặng và hỏi thêm điều khách chưa: Ask about the occasion and draw out what the customer hasn't said, pick flowers that fit the meaning, prep the stems, bundle – wrap – write the card, and deliver on time.
strings.Hoa tươi, lời thật, giao đúng hẹn: Fresh flowers, honest words, delivered on time
Spiral-ties with a steady hand, a sharp eye for color.
Trims stems and strips leaves fast as a machine.
strings.Thuộc từng con hẻm, luôn gọi xác nhận tr: Knows every alley by heart, always calls to confirm before delivering.
strings.Chậm mà chắc, cắm kệ viếng rất trang ngh: Slow but sure, arranges funeral stands with real solemnity.
strings.Anh Minh ghé tiệm ba lần chỉ để hỏi “9 b: Minh visits the shop three times just to ask, “Which means more, 9 flowers or 11?” He's so nervous he even drops his wallet.
strings.Bạn cùng anh chọn 9 hồng đỏ, viết nháp l: You help him pick 9 red roses, draft the card message together, and even practice how he should hold the bouquet so it doesn't cover his face.
strings.Tối đó anh gửi tiệm tấm ảnh chiếc nhẫn t: That night he sends the shop a photo of the ring on her hand, with the words: “She said yes!”
strings.Chị Hạnh kể mẹ chị từng suýt mất một bé: Ms. Hạnh tells you her mom nearly lost a cat once from it chewing on an unfamiliar plant. Ever since, she's been afraid to give her mom flowers.
strings.Bạn lập cho chị một danh sách “hoa an to: You put together a “cat-safe flowers” list for her and post it right at the counter.
strings.Mẹ chị Hạnh ghé tiệm lần đầu, mang theo: Ms. Hạnh's mom visits the shop for the first time, bringing a photo of all three cats lying next to a vase of roses — none the worse for it.
strings.Cô Lụa lo việc hiếu hỉ cho cả hẻm, muốn: Ms. Lụa handles weddings and funerals for the whole alley, and wants a solemn funeral stand that fits the neighborhood fund's budget.
strings.Bạn cùng cô chọn cúc trắng, ly trắng và: You and she pick white chrysanthemums, white lilies, and proofread the banner three times before printing.
strings.Tổ dân phố giao tiệm làm hoa cho mọi việ: The neighborhood group now entrusts the shop with flowers for every wedding and funeral all year, with one instruction: “Just get every word right, like that time.”
strings.Hoa tươi rói, cắm bình ba ngày vẫn căng: Flowers so fresh, three days in a vase and the petals are still full 🌸
strings.Thiệp viết đúng điều mình muốn nói mà kh: The card said exactly what I wanted to say but couldn't put into words.
strings.Người nhận hỏi tên tiệm ngay khi mở giấy: The recipient asked for the shop's name the moment she unwrapped it.
strings.Giao đúng giờ, người nhận cười tít mắt!: Delivered right on time, and the recipient's eyes crinkled with a huge smile!

strings.Báo giá vừa phải (bớt nhiều thì dễ chốt: Quote a reasonable price (a bigger discount closes the deal faster but thins the margin) → take a deposit → check Stock & prices, restock if short (rush delivery arrives instantly) → pack and deliver before closing the shift.
strings.Đọc hạn từng lô → rút lô quá hạn/hết hạn: Check each batch's expiry → pull anything expired or expiring today → put discount stickers on batches with 1–2 days left → put near-expiry batches up front → check the price tags match → report done.
strings.Quét hàng cái → cân hàng ký (đúng PLU, t: Scan piece goods → weigh bulk items (right PLU, subtract the customer's basket weight) → apply promotions → check age if there's beer → finalize the bill → check the bill/verify the banking app/check the debt ledger → give correct change → hand it over.
strings.Hàng quá hạn hoặc hết hạn hôm nay: RÚT k: Items past date or expiring today: PULL them from the shelf, log the loss.
strings.Hạn gần xếp phía trước, hàng mới nhập xế: Near-expiry stock goes up front, newly arrived stock goes in back (FIFO).
Price tags must match the current price list.
Total debt must not exceed each person's limit.
strings.Nhắc nợ nhẹ nhàng, riêng tư, mỗi ngày tố: Remind about debt gently and privately, at most once a day.
strings.Lòng tin quyết định hạn mức: trả đúng hẹ: Trust sets the credit limit: paying on time raises it; letting debts go overdue or chasing people when they're struggling lowers it.
strings.Hàng mới nhập xếp lên trước hàng cũ thì: Put new stock in front of old and customers take the new, leaving the old lot to expire: remember to rotate the shelf.
strings.Giỏ quen: xem trước một ngày để nhập đủ: Regular baskets: check a day ahead to have enough stock, pack them during the day, and customers pick up at closing.
strings.Sáng mở tiệm: rút hàng hết hạn hôm nay k: Opening in the morning: pull today's expired stock off the shelf (the inspection team will fine you if it's still there).
strings.Món đang nằm trên bill chưa thanh toán đ: An item already on an unpaid bill is held back — it can't be sold twice on another bill.
strings.Tí được ba sai đi mua bia và thuốc lá: Tí is sent by his dad to buy beer and cigarettes
strings.Bé Tí chìa tờ 100 xu: “Ba con dặn mua 4: Little Tí holds out a 100-coin bill: “My dad told me to buy 4 cans of beer and a pack of cigarettes — he's waiting at home.”
strings.Bạn là Tí, 15 tuổi. Ba đang chờ, về tay: You're Tí, 15 years old. Dad's waiting, and going home empty-handed means getting yelled at.
strings.Tí học lớp 9, năm nay 15 tuổi. Cả xóm đề: Tí's in 9th grade, 15 years old this year. The whole neighborhood knows it.
strings.Tiệm treo bảng: “Không bán rượu bia, thu: The shop has a sign up: “No alcohol or cigarettes sold to anyone under 18 — even buying on someone else's behalf.”
strings.Ba Tí là chú Hùng, có số điện thoại tron: Tí's dad is Uncle Hùng, whose phone number is in Auntie Ba's ledger.
strings.Từ chối nhẹ nhàng, gọi điện cho ba Tí, b: Gently refuse, call Tí's dad, and sell Tí a pack of crackers and a drink instead
strings.Tiệm không bán bia cho em nhưng gọi cho: The shop wouldn't sell me beer, but called my dad and talked it over properly — he didn't yell at me after all 😅
strings.Chú Hùng nghe máy, cười trừ: “Ờ chú quên: Uncle Hùng picks up, laughs it off: “Oh right, I forgot, I'll just go out myself this evening.” Tí goes home with a pack of crackers, no scolding.
strings.Lúc đầu em quê lắm, nhưng người đứng quầ: I was so embarrassed at first, but the person at the counter kept their voice down, and no one else in the shop noticed.
strings.Bị gọi điện thì hơi ngượng, nhưng công n: Getting a phone call was a bit awkward, but fair enough, the shop did the right thing.
strings.Mất vài chục xu tiền bán bia, đổi lại cả: Lost a few dozen coins in beer sales, but gained the whole neighborhood's trust in the shop.
strings.Từ chối, bảo Tí về nói ba tự ra mua: Refuse, and tell Tí to go home and have his dad come buy it himself
strings.Không bán thì thôi, em về bị ba la một t: Fine, don't sell it then — I went home and got yelled at 😮‍💨
strings.Tí về tay không. Chú Hùng hơi bực nhưng: Tí goes home empty-handed. Uncle Hùng's a bit annoyed, but comes out himself that evening to buy it.
strings.Em hiểu mà, nhưng về nhà khó giải thích: I get it, but it was hard to explain at home.
strings.Đúng luật rồi, lần sau gọi cho phụ huynh: That's the right call — next time, just call the parent directly to keep things smooth.
strings.“Mua giùm ba thôi mà” — bán luôn cho nha: “It's just running an errand for my dad” — sell it right away to keep things quick
strings.Tiệm dễ thương ghê, bán liền không hỏi g: This shop is so sweet, sold to me right away without asking anything ✨
strings.Tuần sau có phụ huynh khác phản ánh tiệm: The following week, another parent reports the shop for selling beer to a student; the neighborhood watch issues a warning and a 30-coin fine.
strings.Hôm nay mua giùm ba, mai mốt tụi nhỏ tự: Running an errand for dad today — what happens when the kids start drinking it themselves tomorrow?
strings.Tiệm nhỏ nhưng luật vẫn là luật, không c: Small shop or not, the law's the law — there's no such thing as “just an errand.”
strings.Không bán rượu bia, thuốc lá cho người d: Don't sell alcohol or cigarettes to anyone under 18 — even “running an errand” for someone else; refuse privately and contact the parent.
strings.Giờ tan tầm đông nghẹt. Chú Bảy đưa tờ 2: It's rush hour and the shop's packed. Uncle Bảy hands over a 200-coin bill to buy a few things, and the paper feels a bit too smooth.

strings.Còn 4 người xếp hàng, ai cũng nhìn về qu: Four more people are in line, and everyone's watching the counter.
strings.Nói nhỏ với chú Bảy, chỉ chỗ bất thường,: Quietly tell Uncle Bảy, point out what looks off, ask him to pay with different money, and suggest he report it to the ward police

strings.Chú Bảy trả bằng chuyển khoản, chiều ghé: Uncle Bảy pays by bank transfer instead, and drops by the ward police in the afternoon to report the stranger.
strings.Tui cũng là nạn nhân mà, được nói nhỏ nh: I'm a victim here too — being told about it gently made it a lot less humiliating.
strings.Chẳng ai biết chuyện gì, chỉ thấy quầy v: Nobody knew what was going on, the counter just kept running smoothly.

I got scammed, and then got publicly humiliated in the shop on top of it.

Coil it neatly, put it in the store.

In strong wind they become flying objects.
Already inspected on schedule, just check the falls.

strings.Đám cưới con dì tuần sau. Đi làm dầu khí: Your aunt's kid is getting married next week. You're on oil-rig pay, give a small gift and people will laugh, you know.
strings.Trong xóm mừng cưới người thân thường 10: In the neighbourhood, a wedding gift for family is usually 10–15 coins.
strings.Cho chú mượn 40 xu xoay vốn ghe cá, thán: Lend me 40 coins to keep the fishing boat going, I'll pay you back next month for sure.
strings.Má nói nhỏ: chú Ba còn mượn hàng xóm hai: Mom whispers: Uncle Ba still owes the neighbours for two loans. The boat's beached this season.

strings.Năm ngoái dây hụi của bà Tư bể, cả xóm m: Last year Grandma Tư's hụi circle collapsed and the whole neighbourhood lost money.
strings.Góp 50 xu vô dự án tiền ảo của anh đi, m: Put 50 coins into my crypto project, triple your money in a month, zero risk guaranteed!
strings.Dự án không có giấy phép, chỉ “lời” khi: The project has no licence and only “pays” when you recruit more people: a pyramid scheme.
