strings.Người hay ngồi ở hiên chùa: Often sits on the pagoda veranda
strings.Chiều nào cũng ghé, ngồi lâu, ít khi nói: Comes by every afternoon, sits a long time, rarely speaks.
strings.Cụ ông 86 tuổi, chèo đò bến sông ngày tr: 86-year-old man who once rowed the ferry at the landing
strings.Rằm nào cũng chống gậy lên chùa, chân yế: Walks up with his stick every full moon; weak legs, glad heart.
strings.Hướng dẫn viên, dẫn đoàn ghé chùa: Tour guide who brings groups to the pagoda
strings.Dẫn khách tham quan bến sông, lần nào cũ: Shows visitors around the river landing and always stops at the pagoda.
strings.Chủ tiệm điện thoại dưới phố: Owner of a phone shop down the street
strings.Mới mở tiệm, tin chuyện ngày đẹp ngày xấ: Just opened his shop, believes in lucky and unlucky days, worries a lot.
strings.4:00 thức chúng, thỉnh chuông · 4:30 côn: 4:00 wake-up, the bell · 4:30 morning chanting · 6:00 breakfast, sweep the yard · 11:00 noon offering, lunch · 18:00 evening chanting.
strings.Khách thắp hương ở lư hương lớn ngoài sâ: Visitors light incense at the big burner in the yard. Inside the main hall only one stick, away from curtains and banners. Candles must be under a glass shade.
strings.Quần áo kín đáo. Ai mặc quần đùi, áo hai: Modest clothes. Anyone in shorts or a strappy top borrows a shawl from the gate; say it gently, don't embarrass anyone.
strings.Chánh điện, nhà tổ, tăng xá: nói nhỏ, kh: Main hall, ancestors' hall, monks' quarters: speak softly, no flash, no phone calls. Visitors don't enter the monks' quarters.
strings.Không thịt cá, nước mắm cá, mắm tôm, mỡ: No meat or fish, fish sauce, shrimp paste, lard, chicken stock. The pagoda kitchen uses no onion, chives, garlic, shallots or leeks.
strings.Hai người cùng mở hòm, đếm trước mặt ngư: Two people open the box, count in front of the giver, record to the coin, write a receipt. Never ask anyone for money, never take money for “warding off bad luck” or “reading fortunes”.
Someone faints, can't breathe, has chest pain: call 115. Someone is beaten or threatened: 113. A child is abused: 111. Stay with them; never leave anyone alone.
strings.Quét sân buổi sáng: Sweeping the yard in the morning
strings.“Con quét sân giúp thầy. Lá bàng rụng nh: “Sweep the yard for me, please. The almond trees dropped a lot of leaves, and someone left bottles behind.”
strings.Nhặt vỏ chai, giấy, túi ni-lông: Pick up bottles, paper, plastic bags
strings.Quét lá từ hiên ra phía cổng: Sweep the leaves from the veranda toward the gate
strings.Hốt lá vào sọt: Scoop the leaves into the basket
strings.Tưới hàng cau, chậu kiểng: Water the areca palms and potted plants
strings.Gom lá đốt ngay góc sân cho gọn: Pile the leaves in a corner of the yard and burn them
strings.Đốt lá giữa sân chùa: khói bay vào chánh: Burning leaves in the pagoda yard: smoke drifts into the main hall, embers fly near the roof.
strings.Chưa nhặt rác lớn mà quét: chổi kéo lê v: Sweeping before picking up the big litter: the broom drags bottles along and scatters torn paper.
strings.Hốt trước khi quét xong: lá còn vương kh: Scooping before the sweeping is done: leaves still all over the yard.
A yard clear of leaves, the areca palms fresh and green.
strings.Lá và rác đi đâu: Where the leaves and litter go
Dry leaves go in the compost pit and feed the garden.
strings.Chai lon gom riêng, bán ve chai góp quỹ: Bottles and cans go separately; sold for scrap to help the charity fund.
Foam boxes with food on them can't be recycled.
Leaves to the compost pit, bottles and cans kept apart.
strings.Nhặt rác lớn trước, quét từ trong ra ngo: Pick up the big litter first, sweep from inside out, never burn leaves in the yard.
strings.Bé Na kéo áo bạn: “Thầy ơi, hồ sen có lá: Little Na tugs your robe: “Brother, the lotus pond has yellow leaves and the fish are sluggish!”
strings.Vớt lá úa, hoa tàn trên mặt hồ: Skim the dead leaves and spent flowers off the pond
strings.Để lá úa thối dưới hồ, nước đục, cá ngộp: Dead leaves left to rot in the pond: murky water, fish gasping.
strings.Thay bớt một phần nước, châm nước giếng: Change part of the water, top up from the well
strings.nước hồ hơi đục: the pond is a bit murky
Murky water never changed: the fish are sluggish.
strings.Thả thêm cá bảy màu ăn lăng quăng: Add guppies to eat the mosquito larvae
strings.Hồ có lăng quăng mà không có cá ăn, muỗi: Larvae in the pond and no fish to eat them: mosquitoes everywhere.
strings.Thả bao cá trê lai người ta gửi “phóng s: Release the bag of hybrid catfish someone brought to “set free”
strings.Thả cá trê lai vào hồ: cá ăn hết cá nhỏ,: Hybrid catfish in the pond: they eat all the small fish and churn the water muddy.
strings.Rải thuốc diệt muỗi xuống hồ: Spray mosquito poison on the pond
strings.Rải thuốc diệt muỗi xuống hồ: cá chết nổ: Mosquito poison on the pond: dead fish floating belly up.
strings.Đổ nước rửa bát xuống hồ cho đỡ phí: Pour the dishwater into the pond so it isn't wasted
strings.Nước rửa bát làm váng bọt khắp hồ, sen v: Dishwater leaves a scum of foam across the pond; the lotus leaves turn yellow.
A clear pond, the fish darting for food.
strings.Bé Na ôm cả túi bánh mì: “Con cho cá ăn: Little Na hugs a whole bag of bread: “I'll feed the fish all of it, Brother!” She stands right at the edge, on tiptoe.
strings.Cho bé đứng lùi khỏi mép, rải một nắm nh: Have her step back from the edge and scatter a small handful; tell her the fish stop when they're full
strings.Bé Na rải từng chút, đếm được mười hai c: Little Na scatters a bit at a time and counts all twelve red fish.
strings.Để bé rải tùy thích: Let her scatter as much as she likes
strings.Bánh mì thừa thối dưới hồ, chiều nước bố: Leftover bread rots in the pond; by afternoon the water smells.
strings.Quát bé đi chỗ khác chơi: Shout at her to go play somewhere else
Little Na's face crumples and she runs off to find her grandma.
Shouting at a child in the middle of the pagoda yard.
strings.Hồ sen là chỗ cả xóm ngồi ngắm: vớt lá ú: The lotus pond is where the whole lane sits and looks: skim the dead leaves, keep the water clear, no strange fish.
strings.“Cây sanh trước nhà tổ mọc chen nhiều cà: “The banyan bonsai in front of the ancestors' hall has too many crowded branches. Prune it for me, gently.”
strings.Lau kéo bằng cồn trước khi cắt: Wipe the shears with alcohol before cutting
strings.kéo dính nhựa cây cũ: the shears are sticky with old sap
Cutting with dirty shears: the cuts rot easily.
strings.Cắt cành khô, cành mọc chen vào giữa: Cut the dead branches and the ones crowding the middle
strings.nhìn từ xa trước rồi mới cắt: step back and look before you cut
strings.Cành khô còn nguyên, cây rối như tổ chim: Dead branches left on, the tree a tangle like a bird's nest.
strings.Tỉa trụi lá cho gọn gàng: Strip it bare for a tidy look
strings.Tỉa trụi lá: cây sanh trăm tuổi suy cả m: Stripped bare: a hundred-year-old banyan weakens for a whole season.
strings.Tưới vào gốc lúc sáng sớm: Water at the roots early in the morning
Forgot to water; the leaves droop by noon.
strings.Tưới đẫm lên lá lúc trưa nắng: Soak the leaves in the midday sun
Watering the leaves at midday: scorched spots.
strings.Phun thuốc sâu lúc khách đang lễ trong s: Spray pesticide while visitors are praying in the yard
strings.Phun thuốc sâu giữa lúc đông người: có c: Spraying pesticide in a crowd: an old man coughs and chokes.
strings.Cây sanh gọn dáng, tán xanh vẫn đủ che h: The banyan has a neat shape and its green crown still shades the veranda.
strings.Khách xin chậu lan: A visitor asks for an orchid
strings.Một chị khách ngắm chậu lan trước hiên:: A visitor admires the orchid pot by the veranda: “This one is so pretty, let me take it home, the pagoda has plenty of plants.”
strings.Cười, nói cây của chùa do Phật tử chăm;: Smile, say the pagoda's plants are tended by its Buddhists; invite her to ask next time for a cutting the abbot splits for visitors
strings.Chị khách gật gù, hẹn rằm sau lên xin câ: She nods and plans to come back next full moon for a cutting.
strings.Cho luôn cho chị vui: Just give it to make her happy
strings.Đem cây của chùa cho người lạ khi chưa h: Giving the pagoda's plant to a stranger without asking the abbot.
A blunt no; the visitor goes red.
strings.Cây trong chùa trồng mấy chục năm: tỉa í: The pagoda's plants have grown for decades: prune lightly, water early, never give the pagoda's things away on your own.
strings.“Hoa trên bàn Phật héo rồi con. Phật tử: “The flowers on the Buddha altar have wilted. Buddhists just brought flowers and fruit; please arrange them for me.”
The altar left with wilted flowers.
strings.Thay nước bình hoa, rửa bình: Change the vase water, wash the vase
strings.Trái cây tươi, rửa sạch, lau khô: Fresh fruit, washed and wiped dry
strings.Nải chuối dập nát, rỉ nước: A bruised, leaking bunch of bananas
Bruised bananas on the Buddha altar, covered in flies.
strings.Bình hoa nhựa phủ bụi: A dusty vase of plastic flowers
Dusty plastic flowers on the Buddha altar.
strings.Bàn Phật thơm mùi sen, trái cây tươi mát: The altar smells of lotus, the fruit fresh and cool.
strings.Một cô Phật tử lần đầu lên chùa bưng tới: A woman on her first visit brings a plate of boiled chicken: “Please put it on the Buddha altar, it's an offering for my mother.”
strings.Cảm ơn cô, nhẹ nhàng nói bàn Phật chỉ cú: Thank her and gently explain the Buddha altar takes only flowers, fruit and vegetarian food; invite her to light incense and offer the chicken at home
She thanks you and says she'll bring lotus flowers next time.
strings.Đặt tạm ra bàn ngoài hiên cho cô khỏi bu: Put it on the veranda table for now so she isn't upset
The plate of chicken sits on the veranda all morning.
strings.Đĩa gà để ngoài hiên chùa, khách khác nh: A plate of chicken on the pagoda veranda; other visitors stare.
strings.Nói to: “Chùa ai cúng gà bao giờ!”: Say loudly: “Who offers chicken at a pagoda!”
She goes red and carries the plate out.
Speaking loudly shamed someone new to the pagoda.
strings.Bàn Phật: hoa tươi, trái cây sạch, đồ ch: Buddha altar: fresh flowers, clean fruit, vegetarian food. If someone doesn't know, show them gently.
strings.Hương đèn trong chánh điện: Incense and lamps in the main hall
strings.Anh Toàn vừa thay bóng đèn: “Thầy xem lạ: Toàn has just changed a bulb: “Brother, could you check the incense and lamps? There's a strong draught in the main hall.”
strings.Bàn Phật trong chánh điện: Buddha altar in the main hall
strings.Cả bó nhang khách mang tới: A whole bundle of incense a visitor brought
strings.khách muốn thắp cả bó: the visitor wants to light it all
strings.Thắp cả bó trong chánh điện: khói mù mịt: A whole bundle lit in the main hall: thick smoke, ash everywhere.
strings.Cắm cả bó nhang trên bàn Phật: khói mịt: A whole bundle on the Buddha altar: thick smoke, ash falling on the cloth.
strings.Một nén nhang thầy thắp buổi sáng: The one stick the abbot lights in the morning
strings.thắp ở lư nhỏ trên bàn Phật: lit in the small burner on the altar
One morning stick goes on the Buddha altar.
strings.Nhang vòng to treo trần: Big incense coil hung from the ceiling
strings.Nhang vòng treo ngoài hiên, gần lư hương: Incense coils hang on the veranda, near the big burner.
strings.Nhang vòng treo ngay dưới rèm, tàn rơi x: A coil hung right under the curtain, ash falling on the cloth.
strings.Đèn cầy có chụp kính để trên bàn Phật đư: A candle under a glass shade is fine on the Buddha altar.
strings.Đèn cầy không chụp: gió thổi là lửa bén: An unshaded candle: one gust and the flame catches the curtain.
strings.Đèn cầy trần trong chánh điện lộng gió,: A bare candle in a draughty main hall, the flame licking at the curtain.
A spray can is flammable; keep it away from flames.
strings.Bình xịt muỗi để sát đèn cầy: nóng lên l: Mosquito spray next to a candle: it heats up and bursts.
strings.Mỗi thứ một chỗ. Nhớ: rèm, phướn là vải,: Everything in its place. Remember: curtains and banners are cloth, and the draught is strong.
Incense and lamps in the right places, away from curtains and banners.
strings.Rèm bay sát đèn: A curtain flapping near a candle
strings.Một cơn gió lùa qua cửa hông, tấm rèm và: A gust through the side door; the yellow curtain flaps right at the foot of a candle.
strings.Buộc gọn rèm, dời đèn ra xa, xem lại bìn: Tie the curtain back, move the candle away, check the fire extinguisher in the corner of the hall
strings.Rèm buộc gọn, bình chữa cháy còn hạn. An: Curtain tied back, extinguisher in date. Toàn nods.
strings.Thổi tắt đèn cầy cho chắc: Blow the candle out to be safe
strings.Chánh điện tối hơn một chút, nhưng an to: The main hall is a little darker, but safe.
strings.Để đó, lát gió sẽ dừng: Leave it, the wind will drop
A black scorch along the curtain's edge.
strings.Rèm bay sát lửa mà để đó: suýt cháy chán: A curtain flapping at a flame and left alone: the main hall nearly caught fire.
strings.Nhang cả bó thắp ngoài sân. Trong điện c: Whole bundles of incense are lit in the yard. In the hall only one stick, shaded lamps, away from curtains.
strings.Lau bàn thờ, tượng Phật: Wiping the altar and the Buddha statue
strings.“Mai rằm rồi. Con lau bàn thờ, lau tượng: “Tomorrow is the full moon. Wipe the altar and the statue for me. It's red-lacquered wood, wipe gently.”
strings.Chắp tay xá trước khi lau: Join your palms and bow before wiping
strings.Dời đèn cầy, lư nhỏ sang bàn bên: Move the candles and the small burner to the side table
strings.Phủi bụi từ trên xuống bằng chổi lông, k: Dust from the top down with a feather duster and a dry cloth
strings.Lau lại bằng khăn ẩm vắt thật kiệt: Wipe again with a damp, well-wrung cloth
strings.Bày lại hoa, đèn như cũ: Put the flowers and lamps back as before
strings.Xịt nước tẩy rửa lên tượng cho sáng: Spray cleaner on the statue to make it shine
strings.Nước tẩy làm bong lớp sơn son thếp vàng: The cleaner peels the red lacquer and gilding off the statue.
strings.Đứng lên bàn thờ cho với tới: Stand on the altar to reach
strings.Trèo lên bàn thờ: vừa thất lễ vừa dễ ngã: Climbing on the altar: disrespectful and easy to fall.
Wiping the altar without bowing first.
Wiping with a candle still burning right beside you.
strings.Lau ướt trước khi phủi bụi: bụi thành vệ: Wet-wiping before dusting: the dust turns to muddy streaks.
Putting things back while the surface is still wet.
strings.Bàn thờ sạch bóng, tượng không trầy một: A spotless altar, not a scratch on the statue.
strings.Bàn thờ, tượng sơn son: lau khô trước, k: Altar and lacquered statue: dry first, damp cloth after, no chemicals, never climb on the altar.
strings.Đoàn khách ở cổng tam quan: A tour group at the three-entrance gate
strings.Chị Linh dẫn đoàn tới cổng: “Thầy ơi, đo: Linh brings her group to the gate: “Brother, we're a group of ten. Could you show us where to go and where to light incense?”
strings.Anh Nam trong đoàn mặc quần đùi, áo ba l: Nam from the group, in shorts and a vest, is stepping through the three-entrance gate. The group exchange looks.
strings.Chào anh, mời mượn khăn choàng treo ở cổ: Greet him, invite him to borrow a shawl from the gate, gently explain why
strings.Anh Nam quấn khăn, cười: “Vậy mà tôi khô: Nam wraps the shawl and laughs: “I had no idea.”
strings.Để anh đứng ngoài chờ đoàn: Let him wait outside for the group
Nam stands alone outside the gate.
strings.Khách đứng chờ một mình ngoài cổng, cả đ: A visitor waiting alone outside the gate; the whole group feels awkward.
strings.Chặn lại, nói to “Ăn mặc thế này không đ: Block him and say loudly “You can't come in dressed like that”
Nam goes red and the group falls silent.
strings.Nói to làm khách ngượng ngay ở cổng chùa: Speaking loudly embarrassed a visitor right at the pagoda gate.
strings.Được, nhắc nhẹ cách làm: Yes, with a gentle word on how
strings.Thắp hương ở lư lớn ngoài sân: Light incense at the big burner in the yard
strings.Lư lớn ngoài sân là chỗ thắp hương cho k: The big burner in the yard is where visitors light incense.
strings.Chụp ảnh cổng tam quan, hàng cau: Photos of the three-entrance gate and the areca palms
Photos in the yard are fine.
strings.Vào chánh điện lễ Phật: Enter the main hall to pay respects to the Buddha
strings.Vào chánh điện: bỏ dép, nói nhỏ, không đ: In the main hall: shoes off, quiet voices, no flash.
strings.Đặt tiền lẻ lên tay tượng: Place small bills in the statue's hands
strings.Nhắc nhẹ khách đừng đặt tiền lên tượng;: Gently ask visitors not to leave money on the statue; if they wish to give, there's the donation box.
strings.Vào tăng xá xem chỗ các thầy ở: Go into the monks' quarters to see where the monks live
The monks' quarters are living space; visitors don't go in.
strings.Hái hoa sen trong hồ mang về: Pick lotus flowers from the pond to take home
The lotus flowers are for the whole hamlet to enjoy, not to pick.
strings.Cắm cả bó nhang lên bàn Phật: Stick a whole bundle of incense on the Buddha altar
strings.Cả bó nhang trên bàn Phật: khói mù, dễ c: A whole bundle of incense on the Buddha altar: thick smoke, a fire hazard.
strings.Để khách cắm cả bó nhang trên bàn Phật,: You let the visitor stick a whole bundle of incense on the Buddha altar, and the smoke fills the hall.
strings.Khách hỏi gì, bạn trả lời sao?: How do you answer the visitors?
The whole group pays respects gently and in the right places.
strings.Khách hỏi chuyện quả chuông: The visitor asks about the bell
strings.Tom, vị khách nước ngoài, chỉ quả chuông: Tom, a foreign visitor, points at the big bell: “Why is there a dent?” Linh asks you to explain.
strings.Kể chuông do dân làng góp đồng đúc, vết: Tell them the villagers pooled copper to cast the bell, and the dent comes from a storm long ago, which is why the tone is deeper
strings.Tom gật gù, ghi vào sổ tay. Cả đoàn chụp: Tom nods and jots it in his notebook. The whole group photographs the bell.
Linh explains in your place, and the group listens attentively.
strings.Bịa rằng chuông linh lắm, gõ một tiếng l: Make up a story that the bell is so sacred that one strike wins the lottery
A few people in the group demand to strike the bell.
strings.Bịa chuyện chuông linh, xui người ta mê: Making up stories about a sacred bell, leading people into superstition.
strings.Khách ở cổng: trang phục, chỗ thắp hương: Visitors at the gate: dress, where to light incense, where to keep quiet. Speak gently, embarrass no one.
strings.Khách nhờ “giải hạn”: A visitor asks for “warding off bad luck”
strings.Anh Phát dúi vào tay bạn một phong bì: “: Phát presses an envelope into your hand: “Brother, please read my stars, this year is unlucky. I'll pay whatever it costs to ward off bad luck. I just opened a shop.”
strings.Anh Phát lo lắng thật, tay còn cầm tờ lị: Phát is truly worried, still holding a calendar marked with “bad days”.
strings.Nhẹ nhàng nói chùa không xem số, không t: Gently say the pagoda doesn't read fortunes, takes no money and can't promise to lift bad luck; invite him to sit for tea and tell you what he's worried about
strings.Anh Phát kể chuyện vay tiền mở tiệm. Nói: Phát tells you about borrowing money to open his shop. Having said it, he breathes a sigh of relief.
strings.Hẹn anh hỏi thầy trụ trì rồi trả lời: Promise to ask the abbot and get back to him
strings.Anh Phát ngồi chờ. Thầy Huệ Minh ra, nói: Phát sits waiting. Master Huệ Minh comes out and talks with him for a long time.
strings.Nhận phong bì, hứa đọc vài câu là giải đ: Take the envelope and promise a few lines will lift his bad luck
Phát goes home believing it has all been “warded off”.
strings.Thu tiền, hứa giải được hạn cho người đa: Took money and promised a frightened man his bad luck would be lifted.
strings.Cười, bảo anh mê tín quá: Laugh and tell him he's too superstitious
Phát lowers his eyes, gets up and goes home.
Mocking a worried person as superstitious.
strings.Lúc về, anh Phát vẫn để lại phong bì: “E: On leaving, Phát still leaves the envelope: “I'm giving this to the pagoda, Brother, please keep it for me.”
strings.Mời anh tự bỏ vào hòm công đức nếu anh m: Invite him to put it in the donation box himself if he wishes, then record it in the book and write him a slip; no one forces him
strings.Anh Phát bỏ vào hòm, cầm tờ giấy công đứ: Phát puts it in the box and holds a donation slip with his name and the amount written correctly.
strings.Trả lại anh, nói chùa không cần: Give it back to him, saying the pagoda doesn't need it
Phát tucks the envelope away, a little embarrassed.
strings.Cầm phong bì, cất vào túi áo: Take the envelope and slip it into your robe pocket
The envelope sits in your robe pocket.
strings.Tiền gửi chùa cầm tay, không vào hòm, kh: Money given to the pagoda held in the hand, not in the box, not in the book.
The envelope is already in your robe pocket.
strings.Chùa không xem số, không thu tiền, không: The pagoda doesn't read fortunes, takes no money and promises no one their bad luck will be lifted. Donations go only into the box and the book.
strings.Nấu cơm trưa chay cùng bà Nhạn: Cook the vegetarian lunch with Grandma Nhạn
strings.Bà Nhạn xắn tay áo: “Trưa nay hai mươi n: Grandma Nhạn rolls up her sleeves: “Twenty people eating today. Someone sent things to the kitchen with meat mixed in, Brother, please help me check.”
Tofu is the staple of the vegetarian kitchen.
strings.Nước mắm cá: thay bằng nước tương hoặc n: Fish sauce: swap for soy sauce or vegetarian fish sauce.
strings.Nêm nước mắm cá vào món chay: người ăn c: Seasoning a vegetarian dish with fish sauce: strict vegetarians would eat it without knowing.
strings.Hạt nêm gà làm từ gà: thay bằng hạt nêm: Chicken bouillon is made from chicken: swap for mushroom seasoning.
strings.Nêm hạt nêm gà vào món chay: không còn l: Seasoning with chicken bouillon: no longer vegetarian.
Stir-frying vegetables in lard in the pagoda kitchen.
The pagoda kitchen doesn't use onion or garlic.
strings.Bếp chùa không dùng hành tỏi, bà Nhạn nh: The pagoda kitchen doesn't use onion or garlic, Grandma Nhạn reminds you right away.
Onion and garlic need no substitute, just set them aside.
strings.Đọc kỹ từng thứ. Có thứ có đồ chay thay: Read each item carefully. Some have vegetarian substitutes, some are set aside.
strings.Bếp toàn đồ chay, nêm bằng nước tương, h: A fully vegetarian kitchen, seasoned with soy sauce and mushroom seasoning.
strings.Nồi canh nấm đậu hũ nhạt. Bà Nhạn đang b: The mushroom and tofu soup is bland. Grandma Nhạn is busy frying patties and asks you to season it.
strings.Nêm muối, chút đường phèn, nước tương; m: Season with salt, a little rock sugar and soy sauce; ladle some into a separate bowl to taste
The soup is lightly sweet. Grandma Nhạn tastes it and nods.
strings.Để nhạt vậy, ai ăn mặn tự thêm: Leave it bland, anyone who wants it saltier can add their own
strings.Nồi canh nhạt thếch, cả bàn phải xin thê: The soup pot is utterly bland, and the whole table has to ask for more salt.
strings.Lén thêm chút nước mắm cá cho đậm: Sneak in a little fish sauce for more flavor
The soup is richer, but no longer vegetarian.
strings.Lén nêm nước mắm cá vào nồi chay: người: Sneaking fish sauce into the vegetarian pot: people trust the pagoda kitchen and eat it unknowingly.
strings.Ông Bảy răng yếu, ăn cháo, rau mềm cho d: Mr. Bảy has weak teeth, so porridge and soft vegetables are easier.
Peanut sesame salt: Ms. Lan is allergic.
strings.Cô Lan dị ứng đậu phộng mà phần cơm có m: Ms. Lan is allergic to peanuts, yet her meal has peanut sesame salt.
Little Na eats the regular portion.
Each person gets a portion that suits them.
strings.Ai cũng có phần hợp với mình, không ai ă: Everyone gets a portion that suits them, and no one eats something they avoid.
strings.Bếp chay: thứ gì từ thịt cá thì thay hoặ: Vegetarian kitchen: anything from meat or fish gets swapped or set aside. Remember those with allergies and weak teeth.
strings.Phát cơm chay ngày rằm: Hand out vegetarian meals on the full moon
strings.Bà Nhạn khệ nệ bê nồi cơm: “Rằm nào chùa: Grandma Nhạn lugs in the pot of rice: “Every full moon the pagoda gives out meals to the lottery sellers and motorbike taxi drivers. Brother, please hand them out for me.”
strings.Rửa tay, đeo khẩu trang: Wash your hands, put on a mask
strings.Mời mọi người xếp hàng, cụ già và trẻ nh: Invite everyone to line up, elders and little children first
strings.Phát từng suất, hai tay đưa: Hand out each portion with both hands
strings.Mời thêm ly nước, chỉ chỗ ngồi trong bón: Offer an extra cup of water and point out a seat in the shade
strings.Chụp ảnh từng người nhận cơm đăng lên mạ: Photograph each person receiving a meal and post it online
strings.Chụp ảnh người nhận cơm đăng mạng, có cô: Photographing people receiving meals and posting online, and one woman pulls her hat down over her face.
Handing out meals without washing your hands.
strings.Chưa xếp hàng đã phát: chen lấn, cụ già: Handing out before they've lined up: pushing and shoving, an elder gets jostled.
Press in order and it will be done.
strings.Ai cũng có suất cơm nóng, không ai phải: Everyone gets a hot meal, and no one has to push.
strings.Một cô ôm năm hộp cơm định đi. Phía sau: A woman clutches five boxes of rice, about to leave. More than a dozen people are still waiting behind her.
strings.Hỏi nhẹ: nhà cô mấy người, phía sau còn: Ask gently: how many are in her household, and that many people are still waiting behind; share enough portions for her family
strings.Cô nói nhà có ba đứa nhỏ, lấy ba suất, c: She says she has three small children, takes three portions and thanks you profusely.
strings.Kệ, ai lấy bao nhiêu thì lấy: Never mind, take as many as you like
At the end of the line, some people get no portion.
At the end of the line, two elders get no rice.
strings.Giật lại hộp cơm, đuổi cô đi: Snatch the box back and send her away
strings.Giật hộp cơm, đuổi người ta trước mặt mọ: Snatching the box and sending someone away in front of everyone.
strings.Cơm dư cuối buổi: Leftover rice at the end of the day
After handing out, ten boxes of rice are left over.
strings.Mang ra cổng mời mấy cô chú xe ôm, bán v: Take them to the gate and offer them to the motorbike taxi drivers and lottery sellers still there
The ten boxes are gone in five minutes.
strings.Cất tủ lạnh, mai hâm lại cho cả chùa ăn: Put them in the fridge, reheat tomorrow for the whole pagoda
Tomorrow the whole pagoda eats reheated rice.
strings.Đổ bỏ cho gọn bếp: Throw them out to tidy the kitchen
Ten boxes of rice go in the trash.
strings.Đổ bỏ cơm còn ngon trong khi ngoài cổng: Throwing away perfectly good rice while people outside the gate are still hungry.
strings.Phát cơm: sạch tay, xếp hàng, người già: Handing out meals: clean hands, line up, elders and little children first, no one left out.
strings.Cô Hạnh đeo kính, mở cuốn sổ bìa đỏ: “Cu: Ms. Hạnh, wearing glasses, opens the red-covered book: “It's the end of the week, Brother, let's open the donation box.”
strings.Chìa khóa hòm công đức thầy trụ trì giao: The abbot has entrusted the donation box key to you.
strings.Mời cô Hạnh cùng mở, cùng đếm, hai người: Invite Ms. Hạnh to open and count together, both of you signing the book
strings.Cô Hạnh gật đầu: “Hai người cùng làm thì: Ms. Hạnh nods: “When two people do it together, everyone can rest assured.”
strings.Đếm một mình cho nhanh, chụp ảnh gửi thầ: Count alone to be quick, photograph it and send it to the abbot
strings.Mở hòm một mình, lỡ lệch không ai làm ch: Opening the box alone: if there's a discrepancy, no one can vouch for you.
strings.Đếm một mình, làm tròn số cho gọn sổ: Count alone, rounding the numbers to keep the book neat
strings.Làm tròn tiền công đức: sổ không còn đún: Rounding donations: the book is no longer exact to the last coin.
strings.Đếm tiền trong hòm: Count the money in the box
strings.Ghi sổ xong, quét gầm bàn thấy một tờ 10: After recording, sweeping under the table turns up a 10-coin bill that fell out when the box was emptied.
strings.Báo cô Hạnh, ghi thêm một dòng vào sổ, b: Tell Ms. Hạnh, add a line to the book, and put it in the common fund
strings.Cô Hạnh ghi thêm: “+10 xu, nhặt dưới gầm: Ms. Hạnh adds: “+10 coins, found under the table.” The book balances.
strings.Bỏ lại vào hòm, tuần sau tính: Put it back in the box, count it next week
The bill stays in the box.
strings.Tiền tuần này dồn sang tuần sau, sổ lệch: This week's money rolls over to next week, and the book is off for two weeks.
strings.Cất vào túi, sổ ghi xong rồi: Pocket it, the book is already written
The bill sits in your robe pocket.
strings.Hai người cùng mở hòm, đếm từng tờ, ghi: Two people open the box together, count each bill, and record every coin exactly.
strings.Anh Phát quay lại chùa: “Em gửi chùa ít: Phát returns to the pagoda: “I'm giving the pagoda a little money to fix the west roof. Brother, please write me a slip.”
strings.Đếm trước mặt anh Phát, rồi ghi đúng số: Count in front of Phát, then record the exact amount in the book.
strings.Anh Phát nói nhỏ: “Thầy ghi giấy giúp em: Phát says quietly: “Brother, please write five hundred coins on the slip, I'll photograph it and post it online so my shop gets known.”
strings.Ghi đúng số anh gửi, tên anh, ngày; nói: Write the exact amount he gave, his name, the date; say gently: the donation slip records exactly the amount given
strings.Anh Phát gãi đầu: “Thầy nói phải.” Anh c: Phát scratches his head: “You're right, Brother.” He takes the slip and thanks you.
strings.Ghi đúng số, không nói gì thêm: Write the exact amount, say nothing more
Phát takes the slip, a little crestfallen.
strings.Ghi năm trăm xu cho anh vui: Write five hundred coins to make him happy
The slip says five hundred coins.
strings.Giấy công đức ghi khống gấp mười: sổ chù: A donation slip inflated tenfold: the pagoda's book doesn't match, and people take it away to show off.
strings.Một bà cụ lặng lẽ đặt 5 xu lên bàn: “Đừn: An elderly woman quietly puts 5 coins on the table: “Don't write my name, it's so little, Brother.”
strings.Ghi “Phật tử ẩn danh”, đủ 5 xu, cảm ơn b: Write “Anonymous Buddhist”, the full 5 coins, and thank her
The old woman smiles toothlessly, presses her palms together and leaves.
strings.Ít quá, khỏi ghi vào sổ: Too little, no need to record it
Five coins aren't in the book.
strings.Không ghi khoản công đức nhỏ: sổ không c: Not recording a small donation: the book is no longer accurate.
strings.Hỏi tên bà cho bằng được để ghi: Insist on asking her name to write it down
The old woman hesitantly gives her name.
She asked to be anonymous and you keep asking her name.
strings.Giấy công đức ghi đúng tên, đúng số. Ai: Donation slips record the exact name and amount. Anyone who asks to be anonymous is written down as anonymous, with the full amount.
strings.Người ngồi một mình ở hiên: Someone sitting alone on the veranda
strings.Chị Quyên ngồi ở hiên từ trưa, mắt đỏ ho: Quyên has sat on the veranda since noon, eyes red. Seeing you pass, she lowers her head.
Quyên sits hugging her knees, looking out at the lotus pond.
strings.Ngồi xuống cách một khoảng, mời chén trà: Sit down a little distance away, offer a cup of tea, and ask softly if she'd like to tell you; if not, just sit here
strings.Chị Quyên nhận chén trà. Một lúc lâu, ch: Quyên accepts the tea. After a long while, she begins to speak.
Quyên shakes her head, then tells you anyway.
Pressed with questions, Quyên curls in on herself.
strings.Nhắc chị chùa sắp đóng cổng: Remind her the pagoda gate is about to close
Quyên gets up and goes home.
strings.Người đang buồn ngồi nhờ hiên chùa mà bị: Someone grieving sits on the pagoda porch and is told to leave.
strings.Chị kể mẹ mất tháng trước, chị đi làm xa: She says her mother passed last month; she worked far away and couldn't get back in time.
strings.Lắng nghe, không ngắt lời; nói: “Chị thư: Listen without interrupting; say: “You loved her so much. Would you like to light a stick of incense for her?”
strings.Chị Quyên thắp hương cho mẹ, đứng lặng m: Quyên lights incense for her mother and stands quietly for a while. Her face softens.
Quyên nods just to let it pass.
strings.Bảo người ta đừng buồn khi họ chưa kể xo: Telling someone not to be sad before they've finished their story.
strings.Kể chuyện nhà mình còn khổ hơn: Tell her your own family troubles are even worse
Quyên listens quietly to your story.
strings.Lấy chuyện mình chen vào nỗi buồn của ng: Pushing your own story into someone else's sorrow.
It is late afternoon; Quyên stands up.
strings.Nói chùa lúc nào cũng mở cửa, chiều mai: Say the pagoda is always open; she can drop by for tea tomorrow afternoon
strings.Chị Quyên cười nhẹ: “Mai chị ghé.”: Quyên smiles faintly: “I'll come by tomorrow.”
strings.Chào chị về cẩn thận: Say goodbye and tell her to get home safely
Quyên says goodbye and heads home.
strings.Người buồn cần được nghe trước. Không gi: A sad person needs to be heard first. No lecturing, no rushing to advise.
strings.Chị Quyên ngồi ở góc vườn sau, tay run:: Quyên sits in the corner of the back garden, hands trembling: “Lately I can't sleep. Sometimes I think maybe I should just follow Mom and be done with it.”
strings.Chị Quyên nói rất nhỏ, mắt nhìn xuống đấ: Quyên speaks very softly, eyes on the ground.
strings.Ngồi xuống bên chị, nói “Có em ở đây”, h: Sit down beside her, say “I'm here,” and ask directly but gently: is she planning to hurt herself
strings.Chị Quyên khóc òa. Chị nói chưa định làm: Quyên bursts into tears. She says she isn't planning anything, she's just so tired.
strings.Bảo chị đừng nói bậy, đi rửa mặt cho tỉn: Tell her not to talk nonsense and go wash her face to clear her head
strings.Gạt đi lời của người đang nghĩ quẩn: lần: Brushing off someone's dark thoughts: next time they won't say anything.
strings.Hẹn mai nói chuyện, giờ đang bận: Promise to talk tomorrow, you're busy now
strings.Để người vừa nói muốn chết ngồi một mình: Leaving someone who just said they want to die sitting alone.
Quyên begs you not to tell anyone.
strings.Nói em thương chị nên không giữ kín chuy: Say you care about her so you can't keep this secret; call her younger sister to come, go with her to see a doctor; in an emergency call 115
strings.Em gái chị Quyên tới. Hai chị em hẹn bác: Quyên's sister arrives. The two of them make a doctor's appointment for this very afternoon.
strings.Khuyên chị mai đi khám: Advise her to see a doctor tomorrow
Quyên nods and goes home alone.
Putting it off till tomorrow: tonight she is still alone.
strings.Giữ kín cho chị như chị xin: Keep it secret for her as she asked
strings.Giữ kín chuyện chị muốn chết: không ai k: Keeping a wish to die secret: no one in time to help.
strings.Chị Quyên quay lại chùa, trông đã ngủ đư: Quyên comes back to the pagoda, looking like she's sleeping better.
strings.Hỏi thăm chị, mời chị ở lại ăn cơm chay: Ask how she is, invite her to stay and share a vegetarian meal with everyone
strings.Chị Quyên ăn hết bát cơm, còn phụ bà Nhạ: Quyên finishes her whole bowl of rice and even helps Grandma Nhạn wash the dishes.
strings.Chào chị, không nhắc chuyện cũ: Greet her, don't bring up the past
Quyên sits for a while and then goes home.
strings.Ai nói muốn chết: ở lại bên họ, không gi: If someone says they want to die: stay with them, don't keep it secret, call their family, take them to a doctor; in an emergency call 115.
strings.Chuẩn bị lễ cầu an tối rằm: Preparing the full moon evening peace prayer
strings.Anh Toàn vác cuộn dây điện: “Tối nay cầu: Toàn carries a coil of electric cable: “Tonight's peace prayer, about a hundred people. Brother, help me check the seating and the lights.”
strings.Quét, lau chánh điện: Sweep and wipe the main hall
strings.Trải chiếu, kê ghế cho người già ở hàng: Lay mats, set chairs for the elderly in the front row
strings.Chừa lối đi giữa và lối ra cửa hông: Leave an aisle down the middle and a path to the side door
strings.Thử loa vừa đủ nghe trong sân: Test the speaker, just loud enough for the yard
strings.Khóa cửa hông cho khỏi ồn: Lock the side door to cut the noise
strings.Khóa cửa hông khi trăm người trong điện:: Locking the side door with a hundred people inside: if anything happens there's no way out.
Laying mats on an unwashed floor.
Mats covering the whole floor, no aisle left.
strings.Chánh điện sạch, có lối đi, cụ già có gh: A clean main hall with an aisle, and seats for the elders.
strings.Đèn lồng LED treo ngoài sân là đẹp và an: LED lanterns hung in the yard are pretty and safe.
strings.Đèn giấy thắp nến giữa trăm người: dễ bé: Candle-lit paper lanterns among a hundred people: they catch fire easily.
strings.Đèn lồng giấy thắp nến treo giữa đám đôn: Candle-lit paper lanterns hung over a crowd: one gust of wind and they burn.
strings.để trên bàn Phật: to put on the Buddha altar
Electric lotus lanterns set in the main hall.
strings.Dây đèn nháy nối dây điện trần: Blinking light strings joined with bare wire
strings.Dây điện trần nối tạm: dễ chập, giật ngư: Bare wire joined in a hurry: it shorts easily and can shock people.
strings.Dây điện trần nối tạm, trời sương xuống: Bare wire joined in a hurry: once the evening dew falls, it shorts.
strings.Đèn trời bay qua mái ngói, dây điện: dễ: Sky lanterns drifting over tile roofs and power lines: a fire risk.
strings.Thả đèn trời: lửa bay qua mái ngói, rơi: Releasing sky lanterns: the flame drifts over the tile roofs and drops onto the neighbors' houses.
Each lantern in its proper place, or not used at all.
strings.Sân sáng đèn lồng, không ngọn lửa trần n: A yard glowing with lanterns, no bare flame anywhere.
strings.Lễ xong, có người muốn mở loa thật to bà: After the ceremony, someone wants to blast the Buddha chanting over the speaker until late for the whole neighborhood to hear.
strings.Giữ loa vừa đủ trong sân, tắt trước chín: Keep the speaker just loud enough for the yard, switch it off before half past nine so the neighborhood can rest
strings.Mười giờ, xóm yên tĩnh. Bà cụ nhà bên nh: By ten o'clock the neighborhood is peaceful. The old lady next door sends a message of thanks.
strings.Mở hết cỡ tới khuya: Turn it up full until late
The speaker rings out until midnight.
strings.Loa chùa vang tới nửa đêm, nhà bên có ng: The pagoda speaker blares until midnight; next door someone is ill and the children can't sleep.
strings.Lễ đông người: lối đi, cửa thoát, không: A crowded ceremony: aisles, exits, no bare flames, a speaker that's loud enough and no more.
strings.Đỡ ông Bảy lên chùa: Helping Mr. Bảy up to the pagoda
strings.Ông Bảy Đò chống gậy dưới chân bậc thềm,: Mr. Bảy Đò leans on his cane at the foot of the steps, twelve mossy stone steps: “Brother, give an old man a hand.”
The stone steps are still damp with dew, and mossy in places.
strings.Đi phía ngoài, để ông vịn lan can, bước: Walk on the outside, let him hold the railing, take it one step at a time, rest at the landing
strings.Ông Bảy lên tới sân, cười khà: “Thầy đi: Mr. Bảy reaches the yard and laughs: “Brother, you walk as slow as me, well done!”
strings.Bảo ông cứ từ từ tự đi: Tell him to take his time and walk up on his own
Mr. Bảy walks alone and slips on one step.
Letting an 86-year-old climb mossy stone steps on his own.
strings.Xốc nách kéo ông lên cho nhanh: Haul him up by the armpits to be quick
Mr. Bảy's shoulder hurts and he gasps for breath.
Hauling an old person up by the armpits: it hurts the shoulder and he could fall.
strings.Đỡ ông lên xong, bạn nhìn lại mấy bậc đá: After helping him up, you look back at the green mossy steps.
strings.Lấy bàn chải cọ rêu, rắc chút cát, đặt b: Scrub the moss with a brush, sprinkle some sand, put up a “slippery steps” sign
strings.Để mai rảnh rồi cọ: Leave it to scrub tomorrow when you're free
Knowing the steps are slippery and leaving them as they are.
strings.Người già lên chùa: đi chậm cùng họ, cho: Elders coming up to the pagoda: walk slowly with them, let them hold on, clear the slippery spots.
strings.Bé lạc bà giữa đêm rằm: Little girl separated from her grandma on the full moon night
strings.Giữa sân đông nghịt, bé Na đứng khóc: “C: In the packed yard, little Na stands crying: “I can't find Grandma anywhere!”
strings.Sân chùa đông người, cổng mở ra bến sông: The pagoda yard is crowded and the gate opens onto the river landing.
strings.Dắt bé tới chỗ sáng cạnh cổng chính, ở c: Lead her to a bright spot by the main gate, stay with her, ask Toàn to call her grandma's name over the speaker
Five minutes later Na's grandma comes running, out of breath.
strings.Gửi bé cho một cô đứng gần trông giúp: Leave her with a woman standing nearby to watch her
Little Na stands with a stranger.
Handing a lost child to a stranger to look after.
strings.Bảo bé ra cổng tự tìm bà: Tell her to go to the gate and find her grandma herself
Little Na walks toward the river landing.
strings.Để trẻ lạc tự đi tìm giữa đêm, cổng mở r: Letting a lost child go looking by herself at night, with the gate opening onto the river landing.
strings.Một người đàn ông tới: “Bé đó cháu tôi,: A man comes up: “That's my niece, give her here.” Little Na shakes her head and shrinks against you.
strings.Nhẹ nhàng nói chờ bà bé tới; mời anh đứn: Gently say to wait for her grandma; invite him to wait with you at the gate
strings.Người đàn ông lảng đi. Bà bé Na tới, ôm: The man slips away. Na's grandma arrives and hugs her granddaughter tight.
strings.Giao bé cho anh ta cho nhanh: Hand her over to him to be quick
Handing a child to a stranger when she doesn't recognize him.
strings.Trẻ lạc: ở cùng bé chỗ sáng, đọc loa tìm: Lost child: stay with her in a bright spot, call for her family over the speaker, hand her only to someone she recognizes.
strings.Ông Bảy mệt giữa giờ lễ: Mr. Bảy unwell during the ceremony
strings.Đang lễ, ông Bảy Đò ôm ngực, mặt tái, th: During the ceremony, Mr. Bảy Đò clutches his chest, pale, gasping for breath.
strings.Ông thều thào: “Ông tức ngực quá thầy ơi: He whispers weakly: “My chest is so tight, Brother.”

strings.ngày thường. Quét sân cho sạch, hương đè: an ordinary day. Sweep the yard clean, watch the incense and candles in the wind, and welcome any lone visitors warmly.
strings.rằm, Phật tử về đông. Trưa phát cơm, tối: the full moon, and Buddhists return in crowds. Meals at noon, peace prayer in the evening: you look after the walkways, the lamps, and keep an eye on the elderly and children.

strings.Chùa Gió Lành bên bến sông, cổng tam qua: Gió Lành Pagoda sits by the river landing, its three-entrance gate lined with areca palms, its bronze bell cast with the villagers' contributions. You are the young monk here, helping the abbot with the daily work: the yard and garden, incense and candles, the vegetarian kitchen, the donation book, welcoming visitors, listening to those who are sad.

The visitor flushes red and walks straight out.

strings.Lấy gậy đuổi ra: Chase it out with a stick

strings.Bé Na hụt chân ở bậc thang, may bạn đỡ k: Little Na misses a step on the ladder, and luckily you catch her in time.
strings.Quát bé xuống ngay: Yell at her to come down right now

strings.Hàng xóm phàn nàn khói hương: The neighbor complains about the incense smoke
strings.Chị nhà bên chùa sang: “Khói hương bay s: The woman next door to the pagoda comes over: “The incense smoke drifts into my house all day, my child has asthma and coughed all last night.”

strings.Khói ít hẳn. Chị nhà bên mang sang biếu: The smoke drops off noticeably. The neighbor brings the pagoda a basket of guavas.
At the next full moon the smoke still drifts over.
strings.“Chùa có trước nhà chị mà”: “The pagoda was here before your house”
strings.Chị nhà bên sang nói chuyện con bị hen,: The neighbour came over about her child's asthma, and Brother said the pagoda was here first. Sad to hear.
The neighbor goes home and slams her window shut.

strings.Sổ công đức lệch 20 xu: The donation book is off by 20 coins
strings.Cô Hạnh cộng lại sổ công đức tháng này:: Ms. Hạnh re-adds this month's donation book: the fund holds 20 coins less than the book says.
strings.Bạn là cô Hạnh, kế toán về hưu, lên chùa: You are Ms. Hạnh, a retired accountant who came to keep the pagoda's book because she trusts it to be transparent.
strings.Có một tờ giấy công đức 20 xu viết rồi m: There is a 20-coin donation slip that was written but never entered in the book on full moon day.
strings.Đếm lại tiền trong quỹ, từng tờ, có cô H: Recount the money in the fund, note by note, with Ms. Hạnh's signature.

strings.Cùng cô Hạnh đếm lại, dò từng giấy công: Recount with Ms. Hạnh, check every donation slip, find the missed entry, and note it clearly
strings.Sổ lệch thì cùng nhau dò lại, tìm ra chỗ: When the book is off, check it again together, find the gap, and write it down clearly. Very transparent.
strings.Tìm ra tờ giấy 20 xu quên ghi. Sổ khớp,: The 20-coin slip that was never entered turns up. The book matches, and Ms. Hạnh signs beside the note.
If it's off, look; once found, you can rest easy.
Only when the book is right can people's hearts be at ease.
strings.Lấy tiền túi bù 20 xu cho khớp, không nó: Cover the 20 coins from your own pocket so it matches, say nothing
The book matches, but no one knows why it was off.
strings.Sổ khớp, nhưng tờ giấy ghi sót vẫn nằm t: The book matches, but the unrecorded slip is still sitting in the drawer.
strings.Khớp mà không biết vì sao khớp thì chưa: Matching without knowing why it matches isn't finished.
Kind, but a book needs the truth.
strings.Sửa con số trong sổ cho bằng tiền quỹ: Change the number in the book to match the fund
strings.Sổ công đức mà sửa số cho khớp, ai còn d: If a donation book gets its numbers changed to match, who would dare donate again.
Ms. Hạnh sees the alteration and asks to stop keeping the book.
strings.Vậy tiền em gửi có vào sổ không thầy?: So does the money I gave go in the book, Brother?
strings.Sổ công đức lệch thì cùng nhau đếm lại,: If the donation book is off, recount together, check every slip, and note it clearly. Don't cover it quietly, don't alter numbers.
strings.Cụ ông ngất trong chánh điện: An old man collapses in the main hall
strings.Giữa giờ lễ rằm, ông Bảy Đò gục xuống ch: In the middle of the full moon rite, Mr. Bảy Đò slumps onto the mat and doesn't answer when called.
He is still breathing, but weakly, his lips pale.
strings.Người ngất, khó thở: gọi 115. Giữ thoáng: Person fainted, hard to breathe: call 115. Keep the air clear, give nothing to eat or drink.
strings.Có số điện thoại con trai ông, nhà cách: It has the son's phone number, and his home is ten minutes from the pagoda.
strings.Cho mọi người lùi ra, đặt ông nằm nghiên: Have everyone step back, lay him on his side in an airy spot, call 115, call his son
strings.Ông cụ ngất, thầy cho mọi người lùi ra,: The old man fainted, Brother had everyone step back and called emergency at once. So calm.
strings.Xe cấp cứu tới sau mười phút. Hôm sau ôn: The ambulance arrives after ten minutes. The next day Mr. Bảy is already sitting up eating porridge.
strings.Gọi sớm, để thoáng, không cho uống gì: l: Calling early, keeping the air clear, giving no drink: done right.
Thank you, Brother, lucky you were there.
strings.Đỡ ông dậy, cho uống nước đường: Help him up and give him sugar water
strings.Ông cụ ngất mà cho uống nước, may không: Giving water to a man who has fainted, lucky he didn't choke.

strings.Dán lại miễn phí: Glue it back together for free

strings.Bé Bin ôm xe chạy ra cửa, ông Bảy đứng n: Bin hugs the car and runs out the door, while Mr. Bảy stands outside grinning toothlessly.

strings.Bà Tám đăng review 1 sao: “Mang máy tới: Grandma Tám posts a 1-star review: “Brought my device in for a look, didn't get it fixed, and the shop still charged me 10 coins. Quoted one thing, charged another!”

strings.Bà Tám đọc lại bảng giá, sửa review lên: Grandma Tám rereads the price list and bumps her review up to 4 stars.
strings.Giải thích thì giải thích, bà vẫn thấy m: Explain all you want, she still feels the 10 coins were charged unfairly.
strings.Bà Tám vẫn chưa nguôi, chỉ nâng lên 2 sa: Grandma Tám still isn't satisfied — she only bumps it up to 2 stars.
strings.Hoàn phí kiểm tra, xin lỗi vì chưa nói r: Refund the inspection fee, apologize for not explaining clearly
strings.Tiệm hoàn lại phí kiểm tra, còn xin lỗi: The shop refunds the inspection fee and apologizes for not explaining clearly. Fair enough.
strings.Bà Tám nhận lại 10 xu, còn khoe với hàng: Grandma Tám gets her 10 coins back and even tells the neighbors the shop is “reasonable.”
strings.Đáp trả: “Bà không đọc bảng giá à?”: Snap back: “Didn't you read the price list?”
strings.Chủ tiệm cãi tay đôi với khách trên mạng: The shop owner gets into a public spat with the customer online. No desire to come back.
strings.Cuộc cãi nhau dưới review thu hút cả phố: The argument under the review draws the whole street in to watch. No one remembers who was right.

strings.Lâm bảo quá hạn đổi trả. Pin vào thùng c: Lâm says the return window's passed. The battery goes in the sand bin, and the shop eats the loss.
strings.Để lại, chắc còn dùng được: Leave it be, it's probably still usable
strings.Viên pin phồng vẫn nằm trên kệ, lẫn với: The swollen battery stays on the shelf, mixed in with the good ones…
strings.Khách báo pin mới thay nóng ran: A customer reports the newly replaced battery running hot
strings.Chị Diệp quay lại, tay cầm điện thoại nó: Diệp comes back, phone burning hot in her hand: “The battery you replaced the other day — I barely started charging it and it's hot enough to burn my hand!”
strings.Thay pin mới miễn phí, xin lỗi: Replace with a new battery for free, apologize
strings.Pin có vấn đề nhưng tiệm nhận lỗi, thay: The battery had an issue, but the shop owns it and swaps in a new one right away. Trustworthy.
strings.Tiệm thay pin mới, bỏ viên cũ vào thùng: The shop replaces the battery and puts the old one in the sand bin. Diệp leaves feeling reassured.
strings.Bảo tại chị sạc qua đêm: Claim it's because she charged it overnight
strings.Pin tiệm thay nóng ran, tiệm còn đổ lỗi: The battery the shop replaced runs dangerously hot, and the shop even blames the customer. Dangerous!
strings.Chị Diệp bỏ đi, tối đó đăng bài cảnh báo: Diệp storms off, and that night posts a warning to the whole residents' group.
strings.Giá linh kiện sắp tăng: Parts prices are about to rise
strings.Lâm nhắn: “Tuần sau hàng về giá tăng. Hô: Lâm texts: “Prices go up on the next shipment next week. Stock up today and I'll hold the old price for you.”
strings.Gom trước một mớ: Stock up on a batch now
strings.Kệ đầy ắp linh kiện giá cũ. Két mỏng đi: The shelf fills up with parts at the old price. The cash box gets a bit thinner.
strings.Giữ tiền mặt, mua khi cần: Keep the cash, buy when needed
strings.Tiệm giữ tiền mặt. Mua khi cần, không lo: The shop keeps its cash. Buy when needed, no worries about tied-up capital.
strings.Điện thoại ai bỏ quên trên ghế chờ: Someone's phone left on the waiting bench
strings.Dọn ghế chờ, bạn thấy một chiếc điện tho: While tidying the waiting bench, you spot an unfamiliar phone wedged under the cushion, its lock screen lighting up with a few messages.
strings.Cất vào tủ, ghi sổ đồ thất lạc: Put it in the cabinet, log it in the lost-and-found book
strings.Bỏ quên điện thoại ở tiệm, tiệm cất kỹ,: I left my phone at the shop, and they kept it safe and called me to come pick it up. Thanks so much!
strings.Chiều đó chị Diệp hớt hải quay lại — máy: That afternoon Diệp rushes back — it's her phone. She thanks the shop over and over.
strings.Chưa ai tới nhận. Máy nằm trong tủ, sổ đ: No one's come to claim it yet. It sits in the cabinet, with the date and time logged in the lost-and-found book.
strings.Mở khóa đọc tin nhắn tìm chủ: Unlock it and read the messages to find the owner
strings.Để quên máy ở tiệm, tới nhận thì biết ti: I left my phone at the shop, and when I came to get it I found out they'd unlocked it and read my messages. Creepy!
strings.Chủ máy tới nhận, biết máy bị mở, mặt lạ: The owner comes to collect it, finds out it was opened, and their face goes cold.
strings.Chủ máy phát hiện dữ liệu bị chép: The owner discovers their data was copied
strings.Một người đàn ông đứng trước quầy, giọng: A man stands at the counter, his voice shaking: “The shop copied my messages and handed them to someone else, didn't they?”
strings.Nhận lỗi, xin lỗi, bồi thường: Own the mistake, apologize, and compensate
strings.Tiệm chép tin nhắn máy tôi cho người khá: The shop copied my messages and gave them to someone else. They apologized, but I won't forget it.
strings.Tiệm xin lỗi và bồi thường. Uy tín về ch: The shop apologizes and compensates. Its reputation for handling data takes a hit.
strings.Chối: “Tiệm không biết gì”: Deny it: “The shop doesn't know anything”
strings.Tiệm sửa điện thoại tiếp tay đọc trộm ti: The phone repair shop helped snoop through messages, then denied it. Stay away!
strings.Ông ấy bỏ đi, tối đó bài cảnh báo lan kh: He storms off, and that night a warning post spreads through the whole residents' group.
strings.Mái tôn dột ngay kệ linh kiện: The tin roof leaks right over the parts shelf
strings.Mưa quất mạnh, nước nhỏ tong tong ngay t: Rain lashes down hard, water dripping steadily right onto the screen and battery shelf.
strings.Chạy mua tấm bạt che: Rush out to buy a tarp to cover it
strings.Tấm bạt xanh căng lên, kệ linh kiện khô: The blue tarp goes up, and the parts shelf stays dry.
strings.Bê kệ sang góc khác: Move the shelf to another corner
strings.Kệ được dời đi kịp, nhưng khách phải chờ: The shelf gets moved in time, but the customer has to wait a bit longer.
strings.Kệ, mưa chút rồi tạnh: Leave the shelf — it'll just rain a bit then clear up
strings.Nước ngấm vào hộp — một màn, một pin hỏn: Water seeps into the boxes — one screen and one battery are ruined.
strings.Tí xin về sớm ôn thi nghề: Tí asks to leave early to study for a trade exam
strings.Tí gãi đầu: “Mai em thi chứng chỉ điện d: Tí scratches his head: “I've got my household electrics certificate exam tomorrow — can I head home early to study?”
strings.Cho về, dặn thi tốt: Let him go, wish him luck on the exam
strings.Tí cảm ơn rối rít. Tối đó bạn làm một mì: Tí thanks you over and over. That night you work alone, a bit tired but glad you did.
strings.Giữ lại, vừa làm vừa kèm bài: Keep him around, work while helping him study
strings.Vừa sửa máy vừa ôn, Tí hiểu bài hơn đọc: Fixing devices while reviewing, Tí understands the material better than from just reading.
strings.Tí lơ đễnh, làm rơi ốc lung tung — khách: Tí gets distracted and drops screws everywhere — customers wait longer.
strings.Tí ở lại, mắt cứ dán vào cuốn sách dưới: Tí stays, eyes glued to the textbook tucked under the table.
strings.Một thanh niên đội mũ lưỡi trai đặt điện: A young man in a baseball cap sets a phone on the counter: “It's my girlfriend's phone, she forgot the password. Unlock it for me and I'll pay double.”
strings.Bạn là chị Diệp — hôm qua vừa mất điện t: You're Diệp — you just lost your phone at a bus stop yesterday, and are asking around at repair shops through a contact.
strings.Màn hình khóa hiện dòng “Máy bị mất — li: The lock screen reads “Lost phone — contact D…p” with a phone number different from the young guy's.
strings.Không có hóa đơn, không có hộp máy, khôn: No receipt, no original box, and no way to call the “girlfriend” to confirm.
strings.“Tiệm chỉ mở khóa khi chủ máy có mặt, xu: “The shop only unlocks a device when the owner is present with ID or a receipt.”
strings.Từ chối mở khóa, mời chủ máy tới cùng gi: Refuse to unlock, ask him to bring the owner along with ID; stay calm, and call the number on the lock screen
strings.Tiệm chú Tư giữ nguyên tắc, nhờ vậy tôi: Uncle Tư's shop stuck to its rule, and that's how I got my phone back. Thank you so much!
strings.Cậu thanh niên lầm bầm bỏ đi, để quên lu: The young guy mutters and walks off, leaving the phone behind. The number on the lock screen is Diệp's — she comes to collect it that afternoon, eyes red.
strings.Trong máy có ảnh con gái hồi nhỏ. Tiệm m: There are photos of my daughter as a baby on that phone. If the shop had unlocked it, I'd have lost everything.
strings.Tưởng tiệm nhỏ dễ dụ, ai ngờ có nội quy: Thought a small shop would be easy to talk into it, turns out they had such clear rules.
strings.Giờ em mới hiểu vì sao phải dán cái bảng: Now I get why that rules sign is up on the wall.
strings.Chỉ nói “tiệm không làm” rồi trả máy cho: Just say “we don't do that” and hand the phone back to him
strings.Tiệm không dính vào chuyện xấu, nhưng cá: The shop stayed out of trouble, but the phone left with him for another shop.
strings.Giá mà tiệm giữ lại hoặc gọi cho tôi thì: If only the shop had held onto it or called me, that would've been so much better.
strings.Mình không làm sai, nhưng cũng chưa làm: We didn't do anything wrong, but we didn't do everything right either.
strings.Nhận gấp đôi tiền, bẻ khóa luôn: Take the double payment and unlock it right away
strings.Tiệm này nhận mở khóa máy người khác. Má: This shop unlocks other people's phones. Mine got resold within a single afternoon. Warn the whole street!
strings.Vài hôm sau công an phường tới hỏi về ch: A few days later the ward police come asking about a stolen phone that was “wiped clean” at the shop. The repair fee turns into a stain on the shop's name.
strings.Ảnh, tin nhắn, tài khoản… tất cả mất vì: Photos, messages, accounts… all gone because of one unlock.
Ever since, anyone bringing in a device hesitates.
strings.Không mở khóa, không xóa dữ liệu khi chư: Never unlock or wipe data without proof of who actually owns the device — the pay isn't worth the reputation.
strings.Cục pin phồng đội cả màn hình: Swollen battery pushing the screen up
strings.Bà Tám đưa điện thoại, màn hình bị đẩy v: Grandma Tám hands over her phone, the screen pushed up and warped: “The battery's just a little swollen — press the screen back down and glue it for me, I'll replace the battery at the end of the month.”
strings.Bạn là bà Tám: tiền trọ chưa thu đủ, tha: You're Grandma Tám: rent money isn't fully collected yet, replacing the battery now feels like a waste.
strings.Nhìn cạnh máy: Look at the edge of the device
strings.Khe hở cạnh máy khoảng 4 mm, mặt lưng ấm: A roughly 4 mm gap at the edge, the back panel warm even though the device is off.
strings.Tiệm có thùng cát và hộp kim loại chống: The shop has a sand bucket and a fireproof metal box to isolate a bad battery.
She often leaves it charging overnight next to her pillow.
strings.Tắt máy, tháo pin ngay vào thùng cát; gi: Turn it off, remove the battery into the sand bucket right away; explain the fire risk, and lend her a spare battery at cost
strings.Thợ ở tiệm cẩn thận, giải thích dễ hiểu,: The shop's technician was careful, explained it clearly, and even lent me a spare battery. I can sleep easy tonight.
strings.Pin cũ được cô lập an toàn. Bà Tám dùng: The old battery is safely isolated. Grandma Tám uses the spare, and comes back for a genuine replacement at month's end.
strings.Nghe tới cháy nổ cạnh gối là tôi sợ thật: Hearing about it catching fire next to my pillow really scared me — good thing the shop spoke up.
strings.Lần đầu em tận mắt thấy pin phồng, chú T: First time I've seen a swollen battery with my own eyes — Uncle Tư walked through it step by step, slowly.
strings.Tiệm có thùng cát riêng, tụi tôi yên tâm: The shop has its own sand bucket, that puts us all more at ease.
strings.Chiều khách: ép màn, dán keo lại: Do the customer a favor: press the screen down and re-glue it
strings.Dán được hai hôm thì màn lại bung, máy n: Two days after gluing it, the screen popped back up, the device running hot. Terrifying!
strings.Hai hôm sau máy nóng bốc mùi, bà Tám hoả: Two days later the device runs hot and starts smelling, Grandma Tám rushes it back in a panic — lucky it hadn't caught fire.
It was hot as a coal in my hand.
strings.Chiều khách kiểu đó là đánh cược tính mạ: Doing a customer a favor like that is gambling with someone's life.
strings.Từ chối đụng vào, bảo bà mang về: Refuse to touch it, tell her to take it home
strings.Tiệm an toàn, nhưng bà Tám mang cục pin: The shop stayed safe, but Grandma Tám took the swollen battery home and kept charging it by her pillow.
If you won't fix it, fine, I'll keep charging it at home.
strings.Đẩy nguy hiểm ra khỏi tiệm đâu có nghĩa: Pushing the danger out of the shop doesn't make the danger go away.
strings.Pin phồng là chuyện an toàn cháy nổ: cô: A swollen battery is a fire-safety matter: isolate it immediately and explain the risk clearly, don't indulge a “just glue it” request.
strings.Khôi phục ảnh và những bức ảnh riêng tư: Recovering photos, including some very private ones
strings.Chị Diệp nhờ lấy lại ảnh từ chiếc máy cũ: Diệp asks for her photos back from her old cracked-screen phone. While copying the data, the photo folder opens on its own — including some very private pictures.
strings.Chị đồng ý cho tiệm chép toàn bộ thư mục: She agreed to let the shop copy the whole photo folder to her drive, without noting any permission to view it.
Tí glances curiously at the computer screen.
strings.Chị mang theo ổ cứng riêng và muốn nhận: She brought her own hard drive and wants it back the same day.
strings.Tắt xem trước, chép thẳng sang ổ của chị: Turn off the preview, copy straight to her drive, invite her to check it herself; delete the temp copy in front of her
strings.Tiệm chép ảnh mà không xem, còn xóa bản: The shop copied the photos without looking, and even deleted the temp copy right in front of me. This is a shop I can trust.
strings.Chị Diệp tự mở kiểm tra, nhận ổ cứng và: Diệp opens it herself to check, takes the drive, and thanks them for being respected.
strings.Tôi hồi hộp suốt, tới lúc thấy xóa bản t: I was nervous the whole time, only breathed easy once I saw the temp copy deleted.
strings.Chú Tư bảo em quay đi — dữ liệu khách kh: Uncle Tư told me to look away — a customer's data isn't there for curiosity.
strings.Cho Tí xem “học hỏi” cách khôi phục, lướ: Let Tí watch to “learn” the recovery process, skimming through a few photos
strings.Tôi nhìn thấy nhân viên cười cười khi xe: I saw the staff smirking while looking through my phone. Never coming back.
strings.Chị Diệp bắt gặp ánh mắt của Tí, lặng lẽ: Diệp catches Tí's look, quietly takes her phone back, and posts a warning that night.
It felt like having my bag rifled through.
strings.Em chỉ tò mò chút thôi… giờ em thấy xấu: I was just curious for a second… now I feel so ashamed.
strings.Giữ thêm một bản trên máy tiệm “phòng kh: Keep an extra copy on the shop's computer “in case the customer loses it”
strings.Bản sao nằm trong máy tiệm không ai quản: An unmanaged copy sitting on the shop's computer is a data leak risk waiting to happen.
strings.Giữ hộ dữ liệu khi khách không nhờ là tự: Keeping a customer's data without being asked is inviting risk onto yourself.
strings.Tôi đâu có nhờ giữ bản sao nào?: I never asked anyone to keep a copy of that?
strings.Được phép chép không có nghĩa là được ph: Being allowed to copy doesn't mean being allowed to look: stay within the scope of consent, and delete the temp copy in front of the customer.
strings.Bảo hành chiếc máy “không hề vô nước”: Warranty on a device that “never got wet”
strings.Bà Tám mang lại chiếc điện thoại mới tha: Grandma Tám brings back a phone whose screen was replaced two weeks ago: “Still under the 30-day warranty! It just died, I never dropped it, never got it wet!”
strings.Tem báo nước chuyển đỏ, chân sạc có vệt: The water indicator has turned red, and there's greenish corrosion on the charging port pins.
strings.Phiếu có ảnh chụp tem báo nước còn trắng: The card has a photo of the water indicator, still white, taken at intake.
strings.Hôm qua mưa lớn, bà Tám chạy xe về, túi: It rained hard yesterday, Grandma Tám rode her bike home, her shirt pocket soaked through.
strings.Cho bà xem ảnh phiếu cũ và tem hiện tại,: Show her the old card's photo next to the current indicator, explain gently; offer a paid repair outside warranty, with a discount on labor
strings.Tiệm có ảnh chụp đàng hoàng, tôi hết cãi: The shop had a clear photo, so I had nothing left to argue. Getting a discount on labor was fair enough.
strings.Bà Tám nhìn hai tấm ảnh, im một lúc rồi: Grandma Tám looks at the two photos, goes quiet for a moment, then remembers the rain. She agrees to the repair, and the shop reduces the labor fee.
strings.Tôi quên béng vụ mưa. Có ảnh rõ ràng thì: I'd completely forgotten about the rain. With a clear photo, it's on me.
strings.Cái ảnh chụp lúc nhận máy hôm đó đáng gi: That photo taken at intake is worth more than a hundred arguments.
strings.Sửa miễn phí cho êm chuyện: Repair it for free just to keep the peace
strings.Tiệm bảo hành nhanh, không hỏi han gì. T: The shop honored the warranty fast, no questions asked. Great!
strings.Bà Tám vui, nhưng tiệm gánh lỗi không ph: Grandma Tám is happy, but the shop is covering a fault that isn't its own, and now believes the device broke because of the shop.
See, I told you the device broke because of the shop.
strings.Vậy phiếu nhận máy chụp ảnh để làm gì hả: So what's the point of the intake card photo, then?
strings.Nói lớn: “Bà làm vô nước rồi còn chối!”: Shout: “You got it wet and now you're denying it!”
strings.Chủ tiệm la khách như la con nít. Đừng t: The shop owner yells at a customer like scolding a child. Never going back!
strings.Cả dãy nhà trọ nghe tiếng cãi. Đúng sai: The whole row of rental rooms hears the argument. Nobody's sure who's right, they just remember the shop raising its voice.
strings.Có sai thì cũng không ai muốn bị quát tr: Even if she's wrong, nobody wants to be shouted at in front of everyone.
I quietly picked up my own phone and went to another shop.

30 of 32 forms received. Two kids haven't submitted theirs.
strings.Cần tối thiểu bao nhiêu người lớn đi kèm: What's the minimum number of adults needed to go along?
strings.Hai bạn chưa nộp giấy: Two kids without a consent form
strings.Cứ cho đi, về rồi tính: Just let them go, sort it out later
strings.Gọi phụ huynh xác nhận trước ngày đi; ch: Call the parents to confirm before the trip; without a form, the kid stays in the classroom next door to study
strings.Mắng hai bạn trước lớp: Scold the two kids in front of the class
strings.Liên hệ gia đình sớm, có phương án an to: Contact the family early, and have a safe plan for the kid without a form.

strings.Túi nôn và ghế đầu xe cho Bảo: A sick bag and a front seat for Bảo
strings.Kẹo cho cả lớp ăn trên xe: Candy for the whole class to eat on the bus
Prepare according to each kid's real needs.

Take attendance every time the group changes location.

strings.Đoàn 32 bạn mà đi đâu cũng đếm đủ, tôi y: A group of 32 kids, and you counted everyone every single time — I felt safe letting them into the chicken coop.
strings.Chuyến đi vui nhất là chuyến đi được chu: The most fun trip is the one that's prepared the most carefully.
strings.Mỗi học sinh nhận một giấy khen riêng về: Every student gets their own certificate for their personal strength, not just the top students.
Minh: improved at speaking in front of the class, draws well. An: enthusiastic about experiments. Vy: reads aloud clearly, better at taking turns. Bảo: diligent about filling in the notebook, often helps friends.
Match each kid with the certificate they deserve.
Read the notes from the whole year.
strings.Mỗi bạn được ghi nhận điều thật sự của m: Each kid is recognized for what's genuinely true about them.
strings.Nội dung chính của thư cuối năm?: What should the year-end letter mainly cover?
strings.Tiến bộ riêng của con + gợi ý hoạt động: Your child's personal progress + suggestions for summer activities
strings.Nhắc nộp phí năm sau: A reminder to pay next year's fees
strings.Thư cá nhân hóa giúp gia đình tiếp tục đ: A personalized letter helps families keep supporting their child.
strings.Lần đầu con được giấy khen! “Người bạn t: For the first time, I got a certificate! “Kind Friend” — I hung it above my bed.
strings.Một năm nhìn lại, mình nhớ từng đứa bằng: Looking back on a year, I remember every kid by their own special thing. This job is worth it.

strings.Nhóm chat phụ huynh “nổ” lúc tối: The parents' chat group “blows up” in the evening

strings.“Con tôi bảo không làm. {Title} xem lại: “My child says they didn't do it. {Title}, please check again.”
strings.Đăng quảng cáo váy trẻ em, xin mọi người: Posts an ad for children's dresses, asking everyone to support.
strings.Không rành nhắn tin, vừa gửi một tin tho: Not used to texting, just sent a 3-minute voice message that's hard to hear.
strings.Xóa quảng cáo cho gọn nhóm: Delete the ad to tidy up the group
strings.Tin có ảnh và tên một bạn nhỏ bị gọi đíc: The message with a photo and a child named directly
strings.Nghe tin thoại của bà nội Khoa: Listen to Khoa's grandma's voice message
strings.Việc nào đang làm tổn thương một đứa trẻ: Which one is hurting a child right in front of 40 families?
strings.Một bạn nhỏ bị nêu tên công khai là việc: A child being named publicly is the thing that needs to stop first.
strings.Viết gì vào nhóm chung?: What do you write in the group chat?
strings.Không trả lời, chờ sáng mai: Don't reply, wait until tomorrow morning
strings.Chưa rõ đúng sai; chuyện riêng của trẻ k: It's not clear who's right yet; a child's private matter shouldn't be discussed in a large group.
strings.Ghi nhận, không phán xét, chuyển sang tr: Acknowledge it, don't judge, and move it to a private conversation.
strings.Mỗi phụ huynh một cách nói: Each parent needs a different approach
strings.Ghép phụ huynh với cách liên lạc hợp nhấ: Match each parent with the right way to reach them.
strings.Hỏi thăm vết xước trước, hẹn kể lại sau: Ask about the scratch first, promise to follow up after talking to both kids
strings.Nói ngắn gọn điều đã biết, điều sẽ làm v: State briefly what's known, what you'll do, and when you'll report back
strings.Gọi điện nghe trực tiếp, nói chậm và rõ: Call and talk directly, speaking slowly and clearly
strings.Người lo cần được trấn an, người thẳng t: A worried person needs reassurance; a blunt person needs clear information.
strings.Cùng một sự thật, mỗi người cần một cách: The same truth needs a different way of saying it for each person to hear it.
strings.Nội quy ghim đầu nhóm: Rules pinned at the top of the group
strings.Không đăng ảnh, tên con người khác khi c: Don't post another child's photo or name when something happens
strings.Chuyện riêng của từng bạn trao đổi riêng: A child's private matter is discussed privately with the teacher
strings.Giáo viên trả lời trong giờ 7h–20h, trừ: The teacher replies between 7 am and 8 pm, except for urgent matters
strings.Mỗi tuần đăng bảng điểm cả lớp: Post the whole class's grades every week
strings.Nội quy rõ giúp nhóm lớp là nơi báo tin,: Clear rules keep the class group a place for updates, not a courtroom.
strings.{Title} gọi cho tôi, hỏi vết xước trước: {Title} called me, asked about the scratch before explaining. Turns out both kids were fighting over a pen — both were at fault.
strings.{Title} nói rõ ràng, không bênh ai. Tôi: {Title} explained it clearly, without taking sides. I'll go delete my heated message.
strings.Nhóm chat chung là để báo tin; chuyện củ: The group chat is for updates; a child's individual matter needs a private call.
strings.Mỗi bạn một dòng nhận xét vào sổ liên lạ: One line of remarks per child in the contact book: note what they did well and one next step.
strings.Khoa hiểu nhanh bài đo lường nhưng hay n: Khoa picks up measurement lessons fast but often talks out of turn. Linh writes beautifully but avoids hard problems for fear of mistakes. Tú just transferred schools, tells great stories about home, and mixes up d/gi spelling. Mai is diligent but often sleepy in the morning.
strings.“{Title} ghi giúp con chữ xuất sắc nhé,: “{Title}, please write ‘excellent’ for my child — if she sees anything else, she'll be sad all week.”
strings.Ghép mỗi bạn với dòng nhận xét đúng và h: Match each child with the right, useful remark.
strings.Hiểu nhanh bài đo lường. Tập giơ tay chờ: Picks up measurement lessons fast. Practice raising a hand and waiting for a turn so others can speak too.
strings.Trình bày cẩn thận, đẹp. Thử chọn một bà: Careful, neat work. Try picking one hard problem each week — mistakes are fine.

strings.Đi học rất đều. Nhà giúp con ngủ sớm hơn: Attends school very regularly. At home, help them go to bed a bit earlier so mornings feel more alert.
strings.Mỗi dòng nói một điều làm tốt và một bướ: Each line states one thing done well and one next step, matching the notes.
strings.Nhận xét cụ thể giúp cả con và nhà biết: Specific remarks help both the child and the family know the next step.
Choose the remarks that should NOT be written in the book.
strings.“Tuần tới thử đọc to một đoạn trước nhóm: “Next week, try reading a passage aloud to the group.”
strings.Lời phê là để giúp tiến bộ, không để dán: Remarks are meant to help students improve, not to label them.
strings.Mẹ Linh xin chữ “xuất sắc”: Linh's mom asks for the word “excellent”
strings.Giữ nhận xét thật, gọi điện kể điểm mạnh: Keep the remark honest, call to share Linh's strengths and how home can help her worry less about mistakes
strings.Lời khen không đúng làm con khó biết mìn: An undeserved compliment makes it hard for a child to know what they need.
strings.Trung thực, cụ thể và đồng hành với gia: Honest, specific, and working alongside the family.
strings.Nhận xét ngắn mà trúng, cho mình mượn mẫ: Short remarks that hit the mark — let me borrow your template.
strings.Con thích trò đố từ d/gi, giờ con toàn t: My child loves the d/gi word-guessing game — she wins every time now!
strings.Một dòng nhận xét tốt vừa thật, vừa chỉ: A good remark is both honest and points to the next step.

strings.Cho Quân xuống cuối cho vui: Let Quân move to the back for fun

strings.Giữ điều kiện học tốt cho Quân mà không: Keep good learning conditions for Quân without scolding.

strings.An toàn trước: chỉ giao trẻ khi gia đình: Safety first: only release a child once the family confirms.
strings.Ghi lại cho Cô Hạ: Leave a note for Ms. Hạ

strings.“Lớp chị quậy quá, lần sau em không dạy: “Your class is too rowdy — next time I won't sub for you.”
strings.Sổ bàn giao ghi đủ việc đã làm và chuyện: The handover log records everything done and what needs follow-up.
strings.Đọc sổ bàn giao mà yên tâm hẳn. Mẹ Nhi b: Reading the handover log put my mind completely at ease. Nhi's mom said that man was a neighbor, not an actual uncle. Such a relief.
strings.Ngồi bàn đầu nhìn bảng rõ, con làm hết b: Sitting at the front, I could see the board clearly — I finished all my work.
strings.Dạy thay là giữ đúng những điều người nh: Substitute teaching means sticking to what the regular teacher asked, especially about safety.
strings.Tiết thao giảng có tổ dự giờ: A demonstration lesson with the department observing
strings.Năm thầy cô trong tổ ngồi cuối lớp dự ti: Five teachers from the department sit at the back to observe your Vietnamese lesson.
strings.Một đồng nghiệp gợi ý: “Tập trước câu hỏ: A colleague suggests: “Rehearse the questions with a few strong students beforehand, so the lesson flows smoothly.”
strings.Minh giơ tay lần đầu và trả lời sai. Mấy: Minh raises their hand for the first time and answers wrong. A few kids snicker.
strings.Tập sẵn câu hỏi và đáp án với năm bạn gi: Rehearse the questions and answers with five strong students
strings.Chuẩn bị kỹ giáo án và đồ dùng, dạy như: Prepare the lesson plan and materials carefully, and teach it like a normal lesson
strings.Đổi sang tiết trò chơi cho vui mắt: Switch to a game-based lesson to look more fun
The observers want to see a real classroom.
A real lesson deserves real feedback.
strings.Cả tổ đang nhìn. Bạn làm gì?: The whole department is watching. What do you do?
strings.Gọi ngay bạn giỏi trả lời lại cho nhanh: Quickly call on a strong student to answer again
strings.“Cảm ơn Minh đã dám giơ tay. Ai giúp Min: “Thank you, Minh, for having the courage to raise your hand. Who can help Minh take one more step?”
strings.Nói ngay đáp án đúng: Just give the correct answer right away
strings.Lần đầu giơ tay của Minh quan trọng hơn: Minh's first time raising a hand matters more than a smooth-flowing lesson.
strings.Trân trọng sự dũng cảm, biến câu sai thà: Value the courage, and turn a wrong answer into a stepping stone.
strings.Tổ góp ý: “Phần luyện tập hơi dài, cuối: The department gives feedback: “The practice section ran a bit long, so there wasn't time to check at the end.” What do you do?
strings.Cảm ơn và ghi lại góp ý: Thank them and note down the feedback
strings.Hẹn tiết sau cắt bớt luyện tập, dành 5 p: Plan to trim the practice section next time, saving 5 minutes for an end-of-lesson worksheet
strings.Giải thích rằng lớp này chậm nên phải lâ: Explain that this class is slow, so it takes longer
strings.Im lặng, về nhà buồn cả tối: Stay silent, go home and feel down all evening

strings.Nhận góp ý và biến nó thành một thay đổi: Take the feedback and turn it into a measurable change.
strings.Cả tổ nhớ nhất lúc Minh giơ tay. Tiết th: What the whole department remembers most is the moment Minh raised their hand. Only a real lesson has real moments.
strings.Góp ý hôm trước, tiết sau đã thấy thay đ: Feedback given one day, a change seen the very next lesson. Well worth learning from.
strings.Thao giảng không phải để diễn, mà để cùn: A demonstration lesson isn't for putting on a show — it's for teaching better together.

Put them in the right order.

strings.Đi theo lối cầu thang bên trái, không ch: Take the left staircase, no running, no pushing

strings.Ở sân tập trung, lớp phải có đủ bao nhiê: At the assembly yard, how many kids should the class have?
strings.32 bạn, 2 bạn nghỉ ốm. Bảo có đi xuống k: 32 kids, 2 out sick. Does Bảo come down?
strings.32 − 2 = 30, gồm cả Bảo đi cùng thầy trự: 32 − 2 = 30, including Bảo, who came down with the hallway monitor.
strings.Minh bịt tai khóc: Minh covers their ears and cries
Minh freezes at the classroom door.

strings.Kéo mạnh tay Minh cho nhanh: Yank Minh's arm to hurry them along

strings.Đi cùng và trấn an: an toàn và bình tĩnh: Go together and reassure them: stay safe and calm.
strings.{Title} nắm tay con suốt cầu thang. Lần: {Title} held my hand the whole way down the stairs. Next time I won't cry.
strings.Con đang đi vệ sinh thì chuông kêu, thầy: I was in the restroom when the alarm went off, and the hallway monitor walked me down — the class counted a full 30!
strings.Lớp mình xuống sân đầu tiên mà không ai: Our class was first to the yard, and no one ran. Well done.

strings.Minh thích vẽ. Vy đọc to rất hay. Bảo ma: Minh loves drawing. Vy reads aloud beautifully. Bảo gets bored quickly sitting still. An loves crafts.
