strings.Tự nhổ cọc cắm lại: Pull the stake and put it back yourself
strings.Hàng xóm không nói gì, nhưng từ đó không: The neighbor says nothing, but stops greeting you from then on.
strings.Hai nhà cãi to, xô xát. Cả hai bị mời lê: The two families argue loudly and scuffle. Both are called to the commune for mediation.
strings.Thương lái cân bí đỏ rồi báo 42 ký. Nhưn: The trader weighs the pumpkins and says 42 kg. But last night the family weighed them again and again: a full 50 kg.
strings.Cân của thương lái có cục nam châm dính: There's a magnet stuck under the trader's scale.
strings.Hợp tác xã có cân chuẩn cách đây một cây: The co-op has a certified scale a kilometer away.
strings.Đề nghị cân lại bằng cân của hợp tác xã: Ask to reweigh on the co-op's scale
strings.Cân chuẩn báo đúng 50 ký. Thương lái cườ: The certified scale reads exactly 50 kg. The trader laughs it off and pays in full.
strings.Thôi, bán cho nhanh: Oh well, just sell it fast
strings.Mất trắng tám ký bí. Thương lái hẹn tuần: Eight kilos of pumpkin lost for nothing. The trader says he'll be back next week.
strings.Không bán nữa, chở ra chợ tự bán: Don't sell, take it to the market yourself
strings.Mất một buổi chở hàng, nhưng bán được gi: It costs a trip, but you get a good price.
strings.Đoàn đang dạo chợ đêm, bà Mai hốt hoảng:: While the group is walking the night market, Grandma Mai panics: her wallet's gone, with her papers and money in it.
strings.Bà Mai nhớ có người va vào mình ở hàng t: Grandma Mai remembers someone bumping into her at the fruit stall.
There's a police post at the market's main gate.
Twenty minutes until it's time to head back to the hotel.
strings.Giữ đoàn một chỗ, đưa bà Mai tới chốt cô: Keep the group together, take Grandma Mai to the police post to report
strings.Công an ghi nhận và hướng dẫn làm lại gi: The police take the report and explain how to replace her papers. Three days later the wallet turns up in a trash bin, papers intact.
strings.Cho bà Mai mượn tiền tiêu, hẹn mai tính: Lend Grandma Mai spending money, sort it out tomorrow
strings.Bà Mai cảm động, nhưng giấy tờ thì vẫn c: Grandma Mai is touched, but still no one has reported her papers.
strings.Bạn chạy khắp chợ, không thấy ai. Đoàn đ: You run all over the market and find no one. The group waits, and two others get separated.
strings.Tại điểm tham quan, thanh tra du lịch yê: At a sightseeing spot, a tourism inspector asks to see your guide card. It's in your backpack, not around your neck.
strings.Quy định: hướng dẫn viên phải đeo thẻ kh: Rule: guides must wear their card while leading guests.
strings.Xuất trình thẻ, nhận lỗi không đeo: Show the card, admit you weren't wearing it
strings.Thanh tra kiểm thẻ còn hạn, nhắc nhở rồi: The inspector sees it's valid, gives a reminder and lets you go.
strings.Vẫn bị lập biên bản lỗi không đeo thẻ. T: You still get written up for not wearing it. From now on the card stays around your neck.
strings.Nói mình chỉ là bạn đi cùng đoàn: Say you're just a friend traveling with the group
strings.Khách trong đoàn nói thật: “Đây là hướng: A guest in the group says honestly: “But this is our guide.” Bigger fine for lying.
strings.Hướng dẫn khách không đeo thẻ hướng dẫn: Guiding guests without wearing a tour guide card
strings.Chủ một cửa hàng đặc sản kéo bạn ra góc:: A specialty shop owner pulls you aside: “Bring your group in here, you get thirty percent of whatever they buy. Prices are a bit high, but who'd know.”
Prices here are double the local market.
strings.Lịch trình đoàn đã ký không có điểm mua: The group's signed itinerary doesn't include this shop.
The group stays on schedule, no complaints.
strings.Hỏi ý đoàn, nói rõ ngoài chợ rẻ hơn: Ask the group, tell them the market is cheaper
strings.Đoàn cảm ơn vì được nói thật, rủ nhau ra: The group thanks you for being honest and heads to the market together. That night Grandma Mai sends a long compliment.
strings.Hướng dẫn viên thật thà, chỉ chỗ mua đặc: An honest guide who showed us where to buy specialties at fair prices. Very trustworthy!
strings.Bạn nhận hoa hồng. Hai hôm sau có khách: You pocket the commission. Two days later a guest compares prices online.
strings.Bị dẫn vào chỗ bán đắt gấp đôi, cảm giác: Taken to a place charging double. Felt like we were herded in to be fleeced.
strings.Phụ huynh rủ đi cà phê riêng: Parent asks you out for coffee
strings.Anh Hưng, bố của bé Na, nhắn lúc 21 giờ:: Hưng, little Na's dad, texts at 9 p.m.: “You're so great with my kid. Free tomorrow night? Let me take you out for coffee, just us, and we can talk about her schoolwork.” With a heart emoji.
strings.Chị Thảo, mẹ của bé Na, nhắn lúc 21 giờ:: Thảo, little Na's mom, texts at 9 p.m.: “You're so great with my kid. Free tomorrow night? Let me take you out for coffee, just us, and we can talk about her schoolwork.” With a heart emoji.
strings.Phụ huynh của bé Na nhắn lúc 21 giờ, lời: Little Na's parent texts at 9 p.m., very familiar: “Free tomorrow night? Let's grab coffee, just us, and talk about her schoolwork.” With a heart emoji.
strings.Bé Na học ổn, không có chuyện gì cần bàn: Little Na is doing fine; nothing urgent to discuss.
strings.Nội quy trường: trao đổi với phụ huynh ở: School rules: talk with parents at school or through the shared channel.
The message went to your personal number, after hours.
strings.Lịch sự từ chối, hẹn gặp ở trường giờ hà: Politely decline, offer to meet at school during office hours with the team leader
strings.Buổi gặp ở phòng hội đồng diễn ra ngắn g: The meeting in the staff room is short. The parent gets the hint and only uses the class group from then on.
strings.Chụp màn hình, báo tổ trưởng để có người: Screenshot it, tell the team leader so someone handles it with you
The team leader calls and gently reminds the parent. You feel relieved not to face it alone.
strings.Buổi cà phê toàn chuyện ngoài lề, chẳng: The coffee is all small talk, barely a word about Na. Someone from the parents' group is sitting at the next table.
strings.Không trả lời, chặn số luôn: Don't reply, just block the number
strings.Hôm sau phụ huynh đón con với vẻ mặt khó: Next day the parent picks up their child looking annoyed, asking why you didn't reply.
strings.Ảnh chụp buổi cà phê hôm trước lan trong: A photo of that coffee spreads in the parents' group with plenty of whispering. The principal calls you in for a talk.
The photo just shows two people having coffee.
strings.Có phụ huynh hỏi con mình có bị đối xử k: One parent asks whether their child is being treated differently.
strings.Kể thật, nhận thiếu sót, cam kết chỉ tra: Tell the truth, admit the lapse, commit to talking only at school
strings.Hiệu trưởng nhắc nhở, ghi nhận sự thẳng: The principal gives a reminder and appreciates your honesty. The parents' group slowly settles down.
strings.Ảnh chụp vẫn còn đó. Lời chối làm mọi th: The photo is still there. Denying makes it worse; you're reprimanded before the board and lose merit points.
strings.Cuối buổi, một phụ huynh dúi vào tay bạn: After class, a parent presses a thick envelope into your hand: “Just a little gift. Please bump up my kid's grade this term so they make the advanced class.”
strings.Bài kiểm tra của cháu được 5,5, chấm đún: The kid's test scored 5.5, graded correctly against the key.
strings.Quy định: nghiêm cấm nhận quà để thay đổ: Rule: accepting gifts to change academic results is strictly forbidden.
strings.Trả lại ngay, hẹn phụ đạo thêm cho cháu: Hand it back right away, offer extra tutoring
strings.Phụ huynh ngượng ngùng cầm lại. Hai tuần: The parent takes it back, embarrassed. Two weeks later the kid scores 7 on their own.
strings.Nhận cho phụ huynh đỡ ngại, mai nộp lại: Take it to spare the parent, hand it in through the school tomorrow
strings.Nhà trường ghi nhận việc bạn nộp lại pho: The school notes that you turned in the envelope, but another parent saw you take it and starts gossiping.
strings.Nhận, sửa điểm lên 7: Take it, raise the grade to 7
strings.Ví dày thêm 50 xu. Tối đó bạn trằn trọc: Your wallet is 50 coins fatter. That night you toss and turn for hours.
strings.Một phụ huynh khác so bài kiểm tra của h: Another parent compares two kids' tests and files a complaint with the education office: one child's grade was changed.
The original graded copy is still in the file cabinet.
strings.Nhận sai, nộp lại tiền, chấm lại đúng đi: Admit it, return the money, restore the correct grade
strings.Bạn bị kỷ luật khiển trách và nộp lại to: You're formally reprimanded and return all the money. The principal gives you a chance to make it right.
strings.Nói là chấm nhầm: Say it was a grading mistake
strings.Bản chấm gốc còn lưu. Bạn bị kỷ luật cản: The original graded copy is still on file. You get a formal warning and a pay cut.
strings.Người lạ tới đón học sinh: Stranger comes to pick up a student
strings.Giờ tan học, một người đàn ông lạ tới đó: At home time, a strange man comes for little Bin, saying he's an “uncle” because the parents are busy. His name isn't on the pickup list.
strings.Danh sách đưa đón chỉ có bố, mẹ và bà nộ: The pickup list has only Dad, Mom and Grandma.
Bin shyly says he doesn't know this man.
strings.Giữ bé ở lại, gọi bố mẹ xác minh trước k: Keep Bin here, call the parents to check before handing him over
strings.Mẹ Bin hốt hoảng: nhà không nhờ ai đón c: Bin's mom panics: no one asked anyone to pick him up. The stranger leaves before security arrives. The school reports it to the police and notifies all parents.
strings.Nhờ bảo vệ giữ chân người đó, báo ban gi: Ask security to keep him there, tell the school board
strings.Bảo vệ ra hỏi giấy tờ, người đó lúng tún: Security asks for his ID, and he fumbles and leaves.
strings.Người ta nói chắc chắn nên cho đón: He sounded sure, so let him take Bin
strings.May mắn, bảo vệ cổng thấy lạ và giữ lại: Luckily, the gate guard found it odd and stopped them in time. The principal gives you a serious reprimand for releasing a child against the rules.
strings.Phụ huynh đòi bồi thường vì con bị ngã: Parent demands compensation after child's fall
strings.Bé Tít ngã trầy đầu gối ở sân. Tối đó bố: Little Tít falls and scrapes a knee in the yard. That night his dad posts in the class group demanding 100 coins, “or I'll expose you online”.
strings.Sổ y tế: bé được sơ cứu ngay, băng sạch,: Health log: first aid given right away, clean bandage, family called.
strings.Camera sân trường: bé chạy đuổi bạn rồi: Yard camera: he was chasing a friend and tripped.
strings.Hẹn gặp cùng ban giám hiệu, cho xem sổ y: Set a meeting with the school board, show the health log and camera
strings.Bố bé xem camera rồi dịu lại. Nhà trường: His dad watches the footage and calms down. The school sends a get-well gift, and no one pays compensation.
strings.Tự bỏ tiền túi cho yên: Pay out of your own pocket to keep the peace
strings.Bố bé nhận tiền, tuần sau lại đòi thêm v: His dad takes the money, then next week asks for more because “my son's still scared of school”.
strings.Cãi tay đôi trên nhóm lớp: Argue it out in the class group
strings.Nhóm lớp chia phe. Hiệu trưởng yêu cầu b: The class group splits into camps. The principal asks you to delete your messages and let the school handle it.
strings.Sếp bảo “làm đẹp” sổ sách: Boss says to “tidy up” the books
strings.Trưởng phòng gọi bạn vào: “Cuối quý rồi,: The department head calls you in: “It's quarter-end, move a few expenses to next quarter so the report looks nice. Small thing, everyone does it.”
strings.Khoản chi đã phát sinh và có hóa đơn tro: The expenses were incurred and invoiced this quarter.
strings.Quy chế: điều chỉnh sổ phải có phê duyệt: Policy: book adjustments need written approval.
The annual audit will check invoice dates.
strings.Từ chối nhẹ nhàng, đề xuất ghi thuyết mi: Gently refuse, suggest a proper disclosure note
strings.Trưởng phòng hơi phật ý nhưng đồng ý ghi: The department head is a bit put out but agrees to the note. The report still passes thanks to the clear explanation.
strings.Xin chỉ đạo bằng email trước khi làm: Ask for the instruction by email first
strings.Nhận được yêu cầu viết email, trưởng phò: Asked to put it in an email, the department head backs off: “Never mind, keep it in the right quarter.”
strings.Trưởng phòng không trả lời email, chỉ nh: The department head ignores the email and just texts: “Do it.” You leave the books as they are and pass the question to internal control.
strings.Làm theo cho êm: Go along to keep things smooth
strings.Báo cáo đẹp hẳn. Trưởng phòng vỗ vai: “Đ: The report looks great. The department head pats your shoulder: “Nice work!”
strings.Kiểm toán độc lập đối chiếu hóa đơn: nhi: The independent auditors reconcile invoices: several expenses were pushed into next quarter. You entered them.
strings.Không có văn bản phê duyệt điều chỉnh nà: There's no written approval for any adjustment.
strings.Trưởng phòng nói “tôi không chỉ đạo việc: The department head says “I never told anyone to do that.”
strings.Trình bày trung thực, nộp tin nhắn chỉ đ: Explain honestly, hand over the instruction text
strings.Tin nhắn chứng minh bạn làm theo chỉ đạo: The text proves you followed orders. You're still reprimanded and lose your bonus, but you keep your job.
strings.Nhận hết về mình cho sếp khỏi rắc rối: Take all the blame to protect the boss
strings.Bạn bị hạ bậc lương và ghi kỷ luật. Trưở: You're demoted a pay grade with a disciplinary record. The department head stays silent as if nothing happened.
strings.Trong cuộc họp, anh Dũng nói lỗi gửi sai: In a meeting, Dũng says sending wrong figures to the client was your data-entry mistake. Actually you just received the file from him.
strings.Email lúc 9:14: anh Dũng gửi file đã có: Email at 9:14: Dũng sent the file with the wrong figures already in it.
strings.Nhật ký phần mềm: bạn chỉ mở file, không: Software log: you only opened the file, never edited that line.
strings.Bình tĩnh đưa email và nhật ký, không cô: Calmly show the email and log, attack no one
strings.Sếp xem xong, chuyển sang bàn cách sửa l: The boss looks it over and moves on to fixing the error. After the meeting, Dũng apologizes privately.
strings.Cãi to ngay giữa họp: Argue loudly in the middle of the meeting
strings.Sự thật được làm rõ, nhưng cuộc họp căng: The truth comes out, but the meeting is tense as a wire. The boss tells you both to stay calm.
strings.Nhận lỗi cho êm chuyện: Take the blame to keep the peace
strings.Bạn bị trừ thưởng tháng. Lần sau anh Dũn: You lose your monthly bonus. Next time Dũng still sends a wrong file without checking.
strings.Người xưng công an xin dữ liệu khách: Caller claiming to be police wants customer data
strings.Một người gọi vào tổng đài, xưng là cán: A caller to the hotline says he's an investigator and demands a customer's address and phone number right now “for a case”.
strings.Quy trình: yêu cầu cung cấp dữ liệu phải: Procedure: data requests must come as an official letter to the legal department.
The call is from a personal mobile number.
strings.Từ chối qua điện thoại, hướng dẫn gửi vă: Refuse by phone, explain how to send an official letter
strings.Người gọi cúp máy ngang. Pháp chế cảm ơn: The caller hangs up abruptly. Legal thanks you for following procedure.
strings.Chuyển máy lên trưởng ca: Transfer the call to the shift lead
strings.Trưởng ca xử lý đúng quy trình. Bạn được: The shift lead handles it by the book. You're told to refuse with confidence next time.
strings.Đọc thông tin cho nhanh: Read out the info to be quick
The caller thanks you and hangs up.
strings.Khách hàng hôm trước báo bị người lạ tìm: The customer from the other day reports a stranger showed up at their home to harass them. The call log shows you read out the address over the phone.
The call recording is still on file.
strings.Nhận trách nhiệm, báo pháp chế và công a: Take responsibility, report to legal and the police
strings.Công ty xin lỗi khách. Bạn bị khiển trác: The company apologizes to the customer. You're reprimanded and must retake the data security course.
strings.Ghi âm cuộc gọi còn lưu. Bạn bị kỷ luật: The call recording is still on file. You're disciplined more harshly for being dishonest.
strings.Một khách gọi lần thứ năm trong ngày, ch: A caller rings for the fifth time today, cursing, then says: “I know where you sit. Wait for me after your shift!”
strings.Quy trình: lời đe dọa được chuyển bộ phậ: Procedure: threats are passed to the security team.
strings.Giữ giọng bình tĩnh, kết thúc đúng quy t: Stay calm, end the call by the book, tell the shift lead and security
strings.Bộ phận an ninh xử lý số gọi và bố trí n: Security deals with the number and has someone walk you out after your shift. You get home safely.
strings.Nhờ đồng nghiệp đi cùng lúc tan ca, khôn: Ask a coworker to walk out with you, tell no one
strings.Tối đó không có chuyện gì, nhưng số điện: Nothing happens that night, but that number keeps calling others.
strings.Ghi âm cho thấy cả hai bên đều lời qua t: The recording shows both sides trading insults. You get a warning for breaking the code of conduct.
strings.Sau khi hồ sơ thanh toán của một nhà cun: After a supplier's payment file is approved, a “thank-you” envelope lands on your desk: “Please approve us quickly next time.”
strings.Quy tắc ứng xử: nhận quà trên mức nhỏ ph: Code of conduct: gifts above a small value must be declared and returned.
strings.Hồ sơ lần sau của nhà cung cấp này có và: This supplier's next file has a few unclear invoices.
strings.Bộ phận tuân thủ ghi nhận. Hồ sơ lần sau: Compliance logs it. The next file is checked closely, and fake invoices turn up.
strings.Cất vào ngăn kéo, tính sau: Put it in a drawer, deal with it later
strings.Chiếc phong bì nằm đó, lần nào mở ngăn k: The envelope sits there, and every time you open the drawer your heart sinks.
strings.Giữ lại, chắc chẳng ai biết: Keep it, surely no one will know
strings.Nhà cung cấp bị điều tra vì hóa đơn khốn: The supplier is under investigation for fake invoices. Their records have a line: “gift for the file approver”.
The file you approved had two fake invoices.
strings.Bạn bị kỷ luật và nộp lại số tiền đã nhậ: You're disciplined and return the money. The company gives you a chance to make it right.
strings.Camera hành lang ghi được cảnh giao phon: The hallway camera caught the envelope handoff. You're suspended and heavily fined.
strings.Khách muốn khai khống người phụ thuộc: Client wants to claim fake dependents
strings.Một khách muốn đăng ký thêm ba người phụ: A client wants to add three distant relatives as dependents, though they don't actually support them, “to cut income tax”.
strings.Người phụ thuộc phải đủ điều kiện và có: Dependents must qualify and have supporting documents.
strings.Nếu bị phát hiện, người lập hồ sơ cũng l: If caught, the person who prepared the file is liable too.
strings.Giải thích điều kiện, chỉ đăng ký người: Explain the rules, only register those with proper papers
strings.Khách hơi tiếc nhưng hiểu. Bạn chỉ thêm: The client is a bit disappointed but understands. You point out a legitimate deduction they didn't know about.
strings.Từ chối nhận hồ sơ luôn: Refuse to take the file at all
strings.Làm theo, khách là thượng đế: Do it, the customer is always right
strings.Hồ sơ đi trót lọt. Khách gửi thêm tiền “: The file goes through without a hitch. The client sends extra money as a “thank-you”.
strings.Đợt rà soát phát hiện một người phụ thuộ: The review finds one dependent registered in two places. The file was prepared by your workplace.
The preparer's name is printed at the bottom of the return.
strings.Nhận sai sót, điều chỉnh hồ sơ, hoàn tiề: Admit the error, amend the file, refund the service fee
strings.Khách bị truy thu, nơi bạn làm hoàn phí: The client owes back taxes, your workplace refunds the fee and gets a warning.
strings.Bản nháp có chữ ký của bạn. Bị phạt vì l: The draft has your signature. You're fined for preparing a false file.
strings.Một đồng nghiệp thì thầm: có bên bán bảo: A coworker whispers: an insurance seller will pay for payroll lists and phone numbers of clients' staff. “We split it fifty-fifty.”
strings.Dữ liệu lương thuộc loại bảo mật cao nhấ: Payroll data is at the highest security level.
strings.Từ chối và báo trưởng phòng: Refuse and tell the department head
strings.Đồng nghiệp bị điều tra. Công ty khóa qu: The coworker is investigated. The company locks bulk file downloads.
strings.Bạn đứng ngoài chuyện đó, nhưng chẳng yê: You stay out of it, but you can't feel at ease.
strings.Ví có thêm 50 xu. Nhật ký tải file ghi t: Your wallet gains 50 coins. The download log has your name.
strings.Khách hàng phát hiện nhân viên của họ bị: A client finds their staff getting insurance sales calls that quote their exact salaries. The download log has your name.
Leaking personal data carries heavy penalties.
strings.Khai thật, nộp lại tiền: Tell the truth, return the money
strings.Bạn bị cho thôi việc tạm thời, nộp lại t: You're suspended, return the money and pay a fine.
strings.Nói tài khoản bị người khác dùng: Say someone else used your account
strings.Camera phòng làm việc ghi rõ bạn ngồi má: The office camera clearly shows you at the computer then. The penalty is heavier.
strings.Khách nhờ “lo lót” cán bộ thuế: Client wants you to “grease” a tax officer
strings.Khách đưa bạn một phong bì: “Em quen bên: A client hands you an envelope: “You know people at the tax office, sort it out for me so this year's finalisation goes easy.”
strings.Có những khoản giảm trừ hợp pháp khách c: There are legal deductions the client hasn't used.
Acting as a go-between for the money is also a violation.
strings.Từ chối, chỉ cách giảm thuế hợp pháp: Refuse, show legal ways to lower the tax
strings.Khách tiết kiệm được một khoản đúng luật: The client saves a fair amount legally, and even refers two friends to your service.
strings.Khách cầm phong bì đi, chẳng hẹn quay lạ: The client takes the envelope and leaves, with no plan to come back.
strings.Cầm phong bì, hứa sẽ lo: Take the envelope, promise to handle it
strings.Phong bì 60 xu nằm trong cặp. Bạn chẳng: A 60-coin envelope sits in your bag. You don't know anyone at the tax office.
strings.Khách tố bạn nhận tiền không làm: Client says you took money and did nothing
strings.Quyết toán của khách không nhẹ đi chút n: The client's year-end finalisation isn't one bit lighter. They file a complaint with the company: they paid a “grease” fee through you.
strings.Tin nhắn hẹn “lo giúp” còn trong máy khá: The message promising to “sort it out” is still on the client's phone.
strings.Trả lại tiền, nhận sai với công ty: Return the money, own up to the company
strings.Bạn bị kỷ luật, trả lại tiền. Khách rút: You're disciplined and return the money. The client withdraws the complaint.
strings.Tin nhắn là bằng chứng. Bạn bị xử lý nặn: The messages are evidence. You're punished hard for taking money illegally.
strings.Bạn cũ hỏi số liệu trước ngày công bố: Old friend asks for figures before release
strings.Một người bạn cũ hẹn cà phê, hỏi khéo lợ: An old friend invites you for coffee and slyly asks about the group's quarterly profit before release day: “Just a rough idea, I'm thinking of buying shares.”
strings.Số liệu quý chưa công bố là thông tin nộ: Unreleased quarterly figures are inside information.
strings.Tiết lộ để người khác giao dịch là vi ph: Leaking them so others can trade breaks securities law.
Your old friend laughs it off. Coffee is still nice.
strings.Từ chối và báo bộ phận tuân thủ về lời đ: Refuse and report the request to compliance
strings.Bộ phận tuân thủ ghi nhận, nhắc cả phòng: Compliance logs it and reminds the whole team about the trading blackout period.
Your old friend nods along, then hurries off early.
strings.Cơ quan quản lý chứng khoán hỏi về một t: The securities regulator asks about an account that bought heavily right before release day. The account holder is your old friend.
strings.Lịch hẹn cà phê hôm đó còn trong điện th: That day's coffee meetup is still in your phone calendar.
strings.Bạn bị phạt vì để lộ thông tin nội bộ, d: You're fined for leaking inside information, even if it was one sentence.
strings.Camera quán cà phê còn lưu. Mức phạt nặn: The café camera still has the footage. The fine is heavier for being dishonest.
strings.Sếp giao bạn đặt bàn nhậu sang trọng mời: Your boss asks you to book a fancy table for drinks with the audit team “to smooth things over,” charged to entertainment.
strings.Quy tắc độc lập của kiểm toán không cho: Audit independence rules don't allow that kind of hospitality.
The entertainment budget is already over its limit this quarter.
strings.Đề xuất bữa trưa làm việc bình thường tạ: Suggest an ordinary working lunch at the office
strings.Nhóm kiểm toán vui vẻ ăn cơm hộp cùng cả: The audit team happily shares boxed lunches with the whole team. The work is clear and nobody feels awkward.
strings.Hỏi lại sếp có chắc không, nêu quy tắc đ: Double-check with your boss, citing independence rules
Your boss thinks again and calls it off.
strings.Sếp gạt đi: “Cứ đặt.” Bạn đặt bàn, trưởn: Your boss waves it away: “Just book it.” You book the table; the lead auditor declines to come.
strings.Đặt bàn như sếp muốn: Book the table as your boss wants
strings.Trưởng nhóm kiểm toán từ chối tới và ghi: The lead auditor declines and notes the invitation in the working papers.
strings.Khách quen xin “ghi sổ”: A regular asks to “put it on the tab”
strings.Chú Bảy ở đầu hẻm, khách quen mấy tháng: Uncle Bảy from the top of the alley, a regular for a few months now, takes his usual, about 30 coins, and laughs it off: “I forgot my wallet today, put it on the tab for me, I'll pay you tomorrow.”
strings.Sổ nợ của tiệm còn một dòng cũ của chú,: The shop's tab book still has an old line of his, not crossed out.
strings.Hàng xóm nói chú vừa nghỉ việc ở xưởng m: The neighbours say he just lost his job at the garment workshop.
The shop has no rule about selling on credit yet.
strings.Ghi sổ rõ ngày, món, số tiền, nhờ chú ký: Write it in the book clearly — date, item, amount — ask him to sign and set a date to pay
strings.Chú Bảy ký tên, hẹn thứ bảy. Món hàng đi: Uncle Bảy signs and promises Saturday. The goods go now and the money comes later, but every line of debt is clear.
strings.Nói khéo: tiệm nhỏ không bán chịu, gợi ý: Say it tactfully: a small shop can't sell on credit, and suggest a smaller portion
strings.Chú hơi ngượng, lấy gói nhỏ rồi trả bằng: He's a little embarrassed, takes the small pack and pays with the change in his pocket. He still drops by the next day and even praises the shop for being so well run.
strings.Gật đầu cho qua, khỏi ghi cũng được: Nod it through, no need to write it down
strings.Chú Bảy cảm ơn rối rít rồi đi. Không ai: Uncle Bảy thanks you over and over and leaves. Nobody wrote anything down; only you remember.
strings.Đúng hẹn, chú Bảy ghé tiệm, mặt hơi ngại: Right on time, Uncle Bảy drops by, looking a bit awkward: “I only managed to scrape together half. Could I have a few more days for the rest?”
strings.Dòng nợ trong sổ có chữ ký của chú: 30 x: The debt line in the book carries his signature: 30 coins.
He's just found work loading goods at the market.
strings.Nhận một nửa, gạch sổ phần đã trả, hẹn r: Take half, cross off the paid part, set a clear date for the rest
strings.Chú trả 15 xu, bạn gạch sổ ngay trước mặ: He pays 15 coins and you cross it off right in front of him. With a signature and a due date, the other half is still on record, not lost.
strings.Đòi đủ ngay, trước mặt mấy khách khác: Demand the full amount now, in front of other customers
strings.Chú chạy sang hàng xóm vay, trả đủ 30 xu: He runs next door to borrow, and pays the full 30 coins. Debt cleared, but after that he's too embarrassed to come by.
strings.Chú đỏ mặt, đặt lại 15 xu rồi bỏ về. Từ: He turns red, puts down 15 coins and walks off. After that he takes the long way round and never comes by again.
strings.Thấy chú khó khăn, xóa luôn khoản nợ: He's having a hard time — just write off the debt
strings.Chú Bảy rưng rưng cảm ơn. Tuần sau cả nh: Uncle Bảy thanks you, teary-eyed. The next week his whole family become regulars, and he even brings over a bag of home-grown guavas.
strings.Mấy hôm nay không thấy chú Bảy. Bà Tám k: You haven't seen Uncle Bảy for days. Grandma Tám says he's moved out of his rented room, and nobody knows where he went. Not a single line records the 30 coins from the other day.
strings.Tổ dân phố còn giữ số điện thoại người n: The neighbourhood committee still has his family's phone number.
strings.Nhờ tổ dân phố nhắn người nhà chú, nói n: Ask the neighbourhood committee to message his family, gently
strings.Con gái chú gọi lại xin lỗi, chuyển trả: His daughter calls back to apologise, transfers 15 coins, and asks for time on the rest.
strings.Người nhà cũng không liên lạc được với c: Even his family can't reach him. The debt is as good as gone.
strings.Đăng ảnh chú lên nhóm cư dân, bêu tên “q: Post his photo in the residents' group, naming him as a “deadbeat”
strings.Bài đăng nhiều bình luận, nhưng không có: The post gets lots of comments, but there's no signature to prove anything. People in the alley think the shop went too far.
strings.Có mấy chục xu mà đăng ảnh người ta lên: Posting someone's photo online over a few dozen coins. Who'd dare shop there now?
strings.Coi như học phí: từ nay bán chịu thì phả: Call it a lesson learned: from now on, credit means a written entry and a signature
strings.Bạn làm một cuốn sổ mới, trang đầu ghi:: You start a new book, and on the first page you write: “Date, item, amount, signature.” Thirty coins — a pricey lesson, but one you won't forget.
strings.“Chờ em ra ATM”: “Wait while I run to the ATM”
strings.Bàn năm người gọi đầy món, hóa đơn 60 xu: A table of five orders loads of dishes; the bill comes to 60 coins. When it's time to pay, one guy stands up: “I'll just run to the ATM at the end of the lane.” The others start getting up too.
A payment QR code is stuck right on the table.
The nearest ATM is two streets away.
strings.Cả bàn cầm điện thoại lướt mạng suốt buổ: The whole table has been scrolling on their phones all meal.
strings.Mời cả bàn quét mã QR trên bàn, chia nha: Invite the table to scan the QR code on the table and split the bill right there
strings.Hóa ra ai cũng có ứng dụng ngân hàng. Nă: Turns out everyone has a banking app. Five minutes later the bill is paid in full, and they even ask for more toothpicks.
strings.Lịch sự đề nghị một người ở lại chờ bạn: Politely ask one person to stay and wait for their friend to come back
strings.Anh kia quay lại thật, trả đủ và xin lỗi: The guy really does come back, pays in full and apologises for the wait.
strings.Người ở lại chỉ gom được 40 xu, thề khôn: The one who stayed can only scrape together 40 coins, swearing he doesn't know where his friend went. The restaurant loses 20 coins but keeps most of it.
strings.Tin lời, để cả bàn về dần: Take their word and let the table drift off
strings.Mười phút, rồi ba mươi phút. Không ai qu: Ten minutes, then thirty. Nobody comes back, and the phone number they left doesn't work. The restaurant loses the full 60 coins for the food.
strings.Đơn thu hộ 45 xu, bạn đã ứng trước tiền: A 45-coin cash-on-delivery order, and as always you've already fronted the money for the goods to the shop. When you arrive, the customer answers and says: “I didn't order anything,” then hangs up.
strings.Ứng dụng có nút “Khách từ chối nhận” và: The app has a “Customer refused” button and a return process.
strings.Shop cam kết trả lại tiền ứng khi nhận l: The shop promises to refund the fronted money when the goods come back intact.
The box still has its seal intact.
strings.Chụp ảnh, bấm “Khách từ chối”, mang hàng: Take a photo, tap “Customer refused”, and return the goods to the shop the same day
strings.Shop nhận lại hàng còn nguyên tem, chuyể: The shop gets the goods back with the seal intact and refunds your money right away. You only lose one wasted trip. Next time, call to confirm high-value orders before fronting money.
strings.Gọi lại mấy lần, năn nỉ khách nhận: Call back again and again, begging them to take it
strings.Lần thứ ba khách bắt máy: hóa ra vợ khác: On the third try the customer picks up: turns out his wife ordered it. He takes the package and pays in full.
strings.Khách chặn số. Chạy tới chạy lui, bạn lỡ: The customer blocks your number. Running back and forth, you miss two other orders and the return deadline, and the shop charges you a 10-coin fee.
strings.Để hàng trong cốp, tính sau: Leave it in the scooter trunk and deal with it later
strings.Mấy hôm sau mới nhớ ra: quá hạn hoàn, hộ: You only remember days later: past the return deadline, and the box is dented by the rain. The shop won't take it back, and your 45 coins fronted are gone.
strings.Khách trả phòng lúc tờ mờ sáng: A guest checks out at dawn
strings.Năm giờ sáng, khách phòng hai để chìa kh: At five in the morning, the guest in room two leaves the key at the desk and goes. Only when you clean the room do you find the minibar empty: water, beer, snacks — 25 coins unpaid in total.
strings.Lúc nhận phòng bạn có giữ 50 xu tiền cọc: At check-in you held a 50-coin deposit through the app.
strings.Bảng giá minibar dán ngay cửa tủ, khách: The minibar price list is stuck right on the fridge door, and the guest signed the check-in form.
strings.Ứng dụng đặt phòng cho gửi hóa đơn phát: The booking app lets you send an extra-charges invoice with photos.
strings.Chụp ảnh tủ, gửi hóa đơn qua ứng dụng, t: Photograph the fridge, send the invoice through the app, take 25 coins from the deposit and refund the rest
strings.Khách nhắn lại: “Xin lỗi, sáng vội quá q: The guest replies: “Sorry, I was in such a rush this morning I forgot.” The minibar is paid in full, and the guest still leaves five stars.
strings.Hoàn đủ cọc trước, rồi nhắn xin khách ch: Refund the full deposit first, then message the guest asking them to transfer the minibar money
strings.Khách tự giác chuyển 25 xu, kèm lời khen: The guest kindly transfers the 25 coins, along with a compliment on the lovely homestay.
strings.Tin nhắn “đã xem” rồi im lặng. Cọc đã ho: The message shows “seen”, then silence. The deposit's been refunded, and the 25 coins for the minibar can't be recovered.
strings.Để ứng dụng hoàn cọc tự động như mọi khi: Let the app refund the deposit automatically as usual, sort out the minibar later
strings.May là khách tự nhớ ra và chuyển khoản t: Luckily the guest remembered and transferred the money.
strings.Cọc đã tự hoàn từ sáng. Khách không bao: The deposit was auto-refunded that morning. The guest never replies. The minibar is a total loss of 25 coins.
strings.Quỹ lớp cứ hẹn mãi: The class fund keeps getting put off
strings.Cuối tuần lớp đi dã ngoại, cả lớp đã góp: The class goes on a field trip this weekend. Everyone has chipped in for the bus and snacks, except little Na's family, who've asked for more time for the third time. The bus comes tomorrow, and 20 coins are still missing.
Na's mum just had a new baby, and her dad works far away.
strings.Ban phụ huynh có quỹ khuyến học nhỏ cho: The parents' committee has a small scholarship fund for families in need.
strings.Nhắn riêng mẹ bé Na hỏi thăm, gợi ý góp: Message Na's mum privately to check in, suggest paying in instalments or using the scholarship fund
strings.Mẹ Na nhắn lại thật dài, cảm ơn vì được: Na's mum sends back a long message, thankful to be asked privately. The scholarship fund covers Na's share, and the family promises to pay it back bit by bit. Tomorrow morning Na is the first one on the bus.
strings.Thôi, mình tự bỏ tiền túi đóng thay cho: Oh well, just pay it out of your own pocket
strings.Na được đi, vui lắm. Nhưng lần sau nhà b: Na gets to go and is thrilled. But next time her family stays quiet again, and the parents' committee doesn't know to help. Your wallet is 20 coins lighter.
strings.Nhắc tên nhà bé Na trong nhóm Zalo của l: Name little Na's family in the class Zalo group to speed things up
strings.Tiền được đóng ngay tối đó, nhưng mẹ Na: The money is paid that very evening, but Na's mum quietly leaves the group. The next day a few kids tease Na as “the fund debtor”. The parents' committee says next time it should be a private message.
strings.Công ty Minh Phát còn nợ 45 xu phí dịch: Minh Phát Company still owes 45 coins in service fees from last quarter, three weeks overdue. Their accountant always says “the boss will approve it next week”.
strings.Hợp đồng ghi rõ hạn thanh toán 15 ngày s: The contract clearly says payment is due 15 days after receiving the invoice.
strings.Chưa có biên bản đối chiếu công nợ nào đ: No balance reconciliation statement has been signed yet.
This month you're still doing their paperwork.
strings.Gửi thư nhắc nợ kèm biên bản đối chiếu c: Send a payment reminder with a balance reconciliation statement, proposing a specific payment date
strings.Kế toán Minh Phát ký biên bản đối chiếu,: Minh Phát's accountant signs the reconciliation and promises payment within two days. Now it's in black and white, the debt is no longer an empty promise.
strings.Báo lịch sự: tạm dừng làm hồ sơ tháng tớ: Politely notify them: next month's filing is paused until they pay
strings.Nửa tiếng sau giám đốc Minh Phát gọi xin: Half an hour later, Minh Phát's director calls to apologise and transfers the full 45 coins.
strings.Minh Phát phật ý, trả trước 20 xu, phần: Minh Phát takes offence, pays 20 coins up front, asks for more time on the rest, then takes their business elsewhere.
strings.Thôi cứ đợi, khách lớn mà: Just wait, they're a big client
strings.Bạn làm tiếp hồ sơ, còn ứng luôn 20 xu l: You keep doing their paperwork and even front 20 coins in filing fees for them. The next week their accountant says “next week” again.
strings.Minh Phát chuyển khoản đủ 45 xu theo biê: Minh Phát transfers the full 45 coins per the reconciliation statement. Their accountant messages: “Thanks for the clear reminder, the boss approved it much faster.”
The reconciliation statement is signed by both sides.
The new quarter's contract is almost up for renewal.
strings.Cảm ơn, xuất hóa đơn đầy đủ, thêm điều k: Say thanks, issue a full invoice, add a payment-terms clause to the new contract
strings.Tiền về đủ. Hợp đồng mới ghi rõ hạn than: Paid in full. The new contract spells out the payment deadline and a late fee, and both sides find it easier to work together.
strings.Bớt 5 xu cho lần trả chậm này để giữ khá: Knock 5 coins off for this late payment to keep the client
strings.Minh Phát vui vẻ gia hạn thêm một năm. Í: Minh Phát happily renews for another year. 5 coins less, but you keep a long-term client.
strings.Nghe tin Minh Phát tạm ngừng kinh doanh,: Word is Minh Phát has suspended business and the office is locked. The 45 coins in service fees and the 20 coins in filing fees you fronted are still unpaid.
strings.Không có biên bản đối chiếu công nợ nào: No balance reconciliation statement was ever signed.
strings.Chủ nợ có thể gửi hồ sơ đòi nợ trong đợt: Creditors can file claims during the asset liquidation.
strings.Gom hợp đồng, hóa đơn, gửi hồ sơ đòi nợ: Gather the contracts and invoices, and file a claim
strings.Nhờ hợp đồng và hóa đơn đầy đủ, bạn được: Thanks to complete contracts and invoices, you get 15 coins back in the liquidation.
strings.Hồ sơ được nhận, nhưng tài sản còn lại k: The claim is accepted, but the remaining assets aren't enough to pay the creditors. All you keep is the lesson.
strings.Ghi nhận nợ khó đòi, từ nay thu trước mộ: Record it as a bad debt, and from now on take half the fee up front
strings.Bạn sửa mẫu hợp đồng: thu trước 50%, quá: You revise your contract template: 50% up front, and service is paused after 15 days overdue. This loss is the price of the lesson.
strings.“Bưu điện” xin mã OTP: The “post office” asks for your OTP
strings.Một số lạ gọi tới: “Dạ bưu điện đây, đơn: An unknown number calls: “Hello, this is the post office. Your parcel is stuck because of a wrong address. I've just texted you a confirmation code — please read me the six digits so I can redeliver it.”
strings.Tin nhắn vừa tới ghi: “Mã OTP xác thực g: The text that just arrived says: “OTP to verify an e-wallet transaction. Never share it with anyone.”
You haven't ordered anything these past few days.
strings.Người gọi biết tên bạn nhưng không đọc đ: The caller knows your name but can't read out the tracking number.
strings.Không đọc mã, cúp máy, báo số lạ cho tổn: Don't read the code, hang up, report the number to the anti-scam hotline and Ms. Lụa
strings.Bạn chặn số và gửi báo cáo. Cô Lụa đọc c: You block the number and file a report. Ms. Lụa reads it out to the whole neighbourhood: “Post office, bank, delivery driver… nobody needs your OTP.”
strings.Hỏi lại mã vận đơn và tên người gửi: Ask for the tracking number and the sender's name
strings.Người gọi ấp úng rồi cúp máy. Lần sau kh: The caller stammers and hangs up. Next time, no need for questions: if they ask for an OTP, hang up.
strings.Đang bận, đọc mã cho xong: You're busy, just read the code and be done
strings.Ví điện tử chặn giao dịch lạ và gọi hỏi: The e-wallet blocks the odd transaction and calls to check. Shaken, you change your password: an OTP is the key to your wallet — never read it out to anyone.
strings.Mấy giây sau ví báo trừ 45 xu cho một gi: Seconds later the wallet shows 45 coins taken for a transaction you never made. An OTP is the key to your account: no post office or delivery driver needs it to deliver anything.
strings.Tin nhắn hiện ngay trong mục tin của ngâ: A text shows up right in your usual bank's message thread: “Your account will be locked in 24 hours because your biometrics have not been updated. Visit the following link to verify.”
strings.Tên miền trong link lạ hoắc, có thêm chữ: The domain in the link looks odd, with an extra “-xacthuc” in it.
strings.Kẻ gian có thể mạo tên ngân hàng để tin: Scammers can spoof the bank's name so their text lands in the familiar thread.
strings.Ngân hàng chỉ cập nhật sinh trắc học tro: Banks only update biometrics in the official app or at the counter.
strings.Không bấm link, mở ứng dụng ngân hàng ch: Don't tap the link; open the official bank app to check
strings.Tài khoản vẫn bình thường, chẳng có yêu: The account is fine, with no requests at all. You delete the text and remind the family: banks don't send login links by text.
strings.Để tối rảnh rồi xem: Leave it for this evening when you're free
strings.Tối đó tổ dân phố đăng cảnh báo đúng tin: That evening the neighbourhood committee posts a warning about this exact text. You delete it, relieved.
strings.Bấm link, đăng nhập và nhập mã OTP cho k: Tap the link, log in and enter the OTP quickly
strings.Trang giả bị lỗi giữa chừng, bạn kịp gọi: The fake page glitches halfway, and you manage to call the hotline to lock your account. Close call.
strings.Vừa nhập xong mã OTP, tài khoản bị chuyể: Right after you enter the OTP, 50 coins are transferred out of your account; the hotline only manages to freeze the rest. Banks never ask for an OTP or send login links by text.
strings.“Trúng thưởng, nộp phí nhận quà”: “You've won! Pay a fee to claim your prize”
strings.Một giọng nữ ngọt ngào: “Chúc mừng số đi: A sweet female voice: “Congratulations, your phone number has won a motorbike in our customer appreciation programme! Just transfer 30 coins for shipping and tax, and it'll be delivered to your door today.”
strings.Bạn không tham gia chương trình bốc thăm: You haven't entered any prize draw.
The fee account is in a private individual's name.
strings.Giải thưởng thật không bao giờ bắt nộp p: Real prizes never make you pay a fee before you can claim them.
strings.Gọi tổng đài chính thức của hãng xe để h: Call the motorbike brand's official hotline to ask
strings.Tổng đài xác nhận không có chương trình: The hotline confirms there's no such programme and thanks you for reporting it. Real prizes never make you pay first.
strings.Cười trừ, chặn số: Laugh it off and block the number
strings.Số kia gọi thêm hai lần bằng số khác rồi: They call twice more from different numbers, then give up. You tell the whole alley and everyone laughs.
strings.Chuyển 30 xu phí, xe máy cơ mà: Transfer the 30-coin fee — it's a motorbike!
strings.Chuyển xong, giọng nữ ngọt ngào báo “đan: Once you've paid, the sweet voice says it's “being processed” and promises to call back tomorrow.
strings.Giọng nữ hôm qua gọi lại: “Xe đã ra kho: Yesterday's female voice calls again: “The bike has left the warehouse — just transfer another 40 coins for insurance and it'll be delivered right away. If you don't, you'll lose yesterday's 30 coins.”
Every call brings a new fee.
strings.Công an phường có đường dây nóng tiếp nh: The ward police have a hotline for scam reports.
strings.Dừng lại, không chuyển thêm, mang sao kê: Stop, don't transfer any more, take your bank statement to the ward police and report it
strings.Cán bộ ghi nhận và dặn: kẻ lừa luôn nói: The officer takes your report and warns: scammers always say “pay or you'll lose what you already paid”. You lost 30 coins, but you stopped at the right time.
strings.Chuyển thêm 40 xu cho khỏi phí tiền hôm: Transfer another 40 coins so yesterday's money isn't wasted
strings.Chuyển xong thì số kia tắt máy luôn. Khô: As soon as you pay, the number goes dead. There's no motorbike. Once money's gone, don't pay more to “win it back”.
strings.“Chuyển nhầm, chuyển lại giúp”: “Sent by mistake, please send it back”
strings.Tài khoản của bạn bỗng nhận 40 xu từ một: Your account suddenly receives 40 coins from a stranger. Right after, a call: “I sent it to you by mistake. Could you kindly send it back to this account? My old one's been locked.”
strings.Số tài khoản người gọi đưa khác với tài: The account number the caller gives is different from the one that sent the money.
strings.Người gọi giục liên tục, giọng rất khổ s: The caller keeps pushing, sounding very distressed.
strings.Ngân hàng có quy trình tra soát, hoàn tr: Banks have a process to trace and reverse mistaken transfers.
strings.Không chuyển cho số lạ, báo ngân hàng tr: Don't send to the unknown account; ask the bank to trace it and return it to the original account
strings.Ngân hàng xác minh rồi hoàn tiền về đúng: The bank verifies it and returns the money to the account it came from. The caller never calls again. Money sent by mistake should go back through the bank, to where it came from.
strings.Tự chuyển trả về đúng tài khoản đã gửi t: Send it back yourself to the account it came from
strings.Tiền về đúng chỗ cũ, người gọi im bặt. H: The money goes back where it came from, and the caller goes quiet. The next day the bank advises: next time, let the bank trace it to be safe.
strings.Chuyển lại vào số người gọi đưa cho nhan: Send it to the account the caller gave, to be quick
strings.Người gọi cảm ơn rối rít rồi tắt máy. Mọ: The caller thanks you profusely and hangs up. Everything seems settled.
strings.Một “công ty tài chính” gọi tới: khoản 4: A “finance company” calls: the 40 coins that landed in your account the other day was a loan in your name. They demand 60 coins with interest today, and threaten to call people in your contacts.
You've never signed any loan agreement.
strings.Số 40 xu kia bạn đã chuyển đi cho người: You already sent those 40 coins on to a stranger.
strings.Công an phường tuần nào cũng nhận tin bá: The ward police get reports like this every week.
strings.Mang sao kê lên công an phường, chỉ trả: Take your bank statement to the ward police, and repay only the 40-coin principal through official channels
strings.Công an xác nhận đây là chiêu “chuyển nh: The police confirm it's the familiar “sent by mistake” trick. You repay exactly the 40-coin principal and not a coin of interest. Remember: money sent by mistake only goes back through the bank.
strings.Trả đủ 60 xu cho yên, sợ họ gọi người nh: Pay the full 60 coins for peace of mind, afraid they'll call your family
strings.Trả xong, tuần sau họ lại gọi đòi “phí t: After you pay, they call again the next week demanding a “settlement fee”. Now you understand: money sent by mistake goes back through the bank, not to an account a stranger gives you.
strings.“Sếp” nhắn Zalo chuyển tiền gấp: The “boss” messages on Zalo for an urgent transfer
strings.Zalo hiện tin nhắn từ tài khoản tên “Giá: A Zalo message from an account named “Director Hùng”, with the right profile photo: “I'm in a meeting with a partner. Transfer this advance to this account within 15 minutes, I'll send the paperwork later. Don't call, I can't pick up.”
strings.Tài khoản Zalo mới tạo tuần trước, không: The Zalo account was created last week and isn't in the company group.
strings.Tài khoản nhận tiền đứng tên một cá nhân: The receiving account is in the name of an unknown individual.
strings.Quy chế: khoản chi lớn phải có phiếu đề: Company rules: large payments need a request form and two signatures.
strings.Gọi thẳng số điện thoại của sếp đã lưu t: Call the boss directly on the number you saved before
strings.Giám đốc thật đang ngồi phòng bên, chưa: The real director is sitting in the next room and never sent any message. The company sends a warning to every department, and you get a spot bonus for sticking to procedure.
strings.Trả lời: cần phiếu đề nghị có đủ hai chữ: Reply: a request form with both signatures is needed, as the rules say
The account goes quiet and deletes the message. The next morning the director reminds the whole company: nobody transfers money just because of a message.
strings.Sếp đang gấp, chuyển ngay rồi tính: The boss is in a hurry — transfer now, sort it out later
strings.Chiều đó giám đốc thật hỏi về khoản chi: That afternoon the real director asks about the strange payment. The company reports it to the police, but the bank can only freeze part of it; you get disciplined and lose your quarterly bonus. Every transfer request by message must be verified with a call.
strings.“Điện lực” dọa cắt điện: The “power company” threatens to cut the electricity
strings.Một người xưng nhân viên điện lực gọi tớ: Someone claiming to be from the power company calls, sounding harsh: “Your premises owe two billing periods. Transfer 35 coins to this account now, or the technical team will come cut your power in thirty minutes!”
strings.Tiền điện tháng này đã trừ tự động, biên: This month's electricity was paid by auto-debit; the receipt is still in the app.
strings.Tài khoản nhận tiền đứng tên một cá nhân: The receiving account is in a private individual's name, not the power company's.
strings.Điện lực chỉ thu qua kênh chính thức và: The power company only collects through official channels and always gives several days' notice.
strings.Mở ứng dụng điện lực tra hóa đơn, báo số: Open the power company app to check the bill, and report the number to the hotline
strings.Không nợ đồng nào. Tổng đài điện lực cảm: Not a coin owed. The power company's hotline thanks you and passes the number on to the police. The power company never asks for transfers to personal accounts.
strings.Chạy sang hỏi nhà bên có bị gọi không: Pop next door to ask if they got a call too
strings.Nhà bên cũng vừa bị gọi y hệt. Hai nhà c: The neighbours just got the exact same call. Both households block the number, and the lights stay on.
strings.Chuyển 35 xu cho kịp, đang giữa ca: Transfer 35 coins to be safe, you're mid-shift
strings.Ba mươi phút trôi qua, chẳng đội kỹ thuậ: Thirty minutes pass, no technical team shows up, and the number can't be reached. The fund loses 35 coins for a debt that never existed.
strings.Công an phường báo tin: nhờ nhiều người: The ward police bring news: thanks to lots of residents reporting strange numbers, a group that made calls pretending to be the post office and the power company has been arrested. The number you reported was on the list.
strings.Thư cảm ơn của công an phường kèm một kh: A thank-you letter from the ward police, with a small reward.
strings.Cô Lụa muốn dán danh sách “các chiêu lừa: Ms. Lụa wants to put a list of “common scams” on the alley noticeboard.
strings.Nhận 15 xu cảm ơn, kể lại chuyện cho cả: Accept the 15-coin thank-you and tell the whole alley the story
strings.Cô Lụa gọi bạn là “người gác cổng” của h: Ms. Lụa calls you the alley's “gatekeeper”. That evening the noticeboard gets a new line: “If they ask for an OTP, hang up.”
strings.Góp phần thưởng vào quỹ tuần tra của hẻm: Donate the reward to the alley's patrol fund
strings.Cô Lụa cảm động, in tờ cảnh báo lừa đảo: Ms. Lụa is touched, and prints scam-warning flyers to stick on every door. The whole alley mentions your name whenever a strange number calls.
strings.Một khách quen say ngà ngà cứ nắm tay bé: A tipsy regular keeps grabbing little Linh's hand at the counter, saying things that make her blush and back into the corner.
Linh is only 19 and works part-time.
Other customers start to look over.
strings.Đứng ra chắn, nói rõ: “Anh tôn trọng nhâ: Step in and say clearly: “Please respect my staff. If this continues, I'll ask you to leave.”
strings.Khách lầm bầm bỏ về, để lại một đánh giá: The customer grumbles off and leaves a 1-star review. Linh thanks you; the whole team feels protected.
